spells.SP01.name: Spark
spells.SP01.effect: A basic attack spell learned at the first inn.
spells.SP01.text: 4 MP. Deals 4 + level × 2 damage, regardless of enemy defense.
spells.SP02.name: Dewmend
spells.SP02.effect: Restores the HP shared with your companions.
spells.SP02.text: 5 MP. Restores 10 + level to the party’s shared HP.
spells.SP03.name: Stone Mantle
spells.SP03.effect: A protective spell that prepares you for the next enemy hit.
spells.SP03.text: 4 MP. Blocks up to 20 damage from the next enemy hit. If no attack comes this turn, it lasts until the next attack.
spells.SP04.name: Dawn Slash
spells.SP04.effect: A spell for striking an enemy preparing a powerful attack.
spells.SP04.text: 7 MP. Deals twice normal attack damage against an enemy preparing a powerful attack. Otherwise, deals normal attack damage.
companions.CP01.name: Gonta the Pot-Lid Shieldbearer
companions.CP01.triggerText: Just before an enemy’s powerful attack hits the party (every time)
companions.CP01.line: Steps forward against powerful attacks, reducing damage taken by 5.
companions.CP02.name: Mint the Medicine-Box Healer
companions.CP02.triggerText: At the end of a round when both sides are alive and party HP is at half maximum or below (once per battle)
companions.CP02.line: Restores 15 HP once when party HP falls to half or below.
companions.CP03.name: Koro the Stone Thrower
companions.CP03.triggerText: After the hero acts, if the enemy is still alive and showing an opening for a counterattack (every time)
companions.CP03.line: Throws a stone for 6 damage when the enemy leaves an opening.
companions.CP04.name: Rue the Lantern Keeper
companions.CP04.triggerText: At the start of battle, including a retry
companions.CP04.line: Lights a lantern at the start of battle, restoring 3 MP.
jobs.JB00.name: Traveler
jobs.JB00.text: No special ability. Levels, gear, and spells work the same way for every job.
jobs.JB01.name: Warrior
jobs.JB01.text: If a normal attack lands on the turn after guarding, that hit deals 6 extra damage.
jobs.JB02.name: Mage
jobs.JB02.text: Attack spells (Spark and Dawn Slash) cost 2 less MP, to a minimum of 1.
jobs.JB03.name: Traveling Performer
jobs.JB03.text: View 3 items in a treasure chest and choose 1.
routes.M.name: Merchant’s Gold Road
routes.M.summary: Help unpack and appraise goods, saving up for the items you want.
routes.M.tradeoff: For those who want to choose their purchases. Fewer chances to find gear or recover naturally.
routes.F.name: Artisan’s Forge Road
routes.F.summary: Tend furnaces and tools, find swords and armor, and try out new gear.
routes.F.tradeoff: For those who like experimenting with gear. Use battles and gold spaces to earn spending money.
routes.B.name: Beast Hunter’s Road
routes.B.summary: Follow tracks, read enemy tells and terrain, and seek victory rewards.
routes.B.tradeoff: For those who want to grow through battle. Frequent encounters make HP, MP, and bag supplies especially important.
routes.H.name: Pilgrim’s Lantern Road
routes.H.summary: Connect the lanterns and help others, replenishing HP, MP, and travel supplies.
routes.H.tradeoff: For those who prefer a gentler journey. Fewer chances to obtain gear and battle experience.

items.HE01.name: Medicinal Herb
items.HE01.limit: Up to maximum HP. Cannot be used at 0 HP.
items.HE02.name: Mana Water
items.HE02.limit: Up to maximum MP. Do not use when MP is already full.
items.HE03.name: Sunny Bean Bread
items.HE03.effect: Restores 7 HP and 2 MP to the party together.
items.HE03.limit: Each is capped at its maximum. Usable even if only one is below maximum.
items.HE04.name: Twin Hill Plums
items.HE04.effect: Choose which fruit to eat: restore 11 HP or 4 MP.
items.HE04.limit: Choose only one from the packet. No leftovers remain.
items.HE05.name: Stump Mushroom Soup
items.HE05.effect: Restores 4 HP. At the end of the current and next enemy actions, restores another 5 HP each time if you are alive.
items.HE05.limit: Up to 14 total. Remaining recovery does not carry beyond the battle.
items.HE06.name: Honeygrass Seed
items.HE06.effect: Restores 18 HP if current HP is at one-third of maximum or below; otherwise restores 8.
items.HE06.limit: Checks HP immediately before use. Cannot exceed maximum HP.
items.HE07.name: Violet Throat Drop
items.HE07.effect: At 0 MP, restores 7 MP. At 1 MP or more, restores 3 MP and 5 HP.
items.HE07.limit: Checks once when eaten. Recovery is capped at each maximum.
items.HE08.name: Wool Bandage
items.HE08.effect: Immediately after the current enemy action, restores 15 HP if direct hits caused 0 HP loss, or 7 HP if they caused 1 or more.
items.HE08.limit: Only if alive after the enemy action. Reducing damage to 0 also grants 15 HP.
items.HE09.name: Wheat-Colored Flask
items.HE09.effect: After a normal rest, restores 10 HP if HP is still below maximum. If HP is full, restores 4 MP instead.
items.HE09.limit: 1 per rest. Cannot be used if both stats are expected to be full.
items.HE10.name: Chick Eggnog
items.HE10.effect: Restores 16 HP when traveling alone. With companions, restores 9 HP and 3 MP to the party.
items.HE10.limit: Checks the number of companions immediately before drinking. Restores shared HP and MP.
items.HE11.name: Two-Tone Jelly
items.HE11.effect: Restores the stat with the lower remaining percentage: one-third of maximum HP or one-third of maximum MP.
items.HE11.limit: Round up. Capped at 18 HP or 8 MP. Choose if the percentages are equal.
items.HE12.name: Sweetwater Shell
items.HE12.effect: Spend 3 MP to fill the shell and restore 20 HP.
items.HE12.limit: Requires at least 3 MP and missing HP. Pay only once.
items.HE13.name: Salted Green Plum
items.HE13.effect: Spend 4 HP to wake yourself up and restore 9 MP.
items.HE13.limit: Requires at least 5 HP and room for MP recovery. The payment does not count as taking a hit.
items.HE14.name: Waterwheel Steamed Bun
items.HE14.effect: Restores 5 HP. During your next 2 turns, the first turn you guard ends with an additional 13 HP restored.
items.HE14.limit: The bonus occurs once, only while alive. Expires if you do not guard.
items.HE15.name: Bubble Candy
items.HE15.effect: Restores 6 HP. Immediately after the current enemy action, recovers up to 9 HP lost during that action.
items.HE15.limit: Only while the party is alive. Does not include HP you paid yourself.
items.HE16.name: Fisher’s Lunch
items.HE16.effect: After eating, restores 21 HP if 0–1 items remain in your bag, 16 if 2–3 remain, or 10 if 4–5 remain.
items.HE16.limit: Count each copy of an item separately. Do not count gear or spells.
items.HE17.name: Water-Moss Mask
items.HE17.effect: Restores 5 HP. On your next 2 turns, each spell you cast immediately refunds up to 2 of the MP actually paid.
items.HE17.limit: Up to 2 refunds, 4 MP total. You must have the required MP before casting.
items.HE18.name: Riverside Salt Dumpling
items.HE18.effect: When movement is confirmed this turn, restores HP equal to twice the die result. Also restores 2 MP per unused step caused by a forced stop.
items.HE18.limit: Up to 6 MP. Does not change the roll or destination. Does not carry into the next turn.
items.HE19.name: Migrating Bird’s Warm Water
items.HE19.effect: During your next 2 turns, each normal attack that hits the real enemy restores 3 MP, or 4 MP if that attack defeats it.
items.HE19.limit: Once per turn, up to 7 MP total. Companion attacks do not restore MP.
items.HE20.name: Silverfish Broth
items.HE20.effect: Restores 12 HP and 3 MP, then flees the chosen battle. Recovery and escape are committed together.
items.HE20.limit: Cannot be used in battles that forbid fleeing. You receive no battle rewards.

items.HE21.name: Miner’s Baked Sweet Potato
items.HE21.effect: Restores 10 HP. If you choose a normal attack, guard, or spell on your next turn, restores another 10 HP immediately after that action.
items.HE21.limit: Choosing an item or fleeing cancels the bonus.
items.HE22.name: Clearstone Spout
items.HE22.effect: Raises current MP to half of maximum MP.
items.HE22.limit: Round the target up. Restores at most 12 MP. Cannot be used if already at half or above.
items.HE23.name: Charcoal Bellows Broth
items.HE23.effect: Refunds up to 9 MP actually paid for the spell on your previous turn, and restores 6 HP.
items.HE23.limit: Does not count MP lost to enemies or items. The refund occurs only once.
items.HE24.name: Blue-Rock Bath Powder
items.HE24.effect: Counts the HP that would overflow maximum HP during the rest, then restores 1 additional MP per 2 overflowing HP.
items.HE24.limit: Up to 8 additional MP. Usable only if MP will still have room after the normal rest.
items.HE25.name: Sugar-Ore Shard
items.HE25.effect: First restores 16 HP. For every 3 HP that would overflow maximum HP, restores 1 MP instead.
items.HE25.limit: Up to 5 MP. Remainders are spent and do not carry over.
items.HE26.name: Unmelting Rock Candy
items.HE26.effect: Restores 8 HP, then removes one chosen effect that drains party HP at the end of a turn.
items.HE26.limit: Still restores 8 HP if there is no matching effect. Does not separately refund HP already lost.
items.HE27.name: Three-Node Ginger
items.HE27.effect: Restores 5 HP at the end of the current and next 2 enemy actions. If HP is full immediately before a recovery, restores 2 MP instead.
items.HE27.limit: Only while alive each time. Remaining recoveries expire when battle ends.
items.HE28.name: Hourglass Medicine Powder
items.HE28.effect: Counting your next turn as the first, restores 24 HP at the start of your second turn.
items.HE28.limit: Restores 0 immediately. Expires if the battle ends before then.
items.HE29.name: Hearth-Roasted Leek
items.HE29.effect: Choose a prepared spell. Restores up to 8 of the MP currently needed to afford that spell, and also restores 4 HP.
items.HE29.limit: Uses the actual required cost. Cannot be selected without a prepared spell.
items.HE30.name: Shared Stone Pot
items.HE30.effect: Restores 10 HP, plus 5 for each distinct companion who provided automatic support during the previous round.
items.HE30.limit: Up to 20 HP. Each companion counts once, however often they acted. Restores 10 in the first round.
items.HE31.name: Birch Sap
items.HE31.effect: Restores 6 MP now and another 4 MP at the start of your next turn.
items.HE31.limit: Up to 10 total. The later recovery expires if battle ends.
items.HE32.name: Moon-Viewing Leaf Wrap
items.HE32.effect: Restores one-quarter of maximum HP and removes one chosen temporary Defense Down effect on the party.
items.HE32.limit: Round HP up, capped at 18. Can heal even without Defense Down.
items.HE33.name: Lily-of-the-Valley Dew
items.HE33.effect: Restores 6 HP. During your next 2 turns, the first spell that actually restores HP also refunds MP equal to half that actual healing.
items.HE33.limit: Round down. Refund capped at 6 MP and at the amount paid for that spell.
items.HE34.name: Sleepy Horse Sugar Lump
items.HE34.effect: For each enemy action actually taken in this battle, restores 4 HP and 1 MP.
items.HE34.limit: Counts up to 4 actions. Only 1 item per victory. Cannot be used after fleeing.
items.HE35.name: Honeycomb Chambers
items.HE35.effect: Eat three small chambers. For each chamber, choose to restore 6 HP or 2 MP.
items.HE35.limit: 3 chambers total. All choices are committed together; no leftovers carry over.
items.HE36.name: Wicklight Bath Crystals
items.HE36.effect: Choose HP or MP and raise it to three-quarters of its maximum.
items.HE36.limit: Round the target up. Restore at most 22 HP or 12 MP. 1 per rest.
items.HE37.name: Mist-Warding Tea
items.HE37.effect: Restores 8 HP. During the current and next enemy actions, the first time an enemy drains MP, immediately recovers up to 7 of it.
items.HE37.limit: Once, only while alive. Does not refund MP paid for your own spells.
items.HE38.name: Hedgehog Warming Pouch
items.HE38.effect: Restores HP equal to the damage actually prevented by the hero’s guard and companion’s shield during the previous enemy action.
items.HE38.limit: Up to 18 HP. Do not count the same prevented damage twice. Cannot be used if the reduction was 0.
items.HE39.name: Evening-Moon Syrup
items.HE39.effect: At the start of your next 3 turns, if HP is at one-third of maximum or below, restores 20 HP and 3 MP.
items.HE39.limit: Triggers only the first time. Does not activate at 0 HP or carry between battles.
items.HE40.name: Frostleaf Chew
items.HE40.effect: On your next turn, restores HP equal to half the actual damage of your normal attack. If that hit defeats the enemy, also restores 3 MP.
items.HE40.limit: Round HP down, capped at 14. Does not trigger from hitting a decoy or from companion attacks.
items.HE41.name: White Porcelain Medicine Jar
items.HE41.effect: Raises current HP to three-quarters of maximum HP. Restores more when you are badly wounded.
items.HE41.limit: Round the target up; restore at most 30 HP. Cannot be used at or above the target.
items.HE42.name: Black-Pepper Tonic
items.HE42.effect: If the landing die result was 1–3, restores 20 HP and 3 MP. If it was 4–6, restores 10 HP and 8 MP.
items.HE42.limit: Uses the adjusted die result, not the distance actually traveled.
items.HE43.name: Royal Kitchen Soup
items.HE43.effect: Prepare for the next battle: when drinking, choose to restore 22 HP or 11 MP at its start.
items.HE43.limit: Only the first battle within the next 3 moves, or started from your current castle gate. Does not apply again on a retry.
items.HE44.name: Crown Droplet
items.HE44.effect: If the boss is at half HP or below, restores 19 HP and 7 MP. Against any other enemy or at any other stage, restores 10 HP and 3 MP.
items.HE44.limit: Restores the party. Does not change the boss’s HP or phase.
items.HE45.name: White Hawk Wing Powder
items.HE45.effect: Restores 9 HP. If you just survived guarding the enemy’s previous powerful attack, also recovers the HP actually lost during that action.
items.HE45.limit: Bonus capped at 15 HP. Counts only direct hits from that powerful attack.
items.HE46.name: Chapel Anointing Oil
items.HE46.effect: Removes one temporary Attack Down and one temporary Defense Down effect from the party. Restores 4 MP and 6 HP per effect removed.
items.HE46.limit: Up to 12 HP. Do not count the same effect twice.
items.HE47.name: Silver-Platter Supper
items.HE47.effect: Add 1 other recovery consumable to restore 28 HP and 12 MP together.
items.HE47.limit: The added item is also consumed, without applying its own effect. Choose it from the bag and confirm both together.
items.HE48.name: Castle-Road Traveler’s Porridge
items.HE48.effect: Counts the distance actually traveled since leaving the previous inn. Restores 2 HP and 1 MP for every 2 spaces.
items.HE48.limit: Up to 8 groups. Unused steps do not count. Cannot be used within 2 spaces of the previous inn.
items.HE49.name: Dragon-Eye Aspic
items.HE49.effect: Restores party HP equal to the HP the enemy actually recovered during its previous action. If the enemy did not heal, restores 7 MP instead.
items.HE49.limit: HP capped at 24. Also restores MP on the first turn.
items.HE50.name: Dawn Spirit Water
items.HE50.effect: Raises current HP and MP to half of their respective maximums. A stat already at half or above stays unchanged.
items.HE50.limit: Round targets up. Cannot be used at 0 HP. Not consumed if both stats are already at half or above.
items.HE23.timing: In battle, the turn after casting a spell
items.HE36.timing: At an inn, immediately after a free rest
items.AT01.name: Powder Bomb
items.AT01.effect: Deals 10 damage to 1 enemy, unaffected by the hero’s attack stat.
items.AT01.limit: Cannot penetrate decoys or a stance that nullifies attacks.
items.AT02.name: Substitution Charm
items.AT02.effect: In battle, halves the next hit that actually deals damage. At a trap, avoids the current trap’s loss once.
items.AT02.limit: Round the halved damage up. The mark remains at 0 damage and expires when battle ends. Identical marks do not stack. One charm serves only one of these purposes.
items.AT03.name: Caltrop Fruit
items.AT03.effect: During the current and next enemy actions, whenever a direct hit deals at least 1 damage, deals 4 damage back to the attacker.
items.AT03.limit: Once per enemy action, up to 8 damage total.
items.AT04.name: Fluff Shield
items.AT04.effect: Absorbs a total of up to 8 direct-hit damage. Capacity left after a small hit can absorb a later hit.
items.AT04.limit: Lasts through the current and next enemy actions. Reapplying the same shield does not add their capacities together.
items.AT05.name: Skylark Whistle
items.AT05.effect: Deals 4 damage. If you guard on your next turn, reduces that turn’s first direct hit by another 4.
items.AT05.limit: Choosing anything other than guard cancels the extra protection.
items.AT06.name: Clover Whetstone
items.AT06.effect: During your next 2 turns, each successful normal attack gains 4 damage on its first hit.
items.AT06.limit: Casting a spell cancels the remainder. Up to 2 activations.
items.AT07.name: Red-Clay Throwing Ring
items.AT07.effect: Deals 7 damage. If the current tell is a powerful attack, deals 7 additional damage to the enemy as it prepares.
items.AT07.limit: Does not cancel the powerful attack itself.
items.AT08.name: Rebound Bean
items.AT08.effect: Reflects damage equal to the HP actually lost from the first direct hit of the current enemy action.
items.AT08.limit: Up to 12. Does not reflect if the party falls.
items.AT09.name: Shepherd’s Clapper
items.AT09.effect: Reduces the current enemy action’s first hit by 3 and also shows the following tell.
items.AT09.limit: Looks ahead 1 turn. If the enemy changes form, its new tell takes priority.
items.AT10.name: Sunset Fuse
items.AT10.effect: Ties a fuse to the enemy. On your next turn, a normal attack or attack spell that hits deals 12 additional damage.
items.AT10.limit: Only the first successful hit. Companion support does not ignite it.
items.AT11.name: River-Pebble Flick
items.AT11.effect: Hits 1 enemy with two pebbles, dealing 5 damage each.
items.AT11.limit: Blocking effects apply separately to each hit. Stops if the first hit defeats the enemy.
items.AT12.name: Crab Pincers
items.AT12.effect: Deals 10 damage. For this hit, first reduces damage prevention from shields or shells by up to 6.
items.AT12.limit: Cannot break through decoys or complete immunity.
items.AT13.name: Rain-Thread Net
items.AT13.effect: During the current and next enemy actions, reduces each hit after the first in a multi-hit attack by 4.
items.AT13.limit: The first hit of each action is unchanged. Damage cannot fall below 0.
items.AT14.name: Low-Tide Horn
items.AT14.effect: Deals 14 damage while the enemy is above half HP. At half HP or below, deals 7 damage and reduces the current enemy action’s first hit by 5.
items.AT14.limit: Checks once immediately before blowing the horn.
items.AT15.name: Waterfowl Decoy
items.AT15.effect: When a normal enemy announces an ordinary single-hit attack, makes it strike the decoy and miss.
items.AT15.limit: Cannot be used against powerful foes, bosses, powerful attacks, or multi-hit attacks.
items.AT16.name: Waterwheel Oil
items.AT16.effect: Reduces each direct hit of the current enemy action by 3. Adds the total damage actually prevented to your next turn’s normal attack.
items.AT16.limit: Bonus damage capped at 9. Expires if you do not attack next turn.
items.AT17.name: Silver-Scale Bookmark
items.AT17.effect: During your next 2 turns, reduces the cost of the next spell that uses MP by 4, once only.
items.AT17.limit: Applies after other savings. A spell that normally costs MP still requires at least 1.
items.AT18.name: Eel Battery Bottle
items.AT18.effect: Choose and pay 1–3 MP. Deals 5 damage plus 3 for each MP paid.
items.AT18.limit: Up to 14. You cannot choose an amount you cannot afford.
items.AT19.name: Bubble Earplugs
items.AT19.effect: Deals 6 damage. Prevents MP loss inflicted on the party by the current enemy action.
items.AT19.limit: Does not change HP lost to enemy attacks or MP you spend yourself.
items.AT20.name: Twin-Boat Mooring Rope
items.AT20.effect: Deals 5 damage. If a companion restores HP after the current enemy action, deals damage equal to that actual healing as well.
items.AT20.limit: Links to 1 companion’s healing, up to 12 damage. Does not grant extra companion activations.
items.AT21.name: Miner’s Rivet Puller
items.AT21.effect: During the current and next hero turns, treats the enemy’s temporary defense increase as up to 10 lower. Deals 6 damage immediately after use.
items.AT21.limit: Does not affect base defense, decoys, or complete immunity.
items.AT22.name: Blasting Clock
items.AT22.effect: Wind the fuse. Immediately before the second enemy action counting from now, it explodes for 20 damage.
items.AT22.limit: Expires when battle ends. This explosion alone cannot reduce a boss below 1 HP.
items.AT23.name: Black-Iron Gauntlet
items.AT23.effect: Treats the turn you use this item as a normal guard, then reduces the first remaining direct hit by another 4.
items.AT23.limit: Counts as guarding only once for guard-triggered techniques.
items.AT24.name: Tin-Splitting Wedge
items.AT24.effect: Deals 3 damage. During your next 2 turns, adds half the actual damage of the first successful normal attack or attack spell.
items.AT24.limit: Round the bonus down, capped at 12. The wedge itself does not trigger it.
items.AT25.name: Mirror-Ore Shield
items.AT25.effect: Reduces the current enemy action’s first direct hit by up to 8 and reflects the amount actually prevented.
items.AT25.limit: One hit only. Reflected damage cannot trigger another reflection.
items.AT26.name: Ceiling Prop
items.AT26.effect: Caps total direct-hit damage from the current enemy action at 12. Even a multi-hit attack cannot deal more than 12 in total.
items.AT26.limit: Losses from sources other than direct enemy attacks, such as poison, still apply separately.
items.AT27.name: Spark-Copy Powder
items.AT27.effect: Deals damage once equal to the total damage your previous normal attack actually dealt to the real enemy.
items.AT27.limit: Up to 18. Does not copy companion attacks or additional effects.
items.AT28.name: Forge Tongs
items.AT28.effect: Deals 8 damage. If you guarded on the previous turn and lost no HP to the enemy, deals another 11 damage.
items.AT28.limit: You must have blocked at least 1 direct enemy hit on the previous turn.
items.AT29.name: Magnetic Hourglass
items.AT29.effect: During your next 2 turns, land one normal attack and one attack spell to add 13 damage on the second turn.
items.AT29.limit: Either order works. Choosing any other action in between cancels it.
items.AT30.name: Vein-Blue Ink
items.AT30.effect: Adds total direct damage with and without guarding to the current and next 2 enemy tells. Reduces only the current action’s first hit by 3.
items.AT30.limit: Up to 3 tells. Updates when HP or stance changes.
items.AT31.name: Mist-Sweeping Feather Broom
items.AT31.effect: If decoys are present, first exposes 1 fake. Choose 1 enemy from the remaining candidates; deals 13 damage if it is the real body.
items.AT31.limit: Also deals 13 against an enemy without decoys. Choosing a fake deals 0.
items.AT32.name: Moon-Stitching Needle
items.AT32.effect: Deals 7 damage. During the current and next enemy actions, subtracts a total of up to 12 from the enemy’s self-healing.
items.AT32.limit: Reducing healing cannot cause the enemy to lose HP.
items.AT33.name: Wind-Hollow Nut
items.AT33.effect: Deals 9 damage. If party MP is 0 at the moment of use, the hollow nut resonates strongly and deals 18 instead.
items.AT34.name: Shadow-Copy Vial
items.AT34.effect: Deals half the actual damage your previous attack spell dealt to the real enemy, once, and restores 2 MP.
items.AT34.limit: Round damage up, capped at 16. Does not copy additional spell effects.
items.AT35.name: Night-Moth Lamp
items.AT35.effect: During the current and next enemy actions, reduces the first hit of the first powerful attack to one-third.
items.AT35.limit: Round up. Normal attacks do not consume the effect.
items.AT36.name: Thorn-Returning Woven Sash
items.AT36.effect: During your next 2 turns, if you guard and receive at least 1 direct enemy hit that turn, deals 7 damage to the enemy.
items.AT36.limit: Still works if damage is blocked to 0. Once per turn, only while alive.
items.AT37.name: Winter-Bud Blade Oil
items.AT37.effect: Deals 17 damage if the party’s remaining HP is lower than the real enemy’s. Otherwise, deals 9 and reduces the current action’s first hit by 4.
items.AT37.limit: Compares the actual HP numbers immediately before use, not percentages.
items.AT38.name: Still-Night Wooden Flute
items.AT38.effect: During your next 2 turns, if a hero spell actually restores HP, the flute sounds and deals 13 damage to the enemy.
items.AT38.limit: Once only. Healing from items or companions does not trigger it.
items.AT39.name: Silencing Moss
items.AT39.effect: If the enemy announces self-healing, stops that recovery. Against any other tell, deals 10 damage.
items.AT39.limit: Boss healing is only reduced by up to 10. Does not stop transformations.
items.AT40.name: Firefly-Path Thread
items.AT40.effect: If the landing roll is odd, deals damage equal to 3 times the die result. If even, reduces the current enemy action’s first hit by up to 2 times the result.
items.AT40.limit: Uses the adjusted die result, not the distance traveled.
items.AT41.name: Hundred-Eye Siege Shot
items.AT41.effect: Divides the real enemy’s current HP by 5, rounds down, then adds 6 to determine damage.
items.AT41.limit: Capped at 26 against normal or powerful foes, or 18 against bosses. Cannot penetrate decoys or complete immunity.
items.AT42.name: Full-Moon Fuse
items.AT42.effect: During your next 3 turns, paying a spell’s cost that brings MP to exactly 0 adds 18 damage to the enemy.
items.AT42.limit: Only the first time. MP drained by enemies does not ignite it.
items.AT43.name: Corridor Knight’s Hand Mirror
items.AT43.effect: Deals 4 damage, plus 6 for each direct hit during the previous enemy action that actually reduced HP.
items.AT43.limit: Up to 22 total. Deals 4 on the first turn of battle.
items.AT44.name: Twin-View Embrasure Scope
items.AT44.effect: On your next turn’s normal attack, choose up to 2 different candidates, including decoys. If either is the real body, the attack hits once.
items.AT44.limit: Only 1 hit on the real body. Without decoys, adds 7 to that attack.
items.AT45.name: Guardian Tower Bell Hammer
items.AT45.effect: During the current and next enemy actions, when party HP immediately before a hit is at half or below, caps the first direct hit dealing at least 1 damage at 5.
items.AT45.limit: Once only. Never increases damage below 5 up to 5.
items.AT46.name: Chipped-Crown Silver Nail
items.AT46.effect: During your next 2 turns, reducing the real enemy from above half HP to half or below adds 12 damage.
items.AT46.limit: Once only. Phase-change conditions remain unchanged. Does not trigger against an enemy already defeated.
items.AT47.name: Last-Stand Red Sash
items.AT47.effect: Pay one-quarter of current HP. Deals 6 damage plus twice the amount paid.
items.AT47.limit: Round payment up, capped at 10. Requires at least 1 HP to remain. The payment does not count as taking a hit.
items.AT48.name: Royal Seal Stopper
items.AT48.effect: Deals 8 damage. Prevents MP loss and temporary Attack Down or Defense Down inflicted by the current enemy action.
items.AT48.limit: HP damage still applies. Existing penalties remain.
items.AT49.name: Triple-Beat War Drum
items.AT49.effect: During your next 3 turns, choose a normal attack, guard, and spell once each. Deals 22 damage after the third action.
items.AT49.limit: Any order works. Repeating an action or choosing another action cancels it.
items.AT50.name: Dawn Duel Glove
items.AT50.effect: The first time the current enemy action deals at least 1 direct damage, increases that damage by 4 in exchange for adding 26 damage to your next turn’s normal attack.
items.AT50.limit: Only the next turn’s first successful hit. The attack mark remains even if used on a turn when the enemy does not attack.
items.AT27.timing: In battle, the turn after a normal attack
items.AT34.timing: In battle, the turn after an attack spell
items.AT42.timing: In battle, with at least 1 MP
items.AT46.timing: In battle, while enemy HP is above half
