items.BD01.name: Traveler’s Compass
items.BD01.effect: After seeing your roll, increase or decrease it by 1. Check the new roll and landing space before deciding.
items.BD01.limit: The result must stay between 1 and 6. Only one roll-changing item per turn. Canceling consumes nothing.
items.BD02.name: Pasture Yoke
items.BD02.effect: For this roll only, a natural 4, 5, or 6 moves you 3 spaces. A 1, 2, or 3 stays unchanged.
items.BD02.limit: Roll only once after using it. The item is consumed even if the result stays unchanged, and no other roll adjustment is allowed.
items.BD03.name: Lark’s Far-Hearing Charm
items.BD03.effect: Choose a battle space within the next 6 spaces that you can reach this turn. Hear the enemy’s name and first telegraph.
items.BD03.limit: You do not arrive or start the battle yet. Not consumed if there is no target.
items.BD04.name: Fence-Mending Plank
items.BD04.effect: When choosing a crossing that costs HP, lay down the plank to reduce this HP loss by 5.
items.BD04.limit: The loss cannot fall below 0. Cannot be used for choices that cost gold, MP, or items.
items.BD05.name: Shepherd’s Picture Card
items.BD05.timing: A multiple-choice question with one correct answer
items.BD05.effect: Identify and remove one definitely wrong answer. Choose your own answer from the remaining options.
items.BD05.limit: Once per question, with at least 3 options. Cannot be used for choices that simply trade benefits and costs.
items.BD06.name: Fruit Seller’s Saucer
items.BD06.timing: When choosing a consumable to receive
items.BD06.effect: Choose one offered recovery item that immediately restores HP or MP, and use it once on the spot instead of putting it in your bag.
items.BD06.limit: You cannot receive the other options. Also usable at inns and before the castle gate. Only items whose effects finish immediately qualify.
items.BD07.name: Wild Strawberry Parcel
items.BD07.effect: If you actually move 1–2 spaces this turn, restore 7 HP when movement is confirmed.
items.BD07.limit: Nothing happens if you move 3 or more spaces. Steps discarded by a forced stop do not count.
items.BD08.name: Rolled-Grass Field Map
items.BD08.effect: In addition to the usual next 6 spaces, mark the types of spaces 7–12 ahead on the same road.
items.BD08.limit: Marks last for the next 3 moves, up to space 99. Does not create spaces or change your road.
items.BD09.name: Inn’s Sample Book
items.BD09.effect: Read the goods and exact price of each item at the next unvisited inn from your current position.
items.BD09.limit: You must arrive at the inn to buy anything. Stock is not rerolled. Not consumed if no inn lies ahead.
items.BD10.name: Knotted-Grass Marker
items.BD10.effect: Mark one normal-battle space you can reach this turn. If you land there, add 6 damage to your first normal attack in that battle.
items.BD10.limit: The mark vanishes if you land elsewhere. Does not change your roll or affect companion attacks.
items.BD11.name: Wave-Turning Shell
items.BD11.effect: Flip the roll to the opposite face: 1 swaps with 6, 2 with 5, and 3 with 4.
items.BD11.limit: This is your only roll adjustment. Does not reroll; you still stop at the first inn or space 100 as usual.
items.BD12.name: Even-Number Float
items.BD12.effect: If your next roll is odd, add 1. If it is even, leave it unchanged. The final result will be 2, 4, or 6.
items.BD12.limit: Roll once. Consumed even on an even roll. No other roll adjustment can be used this turn.
items.BD13.name: Ferryman’s Balance Pan
items.BD13.effect: Choose a recovery, choice, or trap space within the next 6 spaces. Compare each option’s HP, MP, and gold changes using your party’s current values.
items.BD13.limit: Preview only: nothing is paid or received. Actual amounts depend on your state when you land.
items.BD14.name: Knotwork Guide
items.BD14.effect: Fix only the correct first step in a sequence of presses, knots, or placements. Choose the remaining steps yourself.
items.BD14.limit: Once per puzzle with at least 2 steps. Does not complete the puzzle or confirm a reward.
items.BD15.name: Riverboat Cargo Tag
items.BD15.effect: Choose an equipment or item space within the next 10 spaces on the same road. Read the first 2 item names offered there, or fewer if fewer are offered.
items.BD15.limit: You cannot receive them yet. Choices are not rerolled. The mark disappears when you pass the target.
items.BD16.name: Reedboat Matting
items.BD16.effect: Spend 1–4 MP of your choice. Each MP replaces up to 2 HP of this loss.
items.BD16.limit: Protects up to 8 HP. You cannot spend more MP than needed. Gold and item losses still apply.
items.BD17.name: Blue-Cord Waterskin
items.BD17.timing: At a recovery space, before confirming recovery
items.BD17.effect: Convert 2 points of the space’s stated HP recovery into 1 MP. Choose 1–4 such pairs.
items.BD17.limit: Reduces HP recovery by at most 8. Convert only as much as your missing MP allows. You do not also receive the converted HP.
items.BD18.name: Water-Skimming Test Stone
items.BD18.timing: A puzzle with right and wrong answers
items.BD18.effect: Try one candidate and learn only whether it is correct. After seeing the hint, choose your actual answer.
items.BD18.limit: Test one candidate per puzzle. The test confirms no reward, loss, or move count.
items.BD19.name: Boat Hauler’s Belt
items.BD19.timing: When confirming a trap’s gold payment
items.BD19.effect: If you pay the trap’s regular crossing fee, restore 9 party HP immediately after crossing.
items.BD19.limit: Only when you actually pay at least 1 gold. Does not discount or refund the fee.
items.BD20.name: Skiff Cargo Cover
items.BD20.timing: When a trap takes an item
items.BD20.effect: Use this cover instead of surrendering one held item to the trap. After crossing safely, also restore 5 HP.
items.BD20.limit: Replaces only one lost item. Cannot pay for trades, shops, or donations.
items.BD21.name: Miner’s Gear
items.BD21.effect: Halve an even roll: 2 becomes 1, 4 becomes 2, and 6 becomes 3. Check the landing space before choosing.
items.BD21.limit: Cannot be used on an odd roll. This is your only roll adjustment this turn.
items.BD22.name: Leveling Stone
items.BD22.effect: Replace your natural roll with the average of that roll and the final roll used for your previous move. For example, 2 and 5 become 3.
items.BD22.limit: Round down. Unusable on the first turn or if the result would not change. Cannot combine with other roll adjustments.
items.BD23.name: Sorting Compass Needle
items.BD23.timing: A picture or symbol matching puzzle
items.BD23.effect: Correctly match one card to its place. Match the unresolved pairs yourself.
items.BD23.limit: Once per puzzle, only with at least 2 pairs remaining. Does not clear the puzzle automatically.
items.BD24.name: Mine Listening Tube
items.BD24.effect: Read the space number, enemy name, and victory gold and XP for the nearest optional powerful foe ahead on the same road.
items.BD24.limit: Does not move, challenge, or award anything. Not consumed if no such foe lies ahead.
items.BD25.name: Minecart Wheel Stop
items.BD25.timing: Before confirming a trap’s gold payment
items.BD25.effect: Offer the wheel stop to reduce this trap crossing fee by up to 110G.
items.BD25.limit: Payment cannot fall below 0. Usable only if you can pay the remainder. No change is given. Cannot be used in shops.
items.BD26.name: Pattern Chalk
items.BD26.effect: Try writing two different answers. Learn which is closer to the target value, or that they are equally close.
items.BD26.limit: Once per puzzle. Does not show the correct value or confirm your answer or reward.
items.BD27.name: Mine Owner’s Meal Ticket
items.BD27.timing: Before confirming a free inn rest
items.BD27.effect: Set aside 1–12 HP from your usual rest recovery. Receive it after the first enemy action of your next battle, if you are alive.
items.BD27.limit: Set aside no more than you could actually receive now, and subtract the same amount from this recovery. Only the first battle within the next 3 moves. A rematch cannot grant it twice.
items.BD28.name: Ember Tray
items.BD28.timing: When confirming equipment received on the board
items.BD28.effect: A newly received sword adds 7 to your first normal attack next battle. New armor instead reduces the first positive direct hit you take next battle by up to 7.
items.BD28.limit: Once, in the first battle within the next 2 moves. Does not grant extra equipment. Duplicate equipment does not qualify.
items.BD29.name: Stride Tally
items.BD29.timing: Before rolling, within 6 spaces of a forced stop
items.BD29.effect: Answer with the smallest roll from 1–6 that reaches the next inn or castle exactly. If correct, restore 5 HP and 3 MP when movement is confirmed this turn.
items.BD29.limit: One answer only. A wrong answer grants no recovery. Your answer is separate from your actual roll and changes neither the roll nor destination.
items.BD30.name: Strata Folding Stand
items.BD30.effect: Display the landing number and type for each roll from 1–6 at your current position. Group rolls that reach the same stopping space.
items.BD30.limit: Lasts through the next 2 moves. Does not reveal your actual roll, move you, or reroll anything.
items.BD31.name: Mist Pendulum
items.BD31.effect: Change your next natural roll of 1 to 3, or 6 to 4. Rolls of 2–5 stay unchanged.
items.BD31.limit: Roll once after consuming it. No other roll adjustment is allowed this turn, even if the result did not change.
items.BD32.name: Woodcutter’s Homeward Whistle
items.BD32.effect: Set a lookout at one trap within the next 6 spaces. If you land there within the next 3 moves, halve the HP and MP lost to that trap separately.
items.BD32.limit: Round each loss up. The lookout disappears if you pass it. Item and gold losses are unchanged.
items.BD33.name: Shadow-Reading Pane
items.BD33.effect: Underline one matching pair of words in the scene text and action options to show what to compare.
items.BD33.limit: Once per puzzle. Shows a clue without revealing the answer. Not consumed if there is no matching pair.
items.BD34.name: Autumn Shower Mirror
items.BD34.effect: After you arrange a draft answer, show only the first incorrect position from the start. If all positions match, say so.
items.BD34.limit: One draft check. No success, failure, or reward occurs until you rearrange and confirm your actual answer.
items.BD35.name: Night Watch Grass Whistle
items.BD35.effect: Prepare for the first normal battle within the next 3 moves. If you start it at half HP or less and guard on your first turn, reduce the first direct hit by an additional 10.
items.BD35.limit: One normal battle only. Does not activate against powerful foes or the Demon King. Does not add rolls or battles.
items.BD36.name: Deepwood Substitute Token
items.BD36.timing: When choosing to hand over a specified item on the board
items.BD36.effect: Instead of the requested item, hand over one different consumable of the same tier and category worth at least as much. Consume both this token and the substitute.
items.BD36.limit: Cannot be used for purchases or choices that pay you gold. Grants only the original reward once. Unusable without a substitute to hand over.
items.BD37.name: Starmoss Paper Box
items.BD37.effect: If the next 3 spaces you actually stop on all have different types, restore 10 HP and 4 MP after finishing the third event.
items.BD37.limit: Vanishes if a type repeats. Spaces 1 and 100 do not count. No recovery if incapacitated.
items.BD38.name: Violet Whistle Stopper
items.BD38.timing: At a recovery space, before confirming recovery
items.BD38.effect: Reduce that space’s HP recovery by 1–10. Turn the same amount into protection against the first hit in your next battle.
items.BD38.limit: Once, in the first battle within the next 2 moves. The same amount cannot provide both recovery and protection.
items.BD39.name: Blinking Twig
items.BD39.timing: Just before confirming a wrong answer to a single-answer question
items.BD39.effect: Delay the loss from your first wrong answer and choose again once. Resolve the question using your next choice.
items.BD39.limit: Once per question. Cannot be used on an already-correct answer, in battle, or to choose treasure chest rewards. The reward is also granted only once.
items.BD40.name: Lamplight Special Order
items.BD40.effect: Choose one regional consumable slot and request a different consumable of the same tier and category to replace its stock.
items.BD40.limit: Once per inn. Buy it at the normal price. Cannot select staple, sword, armor, or spellbook slots. Ordering alone does not give you the item.
items.BD41.name: Gatekeeper’s Twin Arrows
items.BD41.timing: After rolling, when both results reach the same forced stop
items.BD41.effect: Try 4 if your natural roll is 1–3, or 3 if it is 4–6. Change the roll only if both results stop at the same inn or space 100.
items.BD41.limit: This is your only roll adjustment. Actual distance does not increase. Landing effects that check the roll use the new result.
items.BD42.name: Day-and-Night Tally
items.BD42.effect: Add 3 to a roll of 1–3, or subtract 3 from a roll of 4–6. Swap 1 with 4, 2 with 5, and 3 with 6.
items.BD42.limit: This is your only roll adjustment this turn. Discard leftover steps at inns and space 100.
items.BD43.name: Stargazer’s Window
items.BD43.effect: Choose a destination within the next 12 spaces on the same road. Read how many of the 36 outcomes from two ordinary rolls would let you land there.
items.BD43.limit: Includes arrival on the first move. Assumes normal stops at inns and the castle, survival in battles, and no roll adjustments.
items.BD44.name: Twin Towers Magnifying Glass
items.BD44.timing: A puzzle comparing two pictures or cards
items.BD44.effect: Circle one part that differs from the example. If several differ, show the first found from the top left.
items.BD44.limit: Once per puzzle. Decide what to move next yourself. Not consumed if there is no difference.
items.BD45.name: Guard’s Shoulder Strap
items.BD45.timing: When confirming a new companion at an inn
items.BD45.effect: When that newly joined companion first provides automatic support in a battle within the next 3 moves, restore 8 party HP and 3 MP.
items.BD45.limit: Once, while alive. Does not add companions or change support conditions or the number of activations.
items.BD46.name: Castle Watch Battle Card
items.BD46.timing: Before confirming a challenge against an optional powerful foe
items.BD46.effect: Declare the hero’s first action. A normal attack matching your declaration gains 12 damage on its first hit; guarding as declared reduces the first direct hit by up to 12.
items.BD46.limit: Only the one battle whose challenge you confirm. Passing consumes nothing. Cannot be used against the Demon King. You still need to win the battle.
items.BD47.name: Royal Capital Signpost Card
items.BD47.effect: Choose equipment, items, or recovery. Mark every remaining space number of that type in your current tier on the map.
items.BD47.limit: Marks disappear when you leave the tier or after 4 moves. Not consumed if there are no candidates. Does not reveal other roads.
items.BD48.name: Bell Ringer’s Prediction Book
items.BD48.effect: Predict a low roll of 1–3 or a high roll of 4–6. If correct, restore 12 HP for a low roll or 6 MP for a high roll when movement is confirmed.
items.BD48.limit: Check the natural roll once. A wrong prediction grants no recovery. Does not adjust or reroll the result.
items.BD49.name: Three-Emblem Key Mold
items.BD49.timing: Before the castle gate at space 100
items.BD49.effect: Arrange one sword, shield, and staff. Sword → staff → shield satisfies “sword first, shield last” and reduces the first positive direct hit from the Demon King by 10.
items.BD49.limit: Once per gate. A wrong answer grants no protection. You must still challenge and defeat the Demon King to win.
items.BD50.name: Hero’s Inlaid Board
items.BD50.timing: Before rolling, 3–15 spaces from the next inn or castle
items.BD50.effect: Choose 2 or 3 distinct numbers from 1–6 whose sum equals the distance to the next forced stop. If correct, restore 18 HP and 6 MP when you arrive there.
items.BD50.limit: One answer per destination. Valid if you arrive within the next 6 moves. Does not change your actual rolls, destinations, or turn count.
gear.SW01.name: Starting Sword
gear.SW01.timing: While equipped. Owned from the start.
gear.SW01.effect: Adds 1 to the hero’s attack. No additional effect.
gear.SW02.name: Morning Dew Shortsword
gear.SW02.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack in round 1. Once per battle.
gear.SW02.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 2.
gear.SW03.name: Scarecrow’s Wooden Sword
gear.SW03.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack in the round immediately after guarding. Once per battle.
gear.SW03.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 3.
gear.SW04.name: Lark’s Whistling Sword
gear.SW04.timing: When the hero wins by defeating the enemy with a normal attack. Once per victory.
gear.SW05.name: Clover Sword
gear.SW05.timing: On the first normal attack that hits in a battle entered with a final landing roll of 1–3. Once per battle.
gear.SW05.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 3.
gear.SW06.name: Lamplight Shortsword
gear.SW06.timing: When the hero’s offensive spell first hits the enemy. Once per battle.
gear.SW06.effect: Increase the damage of that spell’s first successful hit by 3.
gear.SW07.name: Rebound Sword
gear.SW07.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack in the round immediately after losing HP to an enemy attack. Once per battle.
gear.SW07.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 3.
gear.SW08.name: Nutcracker Sword
gear.SW08.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack on an enemy already at half HP or less. Once per battle.
gear.SW08.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 3.
gear.SW09.name: Swallow’s Forked Sword
gear.SW09.timing: When the hero lands normal attacks in 2 consecutive rounds. Once per battle.
gear.SW09.effect: Increase the second normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 4.
gear.SW10.name: Hill Standard-Bearer’s Sword
gear.SW10.timing: When you win by round 3 after the hero has guarded at least once. Once per victory.
gear.SW11.name: River-Crossing Sword
gear.SW11.timing: On the hero’s first successful normal attack, if MP was at half or less when battle began. Once per battle.
gear.SW12.name: Spray Scimitar
gear.SW12.timing: When an offensive spell hits in the round immediately after the hero landed a normal attack. Once per battle.
gear.SW12.effect: Increase the damage of that spell’s first successful hit by 4.
gear.SW13.name: Fishbone Sword
gear.SW13.timing: When the hero wins with a normal attack without having guarded in that battle. Once per victory.
gear.SW14.name: Floatglass Rapier
gear.SW14.timing: The enemy hit immediately after the hero’s first successful normal attack in a battle entered on an even landing roll. Once per battle.
gear.SW14.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy that round by 3.
gear.SW15.name: Oarsman’s Greatsword
gear.SW15.timing: On the hero’s first successful normal attack while the party has at least 6 HP. Once per battle.
gear.SW15.effect: Spend 2 party HP and increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 5.
gear.SW16.name: Kingfisher’s Beak
gear.SW16.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack on an enemy telegraphing a powerful attack. Once per battle.
gear.SW16.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 5.
gear.SW17.name: Tide-Waiting Longsword
gear.SW17.timing: When the hero guards in round 1 and lands a normal attack in round 3. Once per battle.
gear.SW17.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 7.
gear.SW18.name: Conch Dagger
gear.SW18.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack in the round immediately after a spell restored party HP. Once per battle.
gear.SW18.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 6.
gear.SW19.name: Eel-Tail Sword
gear.SW19.timing: The enemy hit immediately after a normal attack drops it from above half HP to half or less without defeating it. Once per battle.
gear.SW19.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy that round by 4.
gear.SW20.name: Waterwheel Heavy Sword
gear.SW20.timing: When the hero chooses different actions in rounds 1 and 2, then lands a normal attack in round 3. Once per battle.
gear.SW20.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 7.
gear.SW21.name: Flint Sword
gear.SW21.timing: When the hero first hits the enemy with a damaging item in battle. Once per battle.
gear.SW21.effect: Increase the damage of that item’s first successful hit by 5.
gear.SW22.name: Echo Sword
gear.SW22.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack in round 2. Bonus 1–6; once per battle.
gear.SW22.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage by the final landing roll.
gear.SW23.name: Mica Rapier
gear.SW23.timing: When the hero first uses an offensive spell costing at least 2 MP. Once per battle.
gear.SW23.effect: Reduce that offensive spell’s party MP cost by 2, to a minimum of 1.
gear.SW24.name: Lantern Shortsword
gear.SW24.timing: When the hero wins by using an offensive spell to defeat an enemy already at half HP or less. Once per victory.
gear.SW25.name: Railway Sleeper Greatsword
gear.SW25.timing: Only when the hero lands a normal attack in round 1. Once per battle.
gear.SW25.effect: Its weight slows your opening: reduce that normal attack’s positive damage by 3, to a minimum of 1.
gear.SW26.name: Minecart Wheel Sword
gear.SW26.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack in rounds 2 and 4. Once each round, up to twice per battle.
gear.SW27.name: Anvil Flatblade
gear.SW27.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack in the round immediately after guarding against an enemy’s powerful attack. Once per battle.
gear.SW27.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 7.
gear.SW28.name: Blue Tinstone Sword
gear.SW28.timing: When you use an HP-restoring spell in the round immediately after the hero landed a normal attack. Once per battle.
gear.SW28.effect: That healing spell restores an additional 5 party HP.
gear.SW29.name: Wildcat Hookblade
gear.SW29.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack and receives an enemy normal attack in the same round. Up to twice per battle.
gear.SW29.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy’s normal attack that round by 3.
gear.SW30.name: Lava Tongs Sword
gear.SW30.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack in round 2 with at least 3 MP. Once per battle.
gear.SW30.effect: Spend 3 party MP and increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 8.
gear.SW31.name: White Birch Sword
gear.SW31.timing: When the hero wins with a normal attack without using spells or items in that battle. Once per victory.
gear.SW32.name: Owl’s Night-Eye Sword
gear.SW32.timing: When the hero uses an item in round 1 and lands a normal attack in round 2. Once per battle.
gear.SW32.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 7.
gear.SW33.name: Fox’s Trickblade
gear.SW33.timing: Immediately after surviving HP loss from an enemy attack in a round when the hero guarded. Once per battle.
gear.SW33.effect: Restore party MP equal to the HP actually lost to that hit, up to 5.
gear.SW34.name: Briar Sawblade
gear.SW34.timing: When first using an offensive spell costing at least 4 MP while above half HP and at least 3 HP. Once per battle.
gear.SW34.effect: Spend 2 party HP and reduce that offensive spell’s MP cost by 3, to a minimum of 1.
gear.SW35.name: Night Dew Knife
gear.SW35.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack while both party HP and MP are at half or less. Once per battle.
gear.SW35.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage by 7 and restore 2 party MP.
gear.SW36.name: Spider-Silk Rapier
gear.SW36.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack in the round immediately after losing HP to an enemy normal attack. Once per battle.
gear.SW36.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage by the HP actually lost to the preceding enemy normal attack, up to 7.
gear.SW37.name: Sun-Dappled Sword
gear.SW37.timing: After the hero has used a spell in battle, on the first successful normal attack while MP is below maximum. Once per battle.
gear.SW37.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage by the party’s missing MP, up to 6.
gear.SW38.name: Evening Primrose Dagger
gear.SW38.timing: When paying for an offensive spell takes party MP from at least 1 to exactly 0 and that spell hits. Once per battle.
gear.SW38.effect: Increase the damage of that spell’s first successful hit by 8.
gear.SW39.name: Woodpecker’s Triple-Beat Sword
gear.SW39.timing: When the hero lands 3 normal attacks in one battle. Other actions may occur between them. Once per battle.
gear.SW39.effect: Increase the third normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 8.
gear.SW40.name: Mist-Clearing Blade
gear.SW40.timing: When an offensive spell hits in the round immediately after the hero guarded against an enemy’s powerful attack. Once per battle.
gear.SW40.effect: Increase the damage of that spell’s first successful hit by 8.
gear.SW41.name: Gate-Bar Sword
gear.SW41.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack on an enemy at three-quarters HP or more just before the hit. Up to twice per battle.
gear.SW41.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 6.
gear.SW42.name: Watchbell Sword
gear.SW42.timing: When you win by defeating an enemy telegraphing a powerful attack before that attack happens. Once per victory.
gear.SW43.name: Three Keys Longsword
gear.SW43.timing: When the hero chooses normal attack, guard, and spell once each in rounds 1–3, then lands a normal attack in round 4. Once per battle.
gear.SW43.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 10.
gear.SW44.name: King’s Pen Sword
gear.SW44.timing: When the hero’s offensive spell hits with at least 2 party MP remaining after its normal cost. Once per battle.
gear.SW44.effect: Spend 2 more MP and increase the damage of that spell’s first successful hit by 7.
gear.SW45.name: Redbrick Broadsword
gear.SW45.timing: The first time the party takes damage from an enemy’s powerful attack. Once per battle.
gear.SW45.effect: Its weight makes dodging harder: increase positive damage taken from that powerful attack by 3.
gear.SW46.name: Cobblestone Footfall Sword
gear.SW46.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack in the round matching the landing roll, from 1–6. Once per battle.
gear.SW46.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage to the enemy by 8.
gear.SW47.name: Princess’s Moon-Key Sword
gear.SW47.timing: When using an offensive spell costing at least 2 MP in the round immediately after guarding reduced an enemy hit to 0. Once per battle.
gear.SW47.effect: Reduce that offensive spell’s party MP cost by 3, to a minimum of 1.
gear.SW48.name: Water Mirror Rapier
gear.SW48.timing: Immediately after the hero’s normal attack deals at least 4 damage and the enemy survives. Once per battle.
gear.SW48.effect: Restore party HP equal to one-quarter of the damage actually dealt, rounded down, up to 5.
gear.SW49.name: Crown-Ringing Sword
gear.SW49.timing: When a normal attack drops an enemy from above half HP to half or less and it survives. Only the next round; once per battle.
gear.SW49.effect: If you land a normal attack next round, add 8 damage. If you guard instead, restore 3 party MP.
gear.SW50.name: Hundred Steps Dawn Sword
gear.SW50.timing: When the hero used normal attack and guard once each in the previous 2 rounds, in either order, then lands a normal attack next round. Once per battle.
gear.SW50.effect: Increase that normal attack’s damage by 9 and restore 4 party HP.
gear.AR01.name: Traveler’s Clothes
gear.AR01.timing: While equipped. Owned from the start.
gear.AR01.effect: Adds 1 to party defense. No additional effect.
gear.AR02.name: Straw Hat
gear.AR02.timing: The first time the party takes positive damage from an enemy attack. Once per battle.
gear.AR02.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from that hit by 2.
gear.AR03.name: Straw-Bundle Jacket
gear.AR03.timing: When receiving an enemy powerful attack in a round when the hero chose guard. Once per battle.
gear.AR03.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy’s powerful attack that round by 3.
gear.AR04.name: Herbal Apron
gear.AR04.timing: When the hero first uses an HP-restoring item in battle. Once per battle.
gear.AR04.effect: Increase the party HP restored by that item by 3.
gear.AR05.name: Honey-Colored Vest
gear.AR05.timing: When you win without the hero using any spells in that battle. Once per victory.
gear.AR06.name: Hedgehog Suit
gear.AR06.timing: Immediately after surviving HP loss from an enemy normal attack in a round when you chose guard. Once per battle.
gear.AR06.effect: Return 2 damage to the attacking enemy’s real body, or 0 against an invulnerable stance. This cannot reduce enemy HP below 1.
gear.AR07.name: One-Step Brooch Cape
gear.AR07.timing: When movement is confirmed with an adjusted roll of exactly 1. Once per turn.
gear.AR07.effect: Restore 2 party HP. Actual distance moved is not used for this condition.
gear.AR08.name: Hare Shoes
gear.AR08.timing: When the hero uses an item in round 1 and receives an enemy hit that round. Once per battle.
gear.AR08.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy that round by 3.
gear.AR09.name: Blue-Sky Greaves
gear.AR09.timing: When receiving an enemy normal attack while party MP is full. Once per battle.
gear.AR09.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from that normal hit by 3.
gear.AR10.name: Hill Warden’s Breastplate
gear.AR10.timing: When you win after receiving an enemy attack in a round when the hero guarded. Once per victory.
gear.AR11.name: Riverstone Vest
gear.AR11.timing: When the hero lands a normal attack in round 2 and receives an enemy hit that round. Once per battle.
gear.AR11.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy that round by 4.
gear.AR12.name: Umbrella Shield
gear.AR12.timing: When receiving an enemy powerful attack while party MP is 0. Once per battle.
gear.AR12.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from that powerful hit by 5.
gear.AR13.name: Waterbird Feather Robe
gear.AR13.timing: The enemy hit immediately after the hero’s first spell in that battle. Does not carry to another round. Once per battle.
gear.AR13.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy that round by 3.
gear.AR14.name: Boat-Plank Roundshield
gear.AR14.timing: Immediately after the hero guards against a powerful attack and the party survives. Even 0 damage qualifies. Once per battle.
gear.AR15.name: Riverside Blanket Cape
gear.AR15.timing: When confirming a free rest while equipped. Once at that inn.
gear.AR15.effect: Restore an additional 5 party HP from the inn rest.
gear.AR16.name: Tortoiseshell Boots
gear.AR16.timing: Just before HP loss is finalized when resolving a trap. Battle damage does not qualify. Once per space.
gear.AR16.effect: Reduce party HP loss at a trap space by 3. Loss cannot fall below 0, and remaining HP cannot fall below 1.
gear.AR17.name: Wave-Calming Cloak
gear.AR17.timing: When receiving another enemy attack in the round immediately after losing HP while guarding. Once per battle.
gear.AR17.effect: Reduce that hit’s damage by the HP actually lost while guarding in the previous round, up to 4.
gear.AR18.name: Lotus-Leaf Hat
gear.AR18.timing: Immediately after an enemy hit drops party HP from above half to half or less and you survive. Once per battle.
gear.AR19.name: Lighthouse Keeper’s Jacket
gear.AR19.timing: The first enemy attack received in a battle started at half party HP or less. Once per battle.
gear.AR19.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from that hit by 4.
gear.AR20.name: Whirlpool Armor
gear.AR20.timing: When you win after the hero guarded at least twice in separate rounds. Once per victory.
gear.AR21.name: Mine Helmet
gear.AR21.timing: When the hero chooses normal attack in round 1 and receives an enemy normal attack that round. Once per battle.
gear.AR21.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from that normal hit by 5.
gear.AR22.name: Sparkproof Mask
gear.AR22.timing: When the hero uses a damaging item and receives an enemy hit in the same round. Once per battle.
gear.AR22.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy that round by 5.
gear.AR23.name: Bellows Jacket
gear.AR23.timing: Immediately after the second of the hero’s successful normal attacks in 2 consecutive rounds. Once per battle.
gear.AR24.name: Pickaxe Pauldrons
gear.AR24.timing: When receiving an enemy attack while party HP is full. Once per battle.
gear.AR24.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from that hit by 5.
gear.AR25.name: Rockface Armor
gear.AR25.timing: While equipped, whenever the hero’s offensive spell hits. Once per spell.
gear.AR25.effect: Its stiffness reduces the damage the hero’s offensive spell deals by 2, to a minimum of 0.
gear.AR26.name: Magma Cook’s Coat
gear.AR26.timing: Immediately after surviving an enemy powerful attack that actually cost at least 6 HP. Once per battle.
gear.AR27.name: Echo Earmuffs
gear.AR27.timing: Immediately after receiving an enemy normal attack that costs 0 HP after reductions. Once per battle.
gear.AR28.name: Candle Hat
gear.AR28.timing: When confirming movement that stops at an inn or space 100 after fewer steps than your roll. Compare actual distance moved; once per turn.
gear.AR29.name: Knotted Safety Belt
gear.AR29.timing: When victory is decided with party HP at one-quarter of maximum or less. Once per victory.
gear.AR30.name: Mountain Heart Breastplate
gear.AR30.timing: When the hero guards in 2 consecutive rounds and survives the second enemy action. Once per battle.
gear.AR31.name: Mist-Spraying Cape
gear.AR31.timing: At battle start, if party HP is full and MP is below maximum. Once per battle.
gear.AR32.name: Horned Owl Round Hat
gear.AR32.timing: If an enemy attack in round 1 costs 0 HP. Only the enemy hit in the next round; once per battle.
gear.AR32.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy in round 2 by 6.
gear.AR33.name: Nut-Gatherer’s Apron
gear.AR33.timing: Immediately after the second of 2 different item types takes effect in the same battle. Once per battle.
gear.AR34.name: Mossy Wooden Shield
gear.AR34.timing: Applied in order only to enemy normal attacks dealing positive damage. Powerful attacks do not count. Up to 3 times per battle.
gear.AR34.effect: Reduce damage from enemy normal attacks by 3 the first time, 2 the second, and 1 the third.
gear.AR35.name: Night Spider Silk Robe
gear.AR35.timing: When using a healing spell in the round immediately after surviving an enemy powerful attack at half HP or less. Once per battle.
gear.AR35.effect: That healing spell restores an additional 7 party HP.
gear.AR36.name: White Waymarker Cape
gear.AR36.timing: When confirming movement after using a compass to lower your roll by 1. Previewing or canceling does not trigger it. Once per turn.
gear.AR37.name: Dormouse Sleeping Bag
gear.AR37.timing: If party HP is full and MP below maximum immediately before confirming a free rest. Once at that inn.
gear.AR37.effect: Restore an additional 5 party MP from the inn rest.
gear.AR38.name: Leaf-Turning Jacket
gear.AR38.timing: When an offensive spell hits in the round immediately after a successful normal attack, and an enemy hit follows in the same round. Once per battle.
gear.AR38.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy that round by 6.
gear.AR39.name: Root-Woven Shoes
gear.AR39.timing: Immediately after surviving HP loss from an enemy powerful attack without choosing guard. Once per battle.
gear.AR40.name: Forest Warden’s Tree-Ring Shield
gear.AR40.timing: When you win with a normal attack in the round immediately after the hero guarded against an enemy’s powerful attack. Once per victory.
gear.AR41.name: Gate-Raised Greatshield
gear.AR41.timing: The first time the party takes positive damage from an enemy powerful attack. Once per battle.
gear.AR41.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from that powerful hit by 7.
gear.AR42.name: Stonewall Cloak
gear.AR42.timing: When a spell or item restores party HP from below maximum to full and an enemy hit follows that round. Once per battle.
gear.AR42.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy that round by 6.
gear.AR43.name: Mouse Soldier’s Uniform
gear.AR43.timing: Immediately after the hero first chooses guard in that battle. Once per battle.
gear.AR43.effect: Restore 2 party MP per accompanying companion: 4 for 2 companions, or 0 for none.
gear.AR44.name: Royal Cook’s Apron
gear.AR44.timing: Immediately after the hero restores at least 2 party MP with an item in battle. Once per battle.
gear.AR44.effect: Also restore party HP equal to half the MP actually restored by the item, rounded down, up to 6.
gear.AR45.name: Cracked King’s Armor
gear.AR45.timing: While equipped, whenever the hero uses an HP-restoring spell. Once per spell.
gear.AR45.effect: Reduce the party HP restored by the hero’s healing spell by 4, to a minimum of 0.
gear.AR46.name: Lone Sentry’s Cloak
gear.AR46.timing: When receiving an enemy normal attack with at most 1 accompanying companion. Up to twice per battle.
gear.AR46.effect: Reduce damage from that normal attack by 6 with no companions, or 3 with 1. No effect with 2.
gear.AR47.name: Riddle Mirror Shield
gear.AR47.timing: If the hero uses 3 different action types in rounds 1–3, immediately after the third action succeeds. Once per battle.
gear.AR48.name: Clocktower Pauldrons
gear.AR48.timing: When you land a normal attack in the round immediately after an enemy powerful attack and receive an enemy hit that round. Once per battle.
gear.AR48.effect: Reduce the damage the party takes from the enemy that round by 7.
gear.AR49.name: Castle White-Flag Cape
gear.AR49.timing: When you win after the hero has used an offensive spell and guard at least once each. Once per victory.
gear.AR50.name: Hundred-Step Rampart Armor
gear.AR50.timing: When receiving positive damage from an enemy powerful attack while guarding. Reduction and recovery together activate once per battle.
gear.AR50.effect: Reduce that powerful attack’s damage by 8. If at least 1 damage was prevented and you survive, restore 3 party MP.
events.M1-01.name: Windblown Price Tags
events.M1-01.scene: The flower seller’s price tags have blown away and lie face down in the grass. Their backs show pictures matching the flowers.
events.M1-01.action: Tie the daisy picture to the white flowers and the violet picture to the purple flowers.
events.M1-01.result: Customers can now choose their flowers. The seller gives you 100G.
events.M1-02.name: Spilling Wheat
events.M1-02.scene: A thin trail of wheat is spilling from the cart.
events.M1-02.action: Lay the sack on its side, cover the hole with cloth, and secure it with a cargo rope.
events.M1-02.result: The cart can reach the mill now. You receive 160G from the hauling fee.
events.M1-03.name: Measuring a Scarecrow
events.M1-03.scene: A tailor wants to dress a tall scarecrow, but the measuring string will not reach its neck.
events.M1-03.action: Lay the scarecrow on soft grass and measure from shoulder to hem with the string.
events.M1-03.result: The tailor starts cutting the cloth and gives you 140G for helping measure.
events.M1-04.name: A Weight on One Side
events.M1-04.scene: The cheese seller’s scales tilt left even with nothing on them.
events.M1-04.action: Lift the left pan and peel the old cheese stuck to its underside.
events.M1-04.result: The pans balance. The shopkeeper gives you 180G.
events.M1-05.name: The Silent Service Bell
events.M1-05.scene: Customers are lining up at the egg stall, but the woman inside has not noticed. The bell cord is wrapped around a post.
events.M1-05.action: Unwind the cord and ring the bell where customers can reach it.
events.M1-05.result: The woman comes out. You receive 120G for getting the queue moving.
events.M1-06.name: Bread Marks
events.M1-06.scene: Three loaves look alike. Their bottoms bear wheat, fish, and leaf marks, and the delivery baskets show the same pictures.
events.M1-06.action: Gently turn each loaf over and place it in the basket with the matching mark.
events.M1-06.result: The delivery worker sets off for three homes. You receive 200G for sorting the bread.
events.M1-07.name: The Flag the Cow Hates
events.M1-07.scene: A red flag keeps slapping the cow’s nose, preventing the milk cart from passing through the gate.
events.M1-07.action: Hook the flag’s tip onto a high nail to clear the cow’s path.
events.M1-07.result: The cow walks through. Its keeper hands you 150G from the cart.
events.M1-08.name: Runaway Yarn
events.M1-08.scene: An unraveling ball of yellow yarn rolls across the yarn seller’s floor.
events.M1-08.action: Catch the loose end in the slit of an empty spool and wind it back up.
events.M1-08.result: You make a tidy ball of yarn. The seller gives you 130G.
events.M1-09.name: Footsteps of a Lost Shoe
events.M1-09.scene: One shoe lies in the road. Its star-shaped heel nail matches a single-footed trail in the mud.
events.M1-09.action: Follow the star marks and return the shoe to the traveler waiting by the fence.
events.M1-09.result: The traveler stands on both feet and gives you 170G in thanks.
events.M1-10.name: A Little Boat on the Stall
events.M1-10.scene: An empty wooden dish sits on the vegetable stall. Customers’ change rolls off the counter’s rounded edge.
events.M1-10.action: Place the dish in front of customers and hand over their change in it.
events.M1-10.result: No one drops their change now. You receive 220G for tending the stall.
events.M1-11.name: Rainwater in the Drying Cloth
events.M1-11.scene: Freshly dyed cloth sags, collecting rainwater in its low spots.
events.M1-11.action: Have two dyers hold the ends while you gradually lift the middle.
events.M1-11.result: The water drains without washing out the dye. The dyers give you 190G.
events.M1-12.name: Grass Nests for Eggs
events.M1-12.scene: The empty egg crate is too large. The eggs might knock together when the cart shakes.
events.M1-12.action: Arrange hay in rings inside the box, making a hollow for each egg.
events.M1-12.result: The eggs can ride safely. The poultry farm pays you 210G.
events.M1-13.name: The Sign the Wagon Cannot See
events.M1-13.scene: The sign at the fork is visible from the shop, but a tree trunk hides it from carts.
events.M1-13.action: Follow the driver’s signals and turn the sign to face the road.
events.M1-13.result: Later carts turn without getting lost. You receive 250G for guiding them.
events.M1-14.name: Clacking Clogs
events.M1-14.scene: A dancer stands in the mud, unable to make her wooden clogs ring out.
events.M1-14.action: Lay unloaded wooden boards on the grass to make a small stage.
events.M1-14.result: The clacking draws a crowd. The dancer shares 230G of her earnings.
events.M1-15.name: Festival Paper Bags
events.M1-15.scene: The sweet seller’s paper bags open at the bottom. The sample on the table has overlapping bottom corners.
events.M1-15.action: Overlap the corners, fold the bottom, and test it with beans.
events.M1-15.result: Not a single bean falls out. The shopkeeper gives you 240G.
events.M1-16.name: Blue Glass at Sunset
events.M1-16.scene: You need to match blue glass for an inn window, but the sunset makes every piece look red.
events.M1-16.action: Spread white cloth in the shade and lay the glass beside the color sample.
events.M1-16.result: You find the matching blue. The glass seller gives you 280G.
events.M1-17.name: Two Lines on the Lid
events.M1-17.scene: Two broken lines run across a wooden box’s lid and side.
events.M1-17.action: Slide the lid until the lines join and take the sword inside.
events.M1-17.result: Receive one SW02 sword from the box.
events.M1-18.name: Fitting Armor at the Grass Market
events.M1-18.scene: A tailor is looking for a way to fasten a long cord without letting it trail underfoot.
events.M1-18.action: Thread the cord through the loop, fold the excess inward, and tie it.
events.M1-18.result: The tailor gives you one AR03 armor piece used for the demonstration.
events.M1-19.name: Bundles on Either Side
events.M1-19.scene: Two bundles hang from a wooden horse. The smith says you may have whichever one you help fix: one contains a sword, the other armor.
events.M1-19.action: Choose a side to repair and tie its frayed leather strap.
events.M1-19.result: Receive SW05 from the sword side or AR05 from the armor side.
events.M1-20.name: An Oilcloth Scabbard
events.M1-20.scene: You want to load a bare sword onto a cart safely. A craftsperson points to a spare sword.
events.M1-20.action: Cover the blade with thick cloth from the tip, then tie it below the grip.
events.M1-20.result: Receive one SW08 sword to celebrate learning how to pack it.
events.M1-21.name: Clothes on the Drying Hedge
events.M1-21.scene: After the rain, the hem of some traveling clothes is caught in a hedge.
events.M1-21.action: Bend the branch to free the cloth instead of pulling the hem.
events.M1-21.result: The tailor gives you one spare AR09 armor piece for saving the clothes.
events.M1-22.name: A Gnawed Shipping Label
events.M1-22.scene: On a sack of wheat, a tiny swordsman uses the destination label as a shield.
events.M1-22.action: Slide the sack farther into the cart and face the swordsman.
events.M1-22.result: Fight Field Mouse Swordsman (EN01) in a normal battle. Win to tie a new label to the wheat sack. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M1-23.name: A Mound Beneath the Cart
events.M1-23.scene: The ground between the wheels rises, and a muddy suit of armor pokes out.
events.M1-23.action: Ask the driver to stop the horse, then face the foe emerging from the hole.
events.M1-23.result: Fight Armored Mole (EN02) in a normal battle. Win so the driver can move on. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M1-24.name: Unraveling Hay Labels
events.M1-24.scene: A bale of hay awaiting shipment starts walking. A tanuki with a grass shield peers out from the cargo’s shadow.
events.M1-24.action: Stop the cart and aim for where the grass shield is coming loose.
events.M1-24.result: Fight Grass-Shield Tanuki in a normal battle. Victory grants 140G and 10 XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no victory rewards.
events.M1-25.name: Red Ribbons on the First Load
events.M1-25.scene: Red ribbons with bells are being pulled into cracks in the ground.
events.M1-25.action: Follow the bells and meet the ribbon collector outside its hole.
events.M1-25.result: Fight Armored Mole (EN02) in a normal battle. Win to return the ribbons to the driver. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M1-26.name: The Barn Sieve
events.M1-26.scene: A sword tip pokes through a grain sieve from below, sending the merchants jumping back.
events.M1-26.action: Guide the merchants to the doorway, then stand the sieve on its side.
events.M1-26.result: Fight Field Mouse Swordsman (EN01) in a normal battle. Win to reopen the barn without injuries. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M1-27.name: A Visitor Beneath the Millstone
events.M1-27.scene: The supposedly stopped millstone tilts with a clunk. An armored back moves beneath its base.
events.M1-27.action: Move the flour sacks aside and fight the foe emerging from beneath the mill.
events.M1-27.result: Fight Armored Mole (EN02) in a normal battle. Win so the miller can return the stone to its base. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M1-28.name: Where the Bouncing Beans Go
events.M1-28.scene: At a bean sorter’s feet, beans keep disappearing through a crack in the boards.
events.M1-28.action: Slide a shallow basket underneath to catch them.
events.M1-28.result: Receive one combat item AT01 from the worker’s toolbox.
events.M1-29.name: Lark Alarm Clock
events.M1-29.scene: A lark tugs a ribbon inside a sleeping delivery worker’s bag.
events.M1-29.action: Hold the bag steady and move the ribbon to a nearby branch.
events.M1-29.result: The awakened worker gives you one travel item BD02.
events.M1-30.name: An Empty Bottle in the Grass
events.M1-30.scene: A ladybug is trapped in an apothecary’s empty bottle, unable to climb to the opening.
events.M1-30.action: Lay the bottle on its side and slip in a leaf to help it escape.
events.M1-30.result: The apothecary wraps up one recovery item HE03 for you.
events.M1-31.name: The Saddler’s Loose Drawer
events.M1-31.scene: You open a saddler’s drawer, and its handle comes off in your hand.
events.M1-31.action: Refasten the handle from inside and outside the drawer.
events.M1-31.result: Receive one travel item BD06 from inside.
events.M1-32.name: The Toppling Target
events.M1-32.scene: The square’s practice target falls backward when struck. Empty sandbags lie at its base.
events.M1-32.action: Fill the sandbags and place them on both sides of the stand.
events.M1-32.result: The target stays upright. Receive one sample combat item AT07.
events.M1-33.name: A Small Medicine Shelf
events.M1-33.scene: A parcel lies at the back of a medicine shelf. Reaching in might knock over the other bottles.
events.M1-33.action: Use the shopkeeper’s shallow wooden spatula to draw the parcel forward.
events.M1-33.result: Receive the recovered parcel: one recovery item HE09.
events.M1-34.name: Lunch on a Tree Stump
events.M1-34.scene: A baker splits a little loaf on a stump, urging you to eat before it cools.
events.M1-34.action: Take the steaming half, sit down, and eat.
events.M1-35.name: Clouds in a Teacup
events.M1-35.scene: Mint leaves float in the tea seller’s pitcher as steam rises slowly.
events.M1-35.action: Breathe in the aroma and sip the tea.
events.M1-36.name: Cotton for a Blister
events.M1-36.scene: Noticing your gait, a cobbler spreads cotton to fit the red patch on your heel.
events.M1-36.action: Take off your shoe, apply the cotton, and rest a while.
events.M1-37.name: The Sound of Beans
events.M1-37.scene: A child rocks a little wooden box of beans like the sea.
events.M1-37.action: Breathe out slowly three times in rhythm with the sound.
events.M1-37.result: The hero restores 2 HP and 2 MP.
events.M1-38.name: Swallow Eaves Inn
events.M1-38.scene: Swallow nests line the eaves. A map by the entrance shows resting places and shops.
events.M1-38.action: Pass beneath the nests and open the map at the storefront.
events.M1-38.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. When finished, leave through the door beneath the swallows.
events.M1-39.name: Scarecrow Jacket Inn
events.M1-39.scene: A dressed scarecrow points toward the dining room beside the shop.
events.M1-39.action: Open the indicated door and greet the dining room’s owner.
events.M1-39.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart and the owner sees you back onto the road.
events.M1-40.name: Four-Leaf Stable Inn
events.M1-40.scene: A four-leaf sign hangs on the horse fence, with long tables for travelers farther inside.
events.M1-40.action: Close the wooden gate, then choose your errands at a long table.
events.M1-40.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. When finished, pass through the gate to your next turn.
events.M1-41.name: Hill Weathervane Inn
events.M1-41.scene: Whenever the wooden bird turns on the roof, banners showing shops and beds flutter.
events.M1-41.action: Follow the banners into the inn’s yard.
events.M1-41.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart to resume your journey beneath the weathervane.
events.M1-42.name: Pay for Market Help
events.M1-42.scene: The soup seller asks how to thank you for tending the stall. A pay pouch sits beside a silver pot.
events.M1-42.action: After work, choose either wages or a warm lunch.
events.M1-42.result: Wages grant 150G. Lunch restores 7 hero HP.
events.M1-43.name: Comparing Lid Colors
events.M1-43.scene: The apothecary’s sample box holds one red-lidded combat item and one white-lidded recovery item.
events.M1-43.action: Point to the one you would like to try on your journey.
events.M1-43.result: Receive one AT04 for red or one HE04 for white.
events.M1-44.name: Watering a Rented Field
events.M1-44.scene: A farmer can save only one of two wilted rows today.
events.M1-44.action: Carry one full watering can to either the carrots or the herbs.
events.M1-44.result: Carrots provide stew that restores 6 hero HP. Herbs provide tea that restores 4 hero MP.
events.M1-45.name: A Seat at the Fair
events.M1-45.scene: A rest sign hangs by a cloth chair; a sample sign hangs over a standing counter.
events.M1-45.action: Rest in the chair or watch a travel-item demonstration at the counter.
events.M1-45.result: Resting restores 4 hero HP. The demonstration grants one travel item BD08.
events.M1-46.name: Helper or Passerby
events.M1-46.scene: A shipper stacking crates puts up a sign offering wages for unloading.
events.M1-46.action: Help carry the crates, or save your strength and pass by.
events.M1-46.result: Helping costs 2 hero HP and grants 240G. HP stops at 1. Passing changes nothing.
events.M1-47.name: A Cup for a Few Coins
events.M1-47.scene: A rancher’s daughter pours yellow bean milk into little cups.
events.M1-47.action: Pay 70G for a drink, or continue without buying.
events.M1-47.result: Buying costs 70G and restores 5 hero HP and 2 MP. Nothing changes if you decline or lack the gold.
events.M1-48.name: An Unraveled Cargo Rope
events.M1-48.scene: A log has shifted from a pile on a cart. A nearby porter raises a sign with a fee.
events.M1-48.action: Hire the porter, or push the log aside yourself.
events.M1-48.result: Hiring costs 60G. Pushing it yourself costs 3 hero HP. If you lack the gold, push it yourself. HP stops at 1.
events.M1-49.name: Downy Mud
events.M1-49.scene: Beneath white fluff lies mud deep enough to swallow a shoe.
events.M1-49.action: Retie your laces, grip the grass roots, and pull your foot free.
events.M1-49.result: The effort costs 2 hero HP. HP stops at 1.
events.M1-50.name: Rolling Copper Plates
events.M1-50.scene: A plate seller’s load tumbles, sending copper plates toward your feet. A nearby shop rents thick mats.
events.M1-50.action: Rent a mat to stop the plates, or catch them yourself.
events.M1-50.result: The mat costs 80G. Catching them costs 4 hero HP. If you lack the gold, catch them yourself. HP stops at 1.

scripts.events.M1-49.options.0.label: Retie your laces, grip the grass roots, and pull free (spend 2 HP; minimum 1 remaining)
scripts.events.M1-50.options.0.label: Rent a mat for 80G to stop the plates
scripts.events.M1-50.options.1.label: Catch them yourself (spend 4 HP; minimum 1 remaining)
events.M2-01.name: Harbor Queue Stones
events.M2-01.scene: People waiting for the ferry are also lining up in front of arriving boats. White and blue pebbles lie on the pier.
events.M2-01.action: Use white stones for the exit and blue stones for boarding, guiding people into separate lines.
events.M2-01.result: The two streams no longer collide. The boatman gives you 220G.
events.M2-02.name: A Loose Bottom Board
events.M2-02.scene: Water seeps through a round tub’s bottom. A slender pebble is wedged between the boards.
events.M2-02.action: Empty the tub, remove the pebble, and fit the board back into its groove.
events.M2-02.result: The fish seller can use the tub again and gives you 260G.
events.M2-03.name: The Upside-Down Flounder
events.M2-03.scene: One fish in a drying row still drips. A little tail also peeks out from behind the board.
events.M2-03.action: Separate the two overlapping fish and hang each in the sun.
events.M2-03.result: The fish dry evenly. You receive 190G for your work.
events.M2-04.name: Lunch over Swift Water
events.M2-04.scene: A shipwright across the river needs soup delivered. A basket and hauling rope span the water.
events.M2-04.action: Tie down the pot’s lid and pull the basket across while keeping it level.
events.M2-04.result: Lunch arrives without a spilled drop. You receive a 290G delivery fee.
events.M2-05.name: The White Waterline
events.M2-05.scene: Marks show where boats met the steps, but mud hides the water-level board.
events.M2-05.action: Ask the boatman where it is and wipe the board beside the steps, one level at a time.
events.M2-05.result: The boatman can read the current level and gives you 230G.
events.M2-06.name: Tickets with Washed-Out Dates
events.M2-06.scene: Spray has blurred the writing on the tickets. Today’s tickets also have a triangular hole at the edge.
events.M2-06.action: Use the triangular hole to collect only today’s passengers’ tickets.
events.M2-06.result: The ferry can depart. The ticket collector gives you 210G.
events.M2-07.name: The Bamboo Fish Basket
events.M2-07.scene: At a basket shop, a fish slips out of the sample basket placed in the water.
events.M2-07.action: Find the one bamboo strip facing inward and weave it back to match the others.
events.M2-07.result: The entrance barb closes. The shopkeeper pays you 310G.
events.M2-08.name: A Square Boat Awning
events.M2-08.scene: Passengers crowd one side of the boat for shade. The awning on the other side is still rolled up.
events.M2-08.action: Before the boat moves, untie and unfurl the awning.
events.M2-08.result: Passengers can sit on both sides. The boatman gives you 270G.
events.M2-09.name: An Upside-Down Picture Map
events.M2-09.scene: Visitors following a riverside map all return from the same dead end. Its bridge is on the wrong side.
events.M2-09.action: Turn the map around to align its bridge and landing with the real ones.
events.M2-09.result: New visitors can find their way. The map seller gives you 240G.
events.M2-10.name: The Sputtering Pitcher
events.M2-10.scene: Water shoots sideways from a stall’s pitcher when poured. A broken reed is stuck in the spout.
events.M2-10.action: Transfer the water to another tub and remove the slender reed.
events.M2-10.result: The water seller pours a smooth stream to test it and gives you 200G.
events.M2-11.name: Braces for Big Plates
events.M2-11.scene: Large plates clink against each other on a boat. Empty reed tubes remain on the deck.
events.M2-11.action: Cut the reeds short, wrap them in cloth, and slip them between the plates.
events.M2-11.result: Even the waves no longer make them clatter. The plate seller gives you 340G.
events.M2-12.name: The Midday Fish Shadow
events.M2-12.scene: A floating fish-shaped sign looks like a plain board when the sun is overhead.
events.M2-12.action: Raise its fin and secure it at an angle that shows its outline from the bank.
events.M2-12.result: Noon visitors can find the stall. You receive 300G in thanks.
events.M2-13.name: Whistles on Opposite Banks
events.M2-13.scene: Markets run on both riverbanks today. The closing whistles sound alike, so no one knows which signal is which.
events.M2-13.action: Ask one owner to give two short blasts and the other one long blast, then mark the signals on a sign.
events.M2-13.result: Each bank now has its own signal. The two callers give you 280G in total.
events.M2-14.name: The Three-Legged Teacup Shelf
events.M2-14.scene: A shelf for washed teacups tilts on the stony bank. One leg is shorter.
events.M2-14.action: Slip a spare flat shell under the short leg.
events.M2-14.result: The shelf is level. The tea shop owner gives you 250G.
events.M2-15.name: A White Island under Salt Sacks
events.M2-15.scene: One patch of the cart floor is white. The salt shipper wants to separate wet sacks from dry ones.
events.M2-15.action: Remove the sack that stood above the white patch and move the dry cargo to a high shelf.
events.M2-15.result: The rest of the salt stays dry. The shipper gives you 360G.
events.M2-16.name: The First Note of a Rowing Song
events.M2-16.scene: Boat passengers row out of step on opposite sides and cannot leave the bank.
events.M2-16.action: Sing the opening call and have everyone time their oars to its end.
events.M2-16.result: The boat rows straight out. You receive the singer’s share of 330G.
events.M2-17.name: A Parcel above the Ladder
events.M2-17.scene: A sword parcel without a delivery label lies on a moored boat’s roof. The shipwright is looking for someone to claim it.
events.M2-17.action: Have the boat brought alongside and collect it from the pier ladder.
events.M2-18.name: A Splashed Fitting Room
events.M2-18.scene: Water splashes the armor seller’s cloth partition, troubling customers trying on armor.
events.M2-18.action: Layer oilcloth on the wet side and secure its edges with clothespins.
events.M2-18.result: Receive one AR12 armor piece for helping with the fitting room.
events.M2-19.name: Decorative Boxes at the Bow
events.M2-19.scene: Two launch-celebration boxes bear raised pictures of a sword and armor.
events.M2-19.action: Tie a celebratory ribbon to the boat and open the clasp on one box.
events.M2-19.result: Receive SW14 from the sword box or AR14 from the armor box.
events.M2-20.name: Draining an Old Scabbard
events.M2-20.scene: A sword owner cannot drain water from the scabbard’s tip. A shell blocks its little hole.
events.M2-20.action: Leave the sword with the craftsperson and remove the shell from the empty scabbard.
events.M2-20.result: Receive one SW17 sword from the shop for helping.
events.M2-21.name: A Gap in the Gangplank
events.M2-21.scene: An armor seller’s cargo rope is caught in a small gap in the raft’s gangplank.
events.M2-21.action: Separate the two boards slightly and pull the rope free.
events.M2-21.result: Receive one AR19 armor piece in thanks.
events.M2-22.name: Claws and Ticket Clippers
events.M2-22.scene: Scissor sounds come from under the ticket desk when no paper should be cut.
events.M2-22.action: Move the customers back and turn toward the red claws emerging from beneath the desk.
events.M2-22.result: Fight Shallows Crab (EN03) in a normal battle. Win to return the ticket bundle to the desk. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M2-23.name: Wings Imitating Lanterns
events.M2-23.scene: One lantern at the night market moves from roof to roof against the wind.
events.M2-23.action: Before the stalls close, step into the empty square and face the glowing wings.
events.M2-23.result: Fight Glowtail Bat (EN04) in a normal battle. Win to leave only real lanterns at the stalls. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M2-24.name: The Fish Pen Gatekeeper
events.M2-24.scene: Huge claws block the shallow fish pen’s exit, stopping the transport baskets.
events.M2-24.action: Net the fish for sale farther inside, then confront the foe at the exit.
events.M2-24.result: Fight Shallows Crab (EN03) in a normal battle. Win to clear a place to lift out the baskets. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M2-25.name: Light beneath the Bridge
events.M2-25.scene: Whenever light bursts from beneath the bridge, porters mistake it for dawn and nearly launch their boats.
events.M2-25.action: Have the boats tied to shore and pursue the light beyond the bridge.
events.M2-25.result: Fight Glowtail Bat (EN04) in a normal battle. Win so everyone can wait calmly for the morning signal. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M2-26.name: A Second Lid
events.M2-26.scene: The food seller lifts a pot lid, but another red lid underneath is moving.
events.M2-26.action: Have the fire put out and lure the red, legged visitor onto the open floor.
events.M2-26.result: Fight Shallows Crab (EN03) in a normal battle. Win so the pot can be washed and the stall reopened. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M2-27.name: Light Leaking from the Storehouse
events.M2-27.scene: Red light sometimes flashes through a narrow crack in the fish-oil storehouse. Wings flutter inside.
events.M2-27.action: Open a doorway away from the oil barrels and face the foe flying out.
events.M2-27.result: Fight Glowtail Bat (EN04) in a normal battle. Win so the keeper can safely move the barrels out. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M2-28.name: Nuts in the Hull
events.M2-28.scene: Nuts roll along the bottom of a hauled-out boat, blocking the toolbox lid.
events.M2-28.action: Have the bow raised a little and catch the rolling nuts in a basket.
events.M2-28.result: Receive one travel item BD11 from the opened toolbox.
events.M2-29.name: Sea Breeze and Wrapping Paper
events.M2-29.scene: The wind lifts recovery-item wrappers from the counter.
events.M2-29.action: Place an item under the paper, wrap it once, then tie the cord in a cross.
events.M2-29.result: Receive the HE12 you wrapped yourself.
events.M2-30.name: The Fisher’s Belt Basket
events.M2-30.scene: A net-mending fisher’s belt basket comes undone, dropping a sample item onto the sand.
events.M2-30.action: Shake the sand off over the net and return the sample.
events.M2-30.result: Receive one spare combat item AT13.
events.M2-31.name: A Room in the Wind
events.M2-31.scene: Wind through the waiting hut’s window threatens to blow travel-item parcels all the way to the boats.
events.M2-31.action: Close the windward window and open the small window opposite.
events.M2-31.result: The shopkeeper gives you one BD15 from the goods you saved.
events.M2-32.name: The Reed-Whistling Apothecary
events.M2-32.scene: The apothecary whistles after filling each parcel but has forgotten to mark the last one.
events.M2-32.action: Move the parcel not yet announced by a whistle to the left side of the desk and await confirmation.
events.M2-32.result: Receive one checked recovery item HE16.
events.M2-33.name: A Box Picture behind the Waves
events.M2-33.scene: A craftsperson cannot find the way to open a box and hides the sample whenever a wave comes.
events.M2-33.action: Stand a little door panel against the waves and open the box with its picture the right way up.
events.M2-33.result: The craftsperson gives you one combat item AT19.
events.M2-34.name: A Tiny Bath for Your Feet
events.M2-34.scene: Outside the inn, a sailor lends steaming foot tubs to travelers.
events.M2-34.action: Sit down, remove your shoes, and soak your feet in warm water.
events.M2-35.name: A Seashell Echo
events.M2-35.scene: A shell seller holds a large spiral shell near your ear.
events.M2-35.action: Close your eyes and listen until the low, distant sound fades.
events.M2-36.name: Fish Market Broth
events.M2-36.scene: After the fish market closes, the master serves broth made from leftover bones.
events.M2-36.action: Slowly enjoy the warm fish and broth, avoiding the bones.
events.M2-36.result: The hero restores 7 HP and 1 MP.
events.M2-37.name: A Ceiling of Drops
events.M2-37.scene: In the shade by the ferry, raindrops fall steadily into a blue tub.
events.M2-37.action: Set down your pack, rest your hands on your knees, and count the drops.
events.M2-37.result: The hero restores 3 HP and 3 MP.
events.M2-38.name: Gourd Ferry Inn
events.M2-38.scene: Yellow gourds hang from the eaves, gathering travelers waiting for boats.
events.M2-38.action: Follow the gourds across the paving stones and open the inn guide.
events.M2-38.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart to pass the ferry queue and return to the road.
events.M2-39.name: Blue Net-Curtain Inn
events.M2-39.scene: Washed nets hang like curtains at an inn, where the fishing boss’s wife waves you in.
events.M2-39.action: Lift the blue net and approach the seat before her.
events.M2-39.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. When finished, leave at her signal.
events.M2-40.name: Water Clock Boathouse Inn
events.M2-40.scene: Beneath a clock fed by a thin stream sit a shop and a travelers’ meeting room.
events.M2-40.action: Walk around the water clock and read the guide at the meeting-room entrance.
events.M2-40.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart to resume your journey from the clock.
events.M2-41.name: Upstairs Boat-Plank Inn
events.M2-41.scene: Small boats occupy the ground floor. Travelers’ laughter comes through long windows upstairs.
events.M2-41.action: Climb the railed stairs and visit the upstairs desk.
events.M2-41.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. When finished, go downstairs to your next turn.
events.M2-42.name: The Shipwright’s Payment
events.M2-42.scene: For holding a plank steady, the shipwright offers either a pouch of gold or armor from the shelf.
events.M2-42.action: Choose ready money or something to wear for protection.
events.M2-42.result: Receive 260G or one AR16 armor piece.
events.M2-43.name: Two Pots on the Snack Boat
events.M2-43.scene: An open boat offers samples of round dumplings and shiso tea.
events.M2-43.action: Ask for either steaming dumplings or cold tea.
events.M2-43.result: Dumplings restore 8 hero HP. Tea restores 5 hero MP.
events.M2-44.name: Samples in a Scoop Net
events.M2-44.scene: Two samples float aboard the boat. You may keep whichever you scoop, but the net can be used only once.
events.M2-44.action: Aim for the red combat-item box or blue travel-item box.
events.M2-44.result: Choose red to scoop one AT18, or blue for one BD18.
events.M2-45.name: Payment for Oar Repairs
events.M2-45.scene: A boatman cannot stretch the leather wrap for an oar handle alone.
events.M2-45.action: Lend your strength, or simply wave a farewell flag.
events.M2-45.result: Helping costs 3 hero HP and grants 350G. HP stops at 1. Waving changes nothing.
events.M2-46.name: Broth Delivered by Boat
events.M2-46.scene: A canal shopkeeper simmers silverfish brought by the morning boat. A lidded takeaway bowl bears a price tag.
events.M2-46.action: Buy the steaming bowl for 73G, or return the reserved serving.
events.M2-46.result: Buying costs 73G and grants one HE20. Returning it or lacking the gold changes nothing.
events.M2-47.name: Resting on the Floating Pier
events.M2-47.scene: While waiting for the boat, you can take a sunny bench or a seat farther in where rowing songs can be heard.
events.M2-47.action: Stretch your legs on the bench, or listen to the boatman’s song inside.
events.M2-47.result: The bench restores 9 hero HP. The song restores 3 hero HP and 4 MP.
events.M2-48.name: A Wake beneath Your Feet
events.M2-48.scene: A large boat’s wake sends water spurting between the pier boards.
events.M2-48.action: Clutch your pack to your chest and wait behind a post for the water to recede.
events.M2-48.result: Bracing against the water costs 3 hero HP. HP stops at 1.
events.M2-49.name: Clinging Waterweed
events.M2-49.scene: Waterweed tangles around your shoes in a shallow channel. A nearby washing boat can lift you ashore.
events.M2-49.action: Ask for a ride, or untangle the weeds yourself.
events.M2-49.result: The boat costs 90G. Untangling costs 4 hero HP. If you lack the gold, untangle them yourself. HP stops at 1.
events.M2-50.name: Cracked Tiles
events.M2-50.scene: Wet tiles splash water and slip underfoot. A keeper rents walking boards nearby.
events.M2-50.action: Rent a board, or lean on the handrail to cross.
events.M2-50.result: Renting costs 100G. Using the handrail costs 3 hero HP. If you lack the gold, use the handrail. HP stops at 1.
