events.M3-01.name: Labels for Black Stones
events.M3-01.scene: Two black stones have the same price tag. The stone seller’s sample book shows white veins in only one.
events.M3-01.action: Wipe off the dirt and put the veined stone on the shelf matching the sample.
events.M3-01.result: The seller relabels the stones correctly and gives you 380G.
events.M3-02.name: A Red Flag for One-Way Traffic
events.M3-02.scene: An empty cart and a full cart wait at opposite ends of a narrow track. The flag keeper hands you a red flag.
events.M3-02.action: Show red to stop the empty cart, then lower the flag after the heavy cart passes.
events.M3-02.result: The carts pass without colliding. The hauler pays you 420G.
events.M3-03.name: A Letter under Stone Dust
events.M3-03.scene: White powder covers an order for the quarry, hiding the numbers from the master.
events.M3-03.action: Tilt the paper and gently brush powder from its folds toward the edges.
events.M3-03.result: The required stone width is readable again. The master gives you 310G.
events.M3-04.name: A Whistling Air Hole
events.M3-04.scene: Whenever the tea shop’s door opens, a loud flute-like noise sounds beside customers’ ears.
events.M3-04.action: Move the door slightly to find the noisy hole, then fit a round wooden plug into it.
events.M3-04.result: Conversations can be heard again. The shop gives you 350G.
events.M3-05.name: A White Egg among Salt
events.M3-05.scene: A little white egg lies among white salt chunks outside a shop. Its parent calls from a hollow in the roof.
events.M3-05.action: Place the egg on soft cloth and ask the shopkeeper to help return it to the nest.
events.M3-05.result: The bird settles on the egg. The shopkeeper gives you 400G for protecting the nest.
events.M3-06.name: The Tilted Hourglass
events.M3-06.scene: The break-time hourglass always stops halfway. A large nail head protrudes from its shelf.
events.M3-06.action: Move the hourglass onto a flat stone, turn it over, and check the sand flows.
events.M3-06.result: Everyone gets an equal break now. The timekeeper gives you 330G.
events.M3-07.name: A Swinging Sign in the Valley
events.M3-07.scene: Wind swings a sign into the restaurant wall. Nothing is attached to its lower ring.
events.M3-07.action: Thread a short cord through the ring and tie it to a post, leaving the sign a little room to move.
events.M3-07.result: The sign no longer reaches the wall. The restaurant pays you 390G.
events.M3-08.name: One Miner’s Lamp Oil
events.M3-08.scene: The seller wants to measure a miner’s daily oil, but the large bottle has no markings. A small measuring cup serves as a sample.
events.M3-08.action: Pour in one daily portion at a time and mark a thin line at each oil level.
events.M3-08.result: The bottle now shows quantities. The oil seller gives you 460G.
events.M3-09.name: Hot Stones and Bread Dough
events.M3-09.scene: Only bread at the back of the oven burns underneath. The baker points to the flat stones lining it.
events.M3-09.action: In the cooled oven, move the back stones forward to leave space from the fire.
events.M3-09.result: The next loaves brown evenly. The baker gives you 370G.
events.M3-10.name: A Spiral Stamp Order
events.M3-10.scene: The mason’s stamp prints a spiral facing the opposite way from the order’s picture.
events.M3-10.action: Hold the order up to the light from behind to show the mason which way to carve.
events.M3-10.result: The stamp matches the request. You receive 490G for making the guide.
events.M3-11.name: A Box for Stone Colors
events.M3-11.scene: Colored stone samples bound for town might mix in transit. Thin boards have slots cut halfway through.
events.M3-11.action: Fit the boards together at their slots to divide the box into compartments.
events.M3-11.result: The stones can travel sorted by color. The box maker gives you 440G.
events.M3-12.name: Wheel Ruts on the Slope
events.M3-12.scene: One of the two wheel ruts on a slope is deeper, always sinking the wheel on that side.
events.M3-12.action: Fill the deeper rut with gravel and level it with a board.
events.M3-12.result: Carts can pass without tilting. The merchants using the road pay you 520G.
events.M3-13.name: A Charcoal Thimble
events.M3-13.scene: A charcoal burner’s glove has a hole, leaving black circles on white product tags whenever they are pinched.
events.M3-13.action: Roll a scrap of old leather around the finger’s shape and slip it over the glove.
events.M3-13.result: The tags stay free of fingerprints. The charcoal burner gives you 320G.
events.M3-14.name: A Signal Lost in the Mountains
events.M3-14.scene: A stone-hauling line cannot see its leader around a bend, so stop signals never reach the back.
events.M3-14.action: Stand on a platform at the bend and raise your cloth whenever you see the leader’s white cloth.
events.M3-14.result: The whole line stops together. You receive 470G for relaying the signals.
events.M3-15.name: Comparing Bath Stones by Sound
events.M3-15.scene: A bathhouse wants uncracked stones. The sample note says to return stones with a dull ring.
events.M3-15.action: Tap each gently with the same mallet and place only the dull-sounding stones in the return box.
events.M3-15.result: The bathhouse accepts the sorted shipment and pays you 430G.
events.M3-16.name: A Small Mine Entrance Model
events.M3-16.scene: A model at the market should show the ore’s route, but its marble stops at a bend.
events.M3-16.action: Slip thin wood beneath the model until the marble rolls all the way to the exit.
events.M3-16.result: Market visitors can see the ore’s path. The maker gives you 550G.
events.M3-17.name: Half a Hanging Door
events.M3-17.scene: One counterweight has fallen from a workshop door, so it will not stay open.
events.M3-17.action: Have the craftsperson hold the door while you return the weight to its ring.
events.M3-17.result: Receive one SW22 sword from the back shelf in thanks.
events.M3-18.name: A Clasp Hidden by Soot
events.M3-18.scene: One clasp on a stonecutter’s armor is hidden by soot. Its owner searches by touch.
events.M3-18.action: Follow the black powder on the cloth and wipe around the clasp.
events.M3-18.result: The owner shares one spare AR23 armor piece.
events.M3-19.name: A Mountain Workshop Tour
events.M3-19.scene: One craftsperson stands at a sword-hilting bench, another at a bench for lining armor.
events.M3-19.action: Choose a bench and hand over a mallet or lining cloth at the craftsperson’s signal.
events.M3-19.result: Receive SW25 at the hilt bench or AR25 at the lining bench.
events.M3-20.name: Turning a Carrying Pole
events.M3-20.scene: A pole loaded with hanging swords strikes the rocks. The master notices another person-sized gap between the loads.
events.M3-20.action: Move the loads toward the pole’s center and tie them so they do not jut beyond its ends.
events.M3-20.result: Receive the last sample sword, SW28, from the newly cleared space.
events.M3-21.name: A Pattern on Red Earth
events.M3-21.scene: The pattern for cutting an armor elbow piece slips on the workbench. Marks at the corners show where stones should sit.
events.M3-21.action: Place pebbles on the marks and hold the paper while the craftsperson draws.
events.M3-21.result: Receive one AR29 armor piece for holding the pattern.
events.M3-22.name: Pickaxes in a Row
events.M3-22.scene: Pickaxes hanging on the wall slide into a line toward the mine entrance on their own.
events.M3-22.action: Ask the miners to let go and face the foe drawing in their iron tools.
events.M3-22.result: Fight Magnet Golem (EN05) in a normal battle. Win so the miners can reclaim their pickaxes. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M3-23.name: A Dirt Pillow beneath the Pillar
events.M3-23.scene: Soil piles around a vital pillar’s base, and the mountain shakes as if sneezing.
events.M3-23.action: Move everyone away from the worksite and face the foe emerging from the mound.
events.M3-23.result: Fight Armored Mole (EN02) in a normal battle. Win so the master can inspect the pillar’s base. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M3-24.name: Clinging Price Tags
events.M3-24.scene: Every iron price tag clatters onto an ore sample. The sample then walks off on two legs.
events.M3-24.action: Move the wooden stand aside and fight where there are no goods.
events.M3-24.result: Fight Magnet Golem (EN05) in a normal battle. Win so the merchant can return the tags to their shelves. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M3-25.name: A Tunnel into the Snack Box
events.M3-25.scene: The snack box remains closed, yet dirt crackers fly out from within.
events.M3-25.action: Lift the box and look into the hole beneath it.
events.M3-25.result: Fight Armored Mole (EN02) in a normal battle. Win so the miners can rescue the remaining real snacks. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M3-26.name: The Unhappy Compass
events.M3-26.scene: A compass keeps pointing at the same rock. When the rock stands up, the needle follows it.
events.M3-26.action: Return the compass to the guide and face the rocky body blocking the road.
events.M3-26.result: Fight Magnet Golem (EN05) in a normal battle. Win so the guide can check the true direction. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M3-27.name: A Mound Wearing a Sign
events.M3-27.scene: The writing on a sign slowly sinks into soil. Rounded back marks lead from its base.
events.M3-27.action: Show the porters a detour and call out the foe beneath the sign.
events.M3-27.result: Fight Armored Mole (EN02) in a normal battle. Win to stand the destination sign upright again. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M3-28.name: A Warm-Up in the Sand
events.M3-28.scene: A miner buries one combat item in a shallow sandbox as a pre-work warm-up.
events.M3-28.action: Use a wooden spoon to dig out the item beneath its square impression.
events.M3-28.result: Receive the sandbox sample, one AT21.
events.M3-29.name: A Walnut Shell Marker
events.M3-29.scene: The herbalist has two parcels. The recovery medicine’s cord bears a walnut shell.
events.M3-29.action: Hold the cord carefully so as not to crack the shell, and hand over the parcel.
events.M3-29.result: The herbalist checks it and gives you one recovery item HE22.
events.M3-30.name: Air in an Uphill Parcel
events.M3-30.scene: A cloth bag holding a travel item is puffed with air and will not fit in its box.
events.M3-30.action: Keep its mouth slightly open, press the air out from the bottom, and retie it.
events.M3-30.result: Receive one BD24 for helping pack it.
events.M3-31.name: Two Holes in a Hanging Board
events.M3-31.scene: An item-hanging board has a large hole and a small one. Thin cord slips through the large hole.
events.M3-31.action: Rethread the thin cord through the small hole and hang the board on the shelf.
events.M3-31.result: The seller takes one travel item BD27 from the board for you.
events.M3-32.name: The Forge’s Long Drawer
events.M3-32.scene: An item bag is caught on a leather divider at the back of a long workshop drawer.
events.M3-32.action: Insert the craftsperson’s long spatula, lower the divider, and draw the bag forward.
events.M3-32.result: Receive one combat item AT26 from inside.
events.M3-33.name: The Herbalist’s Reading Stand
events.M3-33.scene: The sample book keeps closing while the herbalist uses both hands to wrap parcels.
events.M3-33.action: Stand the book in a split log’s groove and secure its open pages with cord.
events.M3-33.result: Receive one recovery item HE30 wrapped by the herbalist.
events.M3-34.name: Steam-Potato Stone Oven
events.M3-34.scene: A mountain-pass stall steams potatoes with vapor from cracks in the rock.
events.M3-34.action: Take a potato split by the shopkeeper, blow on it, and eat.
events.M3-35.name: Crystal Shadow Pictures
events.M3-35.scene: Light through a crystal splits into fine colors on the hut’s white wall.
events.M3-35.action: Listen to distant work sounds and follow where the colors meet.
events.M3-36.name: Warm Stone at Your Back
events.M3-36.scene: A keeper spreads a blanket on one side of a flat stone warmed by sunlight.
events.M3-36.action: Lean back against the blanket and relax shoulders stiff from pack straps.
events.M3-36.result: The hero restores 8 HP and 2 MP.
events.M3-37.name: A Juicy Mountain Pear
events.M3-37.scene: The pass’s fruit seller chills juicy pears in a cool hollow.
events.M3-37.action: Accept a slice and moisten your mouth, dry from stone dust.
events.M3-37.result: The hero restores 4 HP and 4 MP.
events.M3-38.name: Trackside Bell Inn
events.M3-38.scene: Outside the cart tracks stands an inn with a round dinner bell.
events.M3-38.action: Take the footpath beside the tracks and open the inn register under the bell.
events.M3-38.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart to leave the Bell Inn and begin your next turn.
events.M3-39.name: Stone-Window Rest Stop
events.M3-39.scene: The mountain hut has beautiful blue stone window frames, with shop lights shining inside.
events.M3-39.action: Knock on the door beside the blue window and greet the guide.
events.M3-39.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart to leave the blue stone window behind.
events.M3-40.name: Kettle Rock Inn
events.M3-40.scene: Workers and travelers gather at an inn beneath a giant kettle-shaped rock.
events.M3-40.action: Follow the steam-shaped arrow painted on the rock to the near entrance.
events.M3-40.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. When finished, choose Depart to return to the mountain-pass road.
events.M3-41.name: Map-Covered Mountain Hut
events.M3-41.scene: Maps drawn by miners of old cover the log hut’s walls.
events.M3-41.action: Set down your pack beneath the large map and tell the attendant what you need.
events.M3-41.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart to shoulder your pack and start the next turn.
events.M3-42.name: A Reward for Test Strikes
events.M3-42.scene: The master offers two rewards for ringing a new mallet three times against the ore vein.
events.M3-42.action: Test the mallet, then choose wages or a combat item.
events.M3-42.result: Receive 410G in wages or one AT23.
events.M3-43.name: The Two-Color Charm Shop
events.M3-43.scene: The charm seller invites you to rest. Food sits beside the red stone and fragrant hot water beside the blue.
events.M3-43.action: Eat at the red table or breathe the steam at the blue one.
events.M3-43.result: Red restores 11 hero HP; blue restores 7 hero MP.
events.M3-44.name: A Mountain-Road Sale Sign
events.M3-44.scene: A large one-day price stands beside a sword picture. The craftsperson brings out a freshly sharpened sword.
events.M3-44.action: Buy the sword for 420G, or continue along the pass without it.
events.M3-44.result: Buying costs 420G and grants one SW27. Declining or lacking the gold changes nothing.
events.M3-45.name: Gift Boxes from Stonemasons
events.M3-45.scene: Two stonemasons hold little boxes, one for travel and one for recovery. You may take only one gift.
events.M3-45.action: Say whether you want to prepare for the road or for injuries.
events.M3-45.result: Receive one BD29 for the road or one HE29 for injuries.
events.M3-46.name: A Coal Cart Uphill
events.M3-46.scene: There is work pushing a coal cart uphill. The shipper also cuts fruit for those resting.
events.M3-46.action: Push the cart for wages or eat fruit in the shade.
events.M3-46.result: Pushing costs 4 hero HP and grants 540G. HP stops at 1. Fruit restores 5 hero HP.
events.M3-47.name: One Last Use of the Furnace
events.M3-47.scene: You may use the still-warm furnace once before closing. Herbalist’s soup sits in a pot, and sample-item materials lie on the table.
events.M3-47.action: Warm the soup or finish a combat item with the craftsperson.
events.M3-47.result: Soup restores 9 hero HP and 2 MP. Making the item grants one AT30.
events.M3-48.name: Pebble Beans on the Slope
events.M3-48.scene: A layer of round pebbles shifts beneath your foot like scattered beans.
events.M3-48.action: Crouch low and follow the rock-mounted handrail back to solid ground.
events.M3-48.result: Keeping your footing costs 4 hero HP. HP stops at 1.
events.M3-49.name: The Heavy Hanging Door
events.M3-49.scene: A door rope has come loose at the tunnel exit. The guard hut rents a jack.
events.M3-49.action: Rent the tool to lift the door, or support it with your shoulder and duck through.
events.M3-49.result: Renting costs 140G. Using your shoulder costs 5 hero HP. If you lack the gold, use your shoulder. HP stops at 1.
events.M3-50.name: A Rock Mouth Biting Cloth
events.M3-50.scene: Your pack strap is caught in a rock. A blue mark glows, opening the rock when given magic.
events.M3-50.action: Open the rock with MP, or pull the strap out by hand.
events.M3-50.result: The mark costs 3 hero MP. Pulling costs 4 hero HP. If you lack MP, pull by hand. HP stops at 1.

scripts.events.M3-08.puzzle.prompt: The sample shows 4 measuring cups of oil. With each cup equal to 1 mark, set the large bottle’s level to match.
events.M4-01.name: An Address Lost in Mist
events.M4-01.scene: The label says “red roof,” but mist hides the forest houses’ roofs. The shipper says a moon is carved into the doorway.
events.M4-01.action: Walk beside the cart to the eaves, find the carved moon, and deliver the load.
events.M4-01.result: The receipt is stamped. You receive a 480G delivery fee.
events.M4-02.name: A Menu in White Letters
events.M4-02.scene: The soup stall’s chalkboard is damp, making its white writing almost unreadable on misty days.
events.M4-02.action: Hang wooden food models below the board in the same order as the pots.
events.M4-02.result: Customers can point to order. The soup seller gives you 450G.
events.M4-03.name: A Voice Echoing at the Night Market
events.M4-03.scene: A caller speaking before a hollow tree hears an answering echo from another shop’s direction.
events.M4-03.action: Have the caller face into the shop and hang rolled thick cloth over the hollow’s entrance.
events.M4-03.result: Customers can follow the voice straight to the shop. You receive 520G.
events.M4-04.name: A Single Path for Drops
events.M4-04.scene: Drops keep falling from a large leaf onto the center of the map seller’s drawing.
events.M4-04.action: Hang a thread from the leaf tip to guide the water into a jar beyond the table.
events.M4-04.result: The maps stay dry and rainwater is collected. The seller gives you 410G.
events.M4-05.name: Mixed-Up Fragrances
events.M4-05.scene: Three boxes at the fragrant-wood shop smell alike. The boxes are separate, but there is only one sampling cloth.
events.M4-05.action: Take three fresh cloths and place one beneath each box.
events.M4-05.result: Customers can choose among three scents. The seller gives you 560G.
events.M4-06.name: A Round Picture of Tree Rings
events.M4-06.scene: The woodblock printer’s block has split in two. Circular growth rings continue across the two ends.
events.M4-06.action: Join the boards so the rings connect and support them while the craftsperson fastens them.
events.M4-06.result: Large pictures can be printed again. The printer pays you 620G.
events.M4-07.name: A Saucer for Honey
events.M4-07.scene: The honey press is low, spilling honey onto the soil whenever a jar is removed.
events.M4-07.action: Keep a small wooden dish beside the jar and slip it under the press during changes.
events.M4-07.result: Honey can be collected without spilling. The beekeeper gives you 490G.
events.M4-08.name: A Delivery on a Misty Night
events.M4-08.scene: A heavy box must reach another shop, but the white guide rope disappears in the mist.
events.M4-08.action: Tie several short black cloth strips to the rope so the porters can follow it.
events.M4-08.result: The heavy box arrives. You receive a 590G night-delivery allowance.
events.M4-09.name: The Forester’s Direction Cards
events.M4-09.scene: Visitors keep asking the same directions, so the forester cannot stop drawing maps.
events.M4-09.action: Turn the forester’s directions into picture cards for each fork and line them up from the entrance.
events.M4-09.result: Visitors can follow the route themselves. The forester gives you 540G.
events.M4-10.name: Leaves under One Pair of Shoes
events.M4-10.scene: Wet leaves cover the fitting stand, mixing up left and right shoes set on it.
events.M4-10.action: Sweep away the leaves and use spare boards to make stands for one pair each.
events.M4-10.result: Customers can try their size. The shoemaker gives you 430G.
events.M4-11.name: Eyebrows on a Mask
events.M4-11.scene: A smiling fox mask looks angry through the mist. The carver hands you charcoal.
events.M4-11.action: Stand back to check it and draw gentle curves over the overly raised eyebrows.
events.M4-11.result: Children now pick it up without fear. The carver gives you 500G.
events.M4-12.name: Dyed Threads in the Forest
events.M4-12.scene: Similar-colored threads under the dyer’s eaves are indistinguishable in mist. The maker uses different knots for each color.
events.M4-12.action: Feel for single and double knots and hang them on separate rods.
events.M4-12.result: The threads can be sold without mix-ups. The dyer pays you 580G.
events.M4-13.name: A Star in a Narrow-Necked Bottle
events.M4-13.scene: A star-shaped wooden piece is stuck in a sample bottle’s neck. One point is shorter than the rest.
events.M4-13.action: Lay the bottle down and turn the star so the short point passes through the narrow opening first.
events.M4-13.result: All the samples can be arranged. The woodworker gives you 470G.
events.M4-14.name: A Drawer of Red Berries
events.M4-14.scene: Wrapping berries in cloth crushes the ripe ones. A shallow drawer sits in the desk.
events.M4-14.action: Lay soft berries in a single layer in the drawer and put only firm ones in bags.
events.M4-14.result: The berries reach market before spoiling. The seller gives you 610G.
events.M4-15.name: Opening the Puppet Theater
events.M4-15.scene: One side of the puppet theater’s curtain winds up unevenly, revealing only half the stage.
events.M4-15.action: Remove the curtain rings from the rod, untwist them, and rethread them facing the same way.
events.M4-15.result: Two puppets can bow side by side. The troupe pays you 670G.
events.M4-16.name: A Black-and-White Exit Curtain
events.M4-16.scene: The forest market’s far exit vanishes after dark. The cloth seller brings broad black and white fabric.
events.M4-16.action: Sew a white exit arrow onto black cloth and hang it at eye level.
events.M4-16.result: Even evening customers can find the exit. The market organizer gives you 700G.
events.M4-17.name: Balancing Empty Scabbards
events.M4-17.scene: The sword seller’s rotating rack tilts whenever a sword is removed. Counterweight holes sit opposite.
events.M4-17.action: Have the seller steady the rack while you remove swords one by one and balance the weights.
events.M4-17.result: Receive the final sample sword, SW31.
events.M4-18.name: The Forester’s Fitting Mirror
events.M4-18.scene: A forester adjusting armor cannot see the back clasp in the mirror.
events.M4-18.action: Angle a small hand mirror beside the back to reflect the clasp into the front mirror.
events.M4-18.result: The forester finishes adjusting and shares one spare AR33 armor piece.
events.M4-19.name: Choosing a Workshop with Nuts
events.M4-19.scene: A long nut and a flat nut lie beneath an owl sign. The craftsperson points to the sample shapes.
events.M4-19.action: Put the long nut on the sword picture or the flat nut on the armor picture.
events.M4-19.result: The long nut grants SW35; the flat nut grants AR35.
events.M4-20.name: Raindrop-Pattern Sample Cloth
events.M4-20.scene: Thin and thick cloth overlap outside the forest tailor’s shop, hiding the sample stitching.
events.M4-20.action: Hang the cloths’ corners from separate branches so light reveals the seams.
events.M4-20.result: Receive one AR38 armor piece from the shop.
events.M4-21.name: An Autumn Letter around a Blade
events.M4-21.scene: A woodworker puzzles over a long parcel returned by the town smith. The outer wrap says to read the inner paper first.
events.M4-21.action: Without touching the blade from outside, first pull out the inner paper’s edge and read the message.
events.M4-21.result: The note says to give the helper one SW40 sword, which you receive.
events.M4-22.name: Customers That Do Not Add Up
events.M4-22.scene: Dumplings vanish, but footprints appear only behind the stall. A fox tail sways beneath a floating price tag.
events.M4-22.action: Move the staff away and call the visitor onto the open road before its tail disappears.
events.M4-22.result: Fight Mist Fox (EN06) in a normal battle. Win to recount the dumplings and reopen the stall. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M4-23.name: Strings Pulling a Stall
events.M4-23.scene: A nut stand rises as if fleeing customers’ hands. Thin threads stretch from all four corners.
events.M4-23.action: Set an empty stand beneath to catch the goods and face the foe in the branches.
events.M4-23.result: Fight Thorn Spider (EN07) in a normal battle. Win to display the nuts at their original height. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M4-24.name: A Tail Pretending to Be the Moon
events.M4-24.scene: A moon floats in a forest puddle at midday. A packhorse refuses to move, and the moon briefly becomes a tail.
events.M4-24.action: Back the horse away from the water and confront the foe beyond the puddle.
events.M4-24.result: Fight Mist Fox (EN06) in a normal battle. Win so the horse can cross the quiet puddle. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M4-25.name: A Hanging Clock
events.M4-25.scene: Threads hoist the market’s great clock into a tree, where a long-legged shadow hides the time.
events.M4-25.action: Clear the area beneath the clock and fight the foe above the threads.
events.M4-25.result: Fight Thorn Spider (EN07) in a normal battle. Win so the clock keeper can safely lower the dial. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M4-26.name: A False Guide
events.M4-26.scene: Wooden Shortcut signs keep appearing before the cart. Laughter comes from behind the last one.
events.M4-26.action: Check the real road with the driver and stand before the sign-holder.
events.M4-26.result: Fight Mist Fox (EN06) in a normal battle. Win to leave only the true fork signs. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M4-27.name: Thorn Lace
events.M4-27.scene: A customer reaching for beautiful lace stops short. Tiny thorns line its threads, and something waits in the branches.
events.M4-27.action: Move the goods beneath the stall and face the foe descending from the tree.
events.M4-27.result: Fight Thorn Spider (EN07) in a normal battle. Win so customers can compare the real lace. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M4-28.name: A Leather Bag on a Branch
events.M4-28.scene: As a loaded traveler passes, a branch thorn catches the mouth of an item bag.
events.M4-28.action: Press down the thorn with a wooden spatula and free the bag without widening its hole.
events.M4-28.result: The owner gives you one combat item AT32.
events.M4-29.name: A Stain on the Guide Horn
events.M4-29.scene: Rain-washed berry juice cakes the guide horn’s mouthpiece.
events.M4-29.action: Wash the mouthpiece with the keeper’s water and wipe it with dry cloth.
events.M4-29.result: Receive one travel item BD33 from the keeper.
events.M4-30.name: Wrapping with Silver Leaves
events.M4-30.scene: The forest apothecary wraps goods in silver leaves that repel drops. The veins face the opposite way from the sample.
events.M4-30.action: Turn the leaf to match and press the crease firmly with its stem.
events.M4-30.result: Receive the recovery item HE34 you wrapped yourself.
events.M4-31.name: Windmills without Wind
events.M4-31.scene: The wind stops on a misty morning, leaving the stall’s pinwheels still. Customers want to see how they work.
events.M4-31.action: Fan each in turn with a large leaf to show it spinning.
events.M4-31.result: Receive one combat item AT36 from the demonstration shelf.
events.M4-32.name: A Forgotten Box by the Stepping Stones
events.M4-32.scene: An item box floats in the stream. Its owner reaches with a pole from the far bank, but the box keeps spinning.
events.M4-32.action: Steady it with a branch from shore so the owner can hook the pole’s loop onto it.
events.M4-32.result: Receive one travel item BD37 from the recovered box.
events.M4-33.name: A Bird’s Glass Bead
events.M4-33.scene: A little bird holds an apothecary’s bottle stopper while resting above glittering ornaments.
events.M4-33.action: Place a spare shiny bead before the bird and wait for it to drop the stopper.
events.M4-33.result: The apothecary retrieves it and gives you one recovery item HE39.
events.M4-34.name: A Hollow-Tree Lap Blanket
events.M4-34.scene: Along the mist-chilled road is a bench in a tree hollow with a dry lap blanket.
events.M4-34.action: Clean the mud from your shoes and borrow the blanket to warm up.
events.M4-35.name: The Last Aroma of Forest Tea
events.M4-35.scene: Even after the tea shop closes, flower fragrance rises from a little iron kettle.
events.M4-35.action: Sip the owner’s last cup a mouthful at a time.
events.M4-36.name: A Room for Resting Ears
events.M4-36.scene: A forest instrument maker’s hut has a quiet room with soft cloth covering every wall.
events.M4-36.action: Close the door, take off your pack, and rest your ears.
events.M4-36.result: The hero restores 6 HP and 4 MP.
events.M4-37.name: Steaming Chestnut Porridge
events.M4-37.scene: An old woman on the misty road hands out porridge with tender split chestnuts.
events.M4-37.action: Eat the warm porridge, crushing the chestnuts with the spoon’s back.
events.M4-37.result: The hero restores 9 HP and 2 MP.
events.M4-38.name: Leaf-Window Tree Inn
events.M4-38.scene: Three leaf-shaped windows line the door of an inn surrounding a great tree.
events.M4-38.action: Call through the middle window and be shown to the desk.
events.M4-38.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart to walk around the tree and return to the forest road.
events.M4-39.name: Owl’s Evening Inn
events.M4-39.scene: In an entrance dim even by day, a wooden owl turns its head to greet travelers.
events.M4-39.action: Enter the doorway beyond the owl’s perch.
events.M4-39.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. When finished, leave through the door watched by the owl.
events.M4-40.name: Spool-Stair Inn
events.M4-40.scene: A spool-like staircase rises through the mist to a bright upstairs inn.
events.M4-40.action: Follow the handrail upstairs and open the guide board.
events.M4-40.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart to descend the stairs and start your next turn.
events.M4-41.name: The House of Two Candles
events.M4-41.scene: Two entrance lights mark the inn. One lights the shop window, the other the rest area.
events.M4-41.action: Enter between the lights and greet the owner.
events.M4-41.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart and head into the forest as the owner sees you off.
events.M4-42.name: Thanks for Carrying Honey
events.M4-42.scene: For delivering honey jars all morning, a forest shop sets out wages and a recovery item.
events.M4-42.action: Hold out your wallet or medicine pouch.
events.M4-42.result: Your wallet receives 530G; your medicine pouch receives one HE31.
events.M4-43.name: The Misty Postcard Shop
events.M4-43.scene: The forest postcard seller offers a bonus: an item trial voucher or admission to a listening hut.
events.M4-43.action: Take the voucher to the item shop or hear a rain-sound performance in the hut.
events.M4-43.result: The voucher grants one BD34. The performance restores 7 hero MP.
events.M4-44.name: Color Samples in Smoke
events.M4-44.scene: Two color-changing lamps glow at the night market. Green lights armor samples; yellow lights dishes from the tea shop.
events.M4-44.action: Receive armor beneath the green light or enjoy food at the yellow-lit seat.
events.M4-44.result: Green grants one AR37. Yellow restores 13 hero HP.
events.M4-45.name: Layered Fragrant Bookmarks
events.M4-45.scene: A fragrant-bookmark seller shows two books: one sleepy tale and one awakening tale.
events.M4-45.action: Lie down for the sleepy tale or breathe deeply while hearing the awakening one.
events.M4-45.result: The sleepy tale restores 11 hero HP. The awakening tale restores 3 hero HP and 6 MP.
events.M4-46.name: A Wayside Sign Lost in Mist
events.M4-46.scene: There is work lighting letters on a mist-obscured station sign. A notice says those unable to use magic may watch.
events.M4-46.action: Spend 3 hero MP to light the sign, or watch.
events.M4-46.result: Lighting costs 3 MP and grants 680G. Watching or lacking MP changes nothing.
events.M4-47.name: A Box That Chirps
events.M4-47.scene: The birdlike sound comes from a wooden whistle the seller blows behind a box. The seller turns its price tag outward.
events.M4-47.action: Buy the whistle for 136G, or close the box and return it.
events.M4-47.result: Buying costs 136G and grants one AT38. Returning it or lacking the gold changes nothing.
events.M4-48.name: A Vanishing Road Edge
events.M4-48.scene: Mist hides the narrow road’s edge, and one foot sinks into soft soil. A guide offers a rope.
events.M4-48.action: Pay to be pulled by the rope, or grip a thick root and climb back yourself.
events.M4-48.result: The rope costs 160G. The root costs 5 hero HP. If you lack the gold, use the root. HP stops at 1.
events.M4-49.name: A Branch Pinching Your Sleeve
events.M4-49.scene: Your sleeve catches on a branch ahead. Pulling raises tiny thorns.
events.M4-49.action: Stop and ease the sleeve back along the branch’s curve.
events.M4-49.result: You get free but lose 4 hero HP. HP stops at 1.
events.M4-50.name: An Overturned Lightstone
events.M4-50.scene: A path lightstone lies face down, blowing cold mist around your feet. A magic symbol marks its face.
events.M4-50.action: Send MP through it to right the stone, or protect your hands with cloth and push it back.
events.M4-50.result: The symbol costs 4 hero MP. The cloth method costs 5 hero HP. If you lack MP, use the cloth. HP stops at 1.

events.M5-01.name: A Long Queue at the Folding Door
events.M5-01.scene: At the morning market outside the gate, a queue reaches a folding door that would hit the person at its front.
events.M5-01.action: Mark the door’s opening space with a white line and move the front of the queue to the side wall.
events.M5-01.result: Goods can keep moving in and out. The market keeper gives you 600G.
events.M5-02.name: A Carriage’s Roof Ornament
events.M5-02.scene: A carriage’s feather ornament touches the gate’s height bar. The decorations fit into sockets.
events.M5-02.action: Remove only the top ornament that hits the bar and replace it inside the gate.
events.M5-02.result: The carriage enters without breaking it. The driver gives you 660G.
events.M5-03.name: Triangular Banquet Napkins
events.M5-03.scene: One place at the banquet table lacks silverware. Two spare triangular napkins are stacked together.
events.M5-03.action: Separate the cloths and put the spoon wrapped between them at the empty place.
events.M5-03.result: Every place is ready. The head server gives you 580G.
events.M5-04.name: A Missing Line in the Counting Song
events.M5-04.scene: A line is missing from the song counting flour sacks into the storehouse, so the total is uncertain.
events.M5-04.action: Recount the completed rows from the back and compare them with the keeper’s ledger.
events.M5-04.result: You find the omitted row. The keeper gives you 710G.
events.M5-05.name: A Blue to Match the Moat
events.M5-05.scene: An artist cannot choose blue for a picture of the outer moat. Paint samples are in sunlight, but the moat is shaded.
events.M5-05.action: Move the test paper into the same shade as the water and have the artist compare their blues.
events.M5-05.result: The picture’s colors are settled for copies across the kingdom. The artist gives you 680G.
events.M5-06.name: A Long Load at the Crossroads
events.M5-06.scene: A furniture seller’s large dining table cannot turn in a narrow lane. A square leading to the entrance offers diagonal room.
events.M5-06.action: Signal the carriers at both ends together to turn in the square before entering the lane.
events.M5-06.result: The table arrives without chipped corners. The seller pays you 800G.
events.M5-07.name: Red-Cord Invitations
events.M5-07.scene: Three sealed invitations bear bread, flower, and instrument symbols matching the destination shops.
events.M5-07.action: Walk around the square and deliver each to its matching shop without opening it.
events.M5-07.result: Collect three receipt marks and receive a 650G delivery fee.
events.M5-08.name: Round Seats by the Moat
events.M5-08.scene: Small spectators stretch behind adults to see a puppet show on the water.
events.M5-08.action: Lay low cushions in front and move the adults’ chairs behind them.
events.M5-08.result: Everyone can see the puppets. The troupe leader pays you 720G.
events.M5-09.name: A Chain on the Gate Model
events.M5-09.scene: A gate sales model will not move because its fine chain catches. One link is twisted.
events.M5-09.action: Lay the model down, straighten the displaced link, and return it to the little gear.
events.M5-09.result: The merchant can demonstrate the opening gate and gives you 740G.
events.M5-10.name: Room for a Stamp
events.M5-10.scene: An order for the castle is so full of pictures that there is no space for a receipt stamp.
events.M5-10.action: Ask the clerk for spare paper and fold it beneath the order like a narrow strip.
events.M5-10.result: The strip can be stamped and the order accepted. The clerk gives you 630G.
events.M5-11.name: Stone Steps Echoing the Tune
events.M5-11.scene: Music reflects from the moat steps, delaying the call to begin. The gate flag bearer is free to help.
events.M5-11.action: Ask for a white flag at the start of the piece so the musicians can follow a visual cue.
events.M5-11.result: Everyone plays together. The musicians pay you 780G.
events.M5-12.name: Powdered Sugar in a Crosswind
events.M5-12.scene: The confectioner’s sugar drifts onto the neighboring hat shop whenever it is sifted over pastries.
events.M5-12.action: Place the pastries and sieve inside a tall box, leaving only the front open.
events.M5-12.result: The pastries are finished without dirtying hats. The confectioner gives you 610G.
events.M5-13.name: A Round Shield’s Reflected Light
events.M5-13.scene: A tilted round shield reflects light from the opposite stall into customers’ eyes.
events.M5-13.action: Have the seller check from the customer’s position while you tilt the stand down one notch.
events.M5-13.result: The reflection points at the paving stones. The shield seller gives you 690G.
events.M5-14.name: A Sketchbook by the Stone Bridge
events.M5-14.scene: At the town art fair, passing feet obscure the view from atop the bridge. An artist unfolds wide paper.
events.M5-14.action: Trace the stone arch visible from the side steps and show how its lines connect.
events.M5-14.result: The artist fits the arch on one sheet and gives you 750G.
events.M5-15.name: Window Letters at Dawn
events.M5-15.scene: Two facing inns want their lit windows to form the character for “inn,” but one window is wrong.
events.M5-15.action: Compare the sample from the marked spot in the street and signal the window to fix with a white towel.
events.M5-15.result: The character becomes readable. The two owners pay you 860G together.
events.M5-16.name: Bread Deliveries across Town
events.M5-16.scene: Rain clouds approach while bread boxes for the town fill the square. Schools, workshops, and guards have distinct marks.
events.M5-16.action: Send school boxes through the covered passage, workshop boxes by cart, and guard boxes to the watch post, delivering every last one.
events.M5-16.result: All bread arrives before the rain. The market guild gives you 1000G for the big job.
events.M5-17.name: The Gatekeeper’s Matching Token
events.M5-17.scene: At the town armory, you receive a token to claim a spare sword. Its jagged edge matches a shelf token.
events.M5-17.action: Match your token to the shelf tokens and ask to open the perfectly matching shelf.
events.M5-17.result: Receive one SW41 sword from that shelf.
events.M5-18.name: A Second Step for Fittings
events.M5-18.scene: The tailor’s fitting platform has a high step. A wooden box underneath can be turned over.
events.M5-18.action: Place the box in front to make two low steps and guide customers up.
events.M5-18.result: The tailor gives you one AR42 armor piece in thanks.
events.M5-19.name: Taking Turns at the Armory
events.M5-19.scene: Two craftspeople simultaneously need help receiving loads at the sword bench and armor storage bench.
events.M5-19.action: Carry a load to the sword maker or clear the armor maker’s shelf.
events.M5-19.result: Receive SW45 at the sword bench or AR45 at the armor bench.
events.M5-20.name: A Sharpening Bench at Sunset
events.M5-20.scene: Sunset glare washes over the white paper used to check a blade. The craftsperson waits with the final sword.
events.M5-20.action: Hang black cloth beside the white paper so the craftsperson can choose a background to see the edge.
events.M5-20.result: Receive the tested sword, one SW48.
events.M5-21.name: A Plug beneath the Handle
events.M5-21.scene: An armor crate will not open before the outer moat. The courier’s diagram shows lowering the handle first.
events.M5-21.action: Lower the handle and remove the little plug hidden beneath it.
events.M5-21.result: Receive the last reward armor piece, one AR50.
events.M5-22.name: Dancing Suspended Scaffolds
events.M5-22.scene: Empty building scaffolds rise board by board in town. Thorny threads stretch from their corners.
events.M5-22.action: Move the workers clear and face the foe pulling the threads.
events.M5-22.result: Fight Thorn Spider (EN07) in a normal battle. Win so the workers can restore the boards. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M5-23.name: The Statue That Would Not Bow
events.M5-23.scene: While washing the statues outside the gate, one knocks away the brush with a wing.
events.M5-23.action: Move the wash tub away and face the foe jumping from its pedestal.
events.M5-23.result: Fight Rampart Gargoyle (EN08) in a normal battle. Win so the mason can wash the other statues. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M5-24.name: Footprints on Books
events.M5-24.scene: Black dots line a stationer’s new books. They are footprints from something descending on ceiling threads.
events.M5-24.action: Have the books boxed away and face the foe on paper-free paving stones.
events.M5-24.result: Fight Thorn Spider (EN07) in a normal battle. Win so the stationer can display the books again. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M5-25.name: A Rampart Spear and a Cart
events.M5-25.scene: A town cart stops abruptly. A kobold blocks the way with a long spear laid on the paving.
events.M5-25.action: Move the cart beside the wall and fight while watching the paving line pointed to by the spear tip.
events.M5-25.result: Fight Rampart Spear Kobold in a normal battle. Victory grants 640G and 47 XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no victory rewards.
events.M5-26.name: Threads at the Parade’s End
events.M5-26.scene: Thick threads like festival ropes wrap around the final stall and drag it toward the rampart.
events.M5-26.action: Help customers down from the stall and face the foe descending the wall.
events.M5-26.result: Fight Thorn Spider (EN07) in a normal battle. Win to return the stall to the festival line. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M5-27.name: The Upside-Down Bell Ringer
events.M5-27.scene: The bell should wait until night, but stone wings cling upside down behind the belfry and pull its rope.
events.M5-27.action: Have the bell ringer let go and face the foe descending to the ground.
events.M5-27.result: Fight Rampart Gargoyle (EN08) in a normal battle. Win so the real bell ringer can reclaim the rope. Receive XP and gold, with separate rolls for one equipment drop and one item drop. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.M5-28.name: A Hole for a Little Flag
events.M5-28.scene: Old paper blocks the hole for a little flag on the item market’s guide board.
events.M5-28.action: Push the old paper out from behind with a thin rod and set the flag.
events.M5-28.result: The market attendant gives you one travel item BD41.
events.M5-29.name: Sifting Retaining Rings
events.M5-29.scene: One round item lid has mixed into a smith’s retaining rings. It is slightly wider than the rings.
events.M5-29.action: Use a coarse sieve and give the lid left behind to the shopkeeper.
events.M5-29.result: Receive one combat item AT42 in thanks.
events.M5-30.name: A Message beneath the Medicine Shelf
events.M5-30.scene: The paper dropped under the medicine shelf tells the courier which item to take from the back.
events.M5-30.action: Place a mirror on the floor to read the picture and hand over the matching parcel.
events.M5-30.result: Receive one recovery item HE43 shared by the recipient.
events.M5-31.name: Paperwork at the Bridgehead
events.M5-31.scene: A paper box for a travel item lies flattened at the stall by the bridge.
events.M5-31.action: Press both side folds and raise it into a square until the bottom tab clicks in.
events.M5-31.result: Receive one BD46 inside the finished box.
events.M5-32.name: The Lookout before the Gate
events.M5-32.scene: At the town training ground, the sample-item signal can be seen only from the lookout.
events.M5-32.action: When the red and white flags overlap, call to the instructor to open the lid.
events.M5-32.result: Receive one spare training item AT47.
events.M5-33.name: A Medicine Jar in the Steam
events.M5-33.scene: The herbalist has no dry place for the opened jar’s lid. An upside-down teacup sits by the window.
events.M5-33.action: Use the cup as a stand for the lid to free the herbalist’s hands.
events.M5-33.result: Receive one recovery item HE49 wrapped by the herbalist.
events.M5-34.name: The Gatekeeper’s Bean Stew
events.M5-34.scene: Bean stew remains in a large pot, and the gatekeeper gestures toward an empty deep plate.
events.M5-34.action: Enjoy a warm serving and wipe the plate clean with bread.
events.M5-35.name: Starry Steps above the Moat
events.M5-35.scene: At night, lights reflected on the water sway like a row of stars below the stone steps.
events.M5-35.action: Sit on a step and trace each light with your finger.
events.M5-36.name: A Deep-Green Waiting Chair
events.M5-36.scene: A deep-backed chair stands behind the tailor’s shop. The owner sets a round footstool before you.
events.M5-36.action: Lean back, remove your shoes, and rest your feet on the stool.
events.M5-36.result: The hero restores 11 HP and 2 MP.
events.M5-37.name: Honey Baked Apple
events.M5-37.scene: The night-market seller drizzles a spoonful of honey over the last baked apple.
events.M5-37.action: Cool the halved apple and eat it with its sweet juices.
events.M5-37.result: The hero restores 7 HP and 5 MP.
events.M5-38.name: The Outer Moat Key Inn
events.M5-38.scene: A large wooden key hangs by the bridge. Dishes clatter in the inn beneath it.
events.M5-38.action: Pass under the key and read the guide at the desk.
events.M5-38.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart to return to the road along the outer moat.
events.M5-39.name: Windmill Roof Inn
events.M5-39.scene: A windmill on a roof below the castle turns, casting light on the inn’s entrance.
events.M5-39.action: Open the lit door and tell the owner what you need tonight.
events.M5-39.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart to leave and start your next turn.
events.M5-40.name: Twin Bridges Merchant Inn
events.M5-40.scene: An inn sits between two small bridges. Travelers talk beyond its cart yard.
events.M5-40.action: Cross the near bridge into the yard and check the inn map.
events.M5-40.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. When finished, choose Depart to return to the paving outside.
events.M5-41.name: Star-Window Waiting Inn
events.M5-41.scene: An inn’s star-shaped windows shine above travelers unloading before the rampart.
events.M5-41.action: Step under the awning below the star windows and approach reception.
events.M5-41.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions. Choose Depart, shoulder your pack, and return to the outer-moat road.
events.M5-42.name: Thanks for the Last Delivery
events.M5-42.scene: A parcel delivered to the gatekeeper’s home includes two pictures for choosing your reward.
events.M5-42.action: Show the gatekeeper the gold picture or the sword picture.
events.M5-42.result: Receive 830G for gold or one SW43 sword.
events.M5-43.name: A Snack Voucher before the Castle
events.M5-43.scene: Two stalls accept the merchants’ voucher. Fragrant blue tea pours beside steaming meatballs.
events.M5-43.action: Exchange it for a meatball skewer or a cup of blue tea.
events.M5-43.result: The skewer restores 14 hero HP. Tea restores 8 hero MP.
events.M5-44.name: Prepaying for One Box
events.M5-44.scene: Just before the item shop closes, one little travel-item box remains. The seller shows its contents and price.
events.M5-44.action: Pay 260G to take it, or leave it at the shop.
events.M5-44.result: Buying costs 260G and grants one BD48. Leaving it or lacking the gold changes nothing.
events.M5-45.name: Raising the Opening Flag
events.M5-45.scene: A large town dining hall needs help raising its opening flag. Samples are also available by the window.
events.M5-45.action: Pull the flag rope for wages or sit for a tasting.
events.M5-45.result: Pulling costs 5 hero HP and grants 900G. HP stops at 1. Tasting restores 7 hero HP.
events.M5-46.name: Supplies from the Town
events.M5-46.scene: Merchants have prepared a combat supply bag and a recovery bag for the hero’s onward journey.
events.M5-46.action: Say which you need and untie only that bag.
events.M5-46.result: Receive one AT49 for combat or one HE48 for recovery.
events.M5-47.name: One Seat by the Rampart
events.M5-47.scene: A guide and a healer take turns in a recess in the stone wall. There is time to meet only one.
events.M5-47.action: Ask the guide to show you an item or the healer to ease your shoulders.
events.M5-47.result: The guide grants one BD50. The healer restores 10 hero HP and 3 MP.
events.M5-48.name: The Screen Door’s Catch Cord
events.M5-48.scene: An open screen door by the outer moat swings back into your pack. Its catch cord is above your head.
events.M5-48.action: Call the gate attendant to release it from above or crouch and pull out the pack.
events.M5-48.result: The attendant costs 190G. Crouching costs 6 hero HP. If you lack the gold, crouch. HP stops at 1.
events.M5-49.name: A Scorching Stone at Noon
events.M5-49.scene: A mirror decoration on the rampart focuses sunlight onto one paving stone, suddenly heating your shoe sole.
events.M5-49.action: Step away and cool your sole in the shade.
events.M5-49.result: Jumping from the hot stone costs 5 hero HP. HP stops at 1.
events.M5-50.name: The Windy Wicket Gate
events.M5-50.scene: A headwind blasts through a small gate. Sending MP into a blue pillar mark weakens it.
events.M5-50.action: Channel power into the blue mark or grip the pillar and push through.
events.M5-50.result: The mark costs 4 hero MP. The pillar route costs 6 hero HP. If you lack MP, use the pillar. HP stops at 1.
scripts.events.M5-01.options.0.label: Mark the door’s opening space with a white line and move the front of the queue to the side wall
scripts.events.M5-02.options.0.label: Remove only the top ornament that hits the bar and replace it inside the gate
scripts.events.M5-03.options.0.label: Separate the cloths and put the spoon wrapped between them at the empty place
scripts.events.M5-04.options.0.label: Recount the completed rows from the back and compare them with the keeper’s ledger
scripts.events.M5-06.options.0.label: Signal the carriers at both ends together to turn in the square before entering the lane
scripts.events.M5-07.options.0.label: Walk around the square and deliver each to its matching shop without opening it
scripts.events.M5-08.options.0.label: Lay low cushions in front and move the adults’ chairs behind them
scripts.events.M5-09.options.0.label: Lay the model down, straighten the displaced link, and return it to the little gear
scripts.events.M5-11.options.0.label: Ask for a white flag at the start of the piece so the musicians can follow a visual cue
scripts.events.M5-12.options.0.label: Place the pastries and sieve inside a tall box, leaving only the front open
scripts.events.M5-13.options.0.label: Have the seller check from the customer’s position while you tilt the stand down one notch
scripts.events.M5-14.options.0.label: Trace the stone arch visible from the side steps and show how its lines connect
scripts.events.M5-15.options.0.label: Compare the sample from the marked spot in the street and signal the window to fix with a white towel
scripts.events.M5-18.options.0.label: Place the box in front to make two low steps and guide customers up
scripts.events.M5-28.options.0.label: Push the old paper out from behind with a thin rod and set the flag
scripts.events.M5-29.options.0.label: Use a coarse sieve and give the lid left behind to the shopkeeper
scripts.events.M5-31.options.0.label: Press both side folds and raise it into a square until the bottom tab clicks in
scripts.events.M5-32.options.0.label: When the red and white flags overlap, call to the instructor to open the lid
scripts.events.M5-33.options.0.label: Use the cup as a stand for the lid to free the herbalist’s hands
scripts.events.M5-05.options.0.label: Move the test paper into the water’s shade and compare their blues
scripts.events.M5-10.options.0.label: Fold spare paper beneath the order like a narrow strip
scripts.events.M5-16.options.0.label: Send school boxes through the passage, workshop boxes by cart, and guard boxes to the watch post; deliver every box
scripts.events.M5-17.options.0.label: Match your token to the shelf token and ask to open the matching shelf
scripts.events.M5-19.options.0.label: Carry the load to the sword maker
scripts.events.M5-19.options.1.label: Clear the armor maker’s shelf
scripts.events.M5-20.options.0.label: Hang black cloth beside the white paper to reveal the blade’s outline
scripts.events.M5-21.options.0.label: Lower the handle and pull out the little plug beneath it
scripts.events.M5-30.options.0.label: Read the label’s picture with a floor mirror and hand over the matching parcel
scripts.events.M5-42.options.0.label: Show the gold picture (830G)
scripts.events.M5-42.options.1.label: Show the sword picture (SW43)
scripts.events.M5-43.options.0.label: Exchange for a meatball skewer (restore 14 HP)
scripts.events.M5-43.options.1.label: Exchange for blue tea (restore 8 MP)
scripts.events.M5-44.options.0.label: Pay 260G for the little box (BD48)
scripts.events.M5-44.options.1.label: Leave the box at the shop
scripts.events.M5-45.options.0.label: Pull the flag rope (spend 5 HP; minimum 1 remaining; gain 900G)
scripts.events.M5-45.options.1.label: Go to the tasting seat (restore 7 HP)
scripts.events.M5-46.options.0.label: Choose combat supplies (AT49)
scripts.events.M5-46.options.1.label: Choose recovery supplies (HE48)
scripts.events.M5-47.options.0.label: Ask the guide to show an item (BD50)
scripts.events.M5-47.options.1.label: Have the healer ease your shoulders (restore 10 HP and 3 MP)
scripts.events.M5-48.options.0.label: Pay the gate attendant 190G to release it
scripts.events.M5-48.options.1.label: Crouch and pull out the pack (spend 6 HP; minimum 1 remaining)
scripts.events.M5-49.options.0.label: Leave the hot stone and cool your soles in the shade (spend 5 HP; minimum 1 remaining)
scripts.events.M5-50.options.0.label: Channel power into the blue mark (spend 4 MP)
scripts.events.M5-50.options.1.label: Grip the pillar and push through the wind (spend 6 HP; minimum 1 remaining)
scripts.events.M5-15.puzzle.prompt: Compare the sample with the current windows and choose one window whose light needs changing.
scripts.events.M1-02.puzzle.labels.layBa: Lay the sack on its side
scripts.events.M1-02.puzzle.labels.tieRo: Secure it with a cargo rope
events.F1-01.name: Check the Hoof First
events.F1-01.scene: A camp packhorse holds up only its right hind foot. Its loose horseshoe still has two usable nail holes.
events.F1-01.action: Support the right hind hoof and drive nails into the empty holes.
events.F1-01.result: The horseshoe holds. The horse handler pays you 180G.
events.F1-02.name: A Stamp among the Sparks
events.F1-02.scene: A scale seller drops scrap iron and coins into the same pan. The stamped pieces are round and do not stick to a magnet.
events.F1-02.action: Lift only the iron with a magnet, then count the remaining round pieces.
events.F1-02.result: Return the bag and receive your share of 240G.
events.F1-03.name: The Windmill’s Split Pin
events.F1-03.scene: Only the mill’s sails turn; a fastener is slipping from the axle’s end.
events.F1-03.action: Stop the sails and spread the fastener’s tip into two prongs.
events.F1-03.result: The axle turns and starts grinding wheat. The miller pays you 320G.
events.F1-04.name: Tuning Two Bells
events.F1-04.scene: A shepherd’s two sheep wear bells with the same note. At dusk, the shepherd wants to count them by sound alone.
events.F1-04.action: Shorten one bell’s clapper and compare their ringing.
events.F1-04.result: The shepherd can distinguish the two and pays you 160G.
events.F1-05.name: A Loosening Handle
events.F1-05.scene: When the hot-water seller tilts the kettle, its wire handle turns outward and nearly slips free.
events.F1-05.action: Bend both ends inward, then test with water.
events.F1-05.result: The kettle can be carried one-handed. The seller gives you 210G.
events.F1-06.name: The First Glow of the Forge
events.F1-06.scene: Dark iron and glowing red iron sit in an apprentice’s furnace. The master offers a hammer, saying red iron can be worked.
events.F1-06.action: Hammer the red iron or return the dark iron to the furnace.
events.F1-06.result: Hammering grants the finished SW05. Returning the iron ends your help without a reward.
events.F1-07.name: A Cutting Test Bench
events.F1-07.scene: Dry rope and fresh grass sit on a test bench. The sharpener lays out a pull-cutting blade and a push-cutting blade.
events.F1-07.action: Pull-cut the dry rope or push-cut the fresh grass.
events.F1-07.result: Rope grants SW02; grass grants SW03. Take home only the one you tested.
events.F1-08.name: A Loose Wooden Grip
events.F1-08.scene: A loan sword’s grip shifts when swung. Two wedges of different thickness lie on the bench.
events.F1-08.action: Insert the thin wedge fully or press the thick wedge against the opening.
events.F1-08.result: The thin wedge secures the grip and grants SW04. The thick one will not fit; continue without receiving it.
events.F1-09.name: Striking in Turn at the Small Forge
events.F1-09.scene: The master raises the hammer after each blow to show the apprentice where to strike. Help is needed for the last three blows.
events.F1-09.action: Take the three assisting strikes or watch the finishing work.
events.F1-09.result: Helping costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants SW05. Watching changes nothing.
events.F1-10.name: A Sword Belt for Low Gates
events.F1-10.scene: A traveler’s scabbard catches the crossbar of each low pasture gate. The belt seller prepares a shorter hanger.
events.F1-10.action: Fit the hanger on the fitting stand and buy it with the sword for 280G, or decline.
events.F1-10.result: Buying costs 280G and grants SW06. Declining or lacking the gold changes nothing.
events.F1-11.name: Blades Covered in Morning Dew
events.F1-11.scene: Two prototypes drying outside the barn are covered in dew. Each early visitor may wipe only one.
events.F1-11.action: Wipe the long one with cloth or wrap the short one in oilcloth.
events.F1-11.result: The long one grants SW07; the short one grants SW08. The other stays at the workshop.
events.F1-12.name: A Loose Grinding Wheel
events.F1-12.scene: The grinding stone lifts from its axle while the treadle spins uselessly. A nearby craftsperson offers paid sharpening.
events.F1-12.action: Repair the axle and sharpen it yourself, or pay 90G for help.
events.F1-12.result: Helping costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants SW09. Hiring costs 90G and grants SW09. You can help even without enough gold.
events.F1-13.name: Two Departure Bags
events.F1-13.scene: The village forge gives departing travelers either a blade or protection. The bags differ in weight.
events.F1-13.action: Sign for either the blade bag or the protective gear bag.
events.F1-13.result: Choose the blade for SW10 or protection for AR09. The unsigned bag remains.
events.F1-14.name: Which Way the Lining Faces
events.F1-14.scene: An armor prototype has rough leather facing inward, scraping the arm. Its seam is not closed yet.
events.F1-14.action: Turn the leather smooth-side toward the skin and sew the edge.
events.F1-14.result: The lining is comfortable. Receive AR02 for helping.
events.F1-15.name: Marks for Overlapping Holes
events.F1-15.scene: Two identical fittings sit on the punch bench. Punching them separately would misalign the fastener.
events.F1-15.action: Stack and punch them together, or punch each by eye.
events.F1-15.result: Stacking lets the fastener pass and grants AR03. Separately, return only the test plate; nothing changes.
events.F1-16.name: Wool Edging
events.F1-16.scene: A craftsperson combs a handful of soft wool from a sheep crossing the fence. The fitting armor’s neck edge is hard.
events.F1-16.action: Sew wool around the neck or first pad the inner elbow.
events.F1-16.result: Finishing the neck grants AR04; finishing the elbow grants AR05. Receive only one.
events.F1-17.name: A One-Handed Fastener
events.F1-17.scene: A villager holding a hoe needs a fastener that closes one-handed. A ring and leather cord lie on the desk.
events.F1-17.action: Double the cord back through the ring and pull with only your free hand.
events.F1-17.result: Teach the villager how it fastens and receive the sample armor AR06.
events.F1-18.name: A Muddy Fitting Area
events.F1-18.scene: A traveler’s gear is muddy after crossing a stream. The polishing bench has a water tub and a quick-service price sign.
events.F1-18.action: Fetch water and polish it yourself, or pay the polisher 100G.
events.F1-18.result: Doing it yourself costs 1 HP (minimum 1 remaining); hiring costs 100G. Either grants AR07. If short of gold, you can polish it yourself.
events.F1-19.name: The Blue-Thread Opening
events.F1-19.scene: Blue thread on an old armor bag says “unravel here.” Red thread secures the padding.
events.F1-19.action: Pull the blue loop or try the red knot.
events.F1-19.result: Blue grants the AR08 inside. For red, the craftsperson stops you; return the whole bag and finish.
events.F1-20.name: The Forge Keeper’s First-Aid Box
events.F1-20.scene: The communal forge seeks healing supplies. Donors receive one traveler’s armor piece.
events.F1-20.action: Donate one held HE02, donate 150G toward the shortage, or decline.
events.F1-20.result: Giving one HE02 or paying 150G grants AR09. Giving neither changes nothing.
events.F1-21.name: The Scythe Barn
events.F1-21.scene: The keeper of the scythe store has two keys. You may open one shelf as a departure gift.
events.F1-21.action: Choose the sword-marked key or the breastplate-marked key.
events.F1-21.result: The sword mark grants SW03; the breastplate grants AR10. The other shelf stays locked.
events.F1-22.name: A Cut in the Wheat Sack
events.F1-22.scene: Field Mouse Swordsman cuts the wheat sacks’ seams one by one. A sack stood on the bench will open with one more slash.
events.F1-22.action: Stand a wheat sack between you and the enemy, or move it aside and fight head-on.
events.F1-22.result: Fight EN01. With the sack standing, guard on your first turn to split it; wheat tangles the enemy’s feet and adds 3 damage to the next hero normal attack it receives. Otherwise, battle proceeds normally. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F1-23.name: An Anvil on a Molehill
events.F1-23.scene: Armored Mole thrusts up beneath a makeshift anvil. Upright it forms a wall; laid flat it becomes a striking surface.
events.F1-23.action: Stand the anvil up for cover or lay it flat and ready your sword.
events.F1-23.result: Fight EN02. Standing reduces the first direct hit you receive by 3. Flat adds 2 damage only if your first-turn normal attack hits. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F1-24.name: A Duel beside the Straw
events.F1-24.scene: A tiny swordsman asks for a duel to the right of a straw pile. To the left, Armored Mole’s back rises from the earth.
events.F1-24.action: Face the swordsman or drive the mole from the straw.
events.F1-24.result: Fight one normal battle: EN01 on the right or EN02 on the left. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F1-25.name: A Hole in the Treadle Bellows
events.F1-25.scene: The bellows’ bottom board bulges. Armored Mole is beneath it. You can still cover the exposed air vent with a board.
events.F1-25.action: Cover the vent to leave one soil exit, or call the mole through the middle hole.
events.F1-25.result: Fight EN02. If you place the board and guard on your first turn, deflect the upward jolt and reduce that turn’s first direct hit to 0. Calling it through the middle gives a normal battle. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F1-26.name: The Bent Scythe
events.F1-26.scene: Field Mouse Swordsman blocks the field path with a stolen scythe. A farmer opens a little frontline supply stall to help catch it quickly.
events.F1-26.action: Buy one HE01 for 20G before chasing, or chase without buying.
events.F1-26.result: Buying costs 20G and grants one HE01. Whether you buy, decline, or cannot afford it, then fight EN01. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F1-27.name: The Ringing Empty Helmet
events.F1-27.scene: A drying helmet moves into the grass. Armored Mole is wearing it from inside. You can skirt past beside the road.
events.F1-27.action: Step forward to reclaim it or slip past.
events.F1-27.result: Stepping forward starts a normal battle against EN02. Slipping past gives no battle or reward. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F1-28.name: The Charcoal Hut’s Fire Watch
events.F1-28.scene: Field Mouse Swordsman hides in an unlit charcoal hut. The keeper’s lamp can light the floor but occupies one hand.
events.F1-28.action: Carry the lamp or leave it in the doorway and fight.
events.F1-28.result: Fight EN01. Carrying the lamp reduces first-turn normal attack damage by 2 (minimum 0) and reduces the enemy’s first direct hit that turn by 4. Leaving it at the door keeps both unchanged. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F1-29.name: Portioning Spent Charcoal
events.F1-29.scene: The forge keeper packs charcoal into small bags. Supplies are divided into combat and travel gear.
events.F1-29.action: Tie the charcoal bags and choose combat or travel supplies as thanks.
events.F1-29.result: Receive one AT02 for combat or one BD01 for travel.
events.F1-30.name: A First-Aid Bag’s Double Bottom
events.F1-30.scene: The lining of a seamstress’s first-aid bag lifts, revealing two spare parcels. She offers whichever you need.
events.F1-30.action: Choose HE03 on the left or HE04 on the right, returning the other.
events.F1-30.result: Receive one chosen HE03 or HE04.
events.F1-31.name: A Wheel Stop for the Ox Cart
events.F1-31.scene: A cart shifts on a slope. The item seller searches for wood; a triangular wedge and round rod lie nearby.
events.F1-31.action: Place the wedge against the wheel or insert the round rod.
events.F1-31.result: The wedge stops the cart and grants one BD02 in thanks. The driver stops you from using the rod; nothing changes.
events.F1-32.name: The Forge Exchange Basket
events.F1-32.scene: A sealed combat item sits in the forge exchange basket. Its sign requests travel item BD03 in exchange.
events.F1-32.action: Hand over one held BD03 or keep it.
events.F1-32.result: Giving one BD03 consumes it and grants one AT03. Lacking it or declining changes nothing.
events.F1-33.name: A Signpost Protecting Saplings
events.F1-33.scene: A child holds a signpost to keep carts away from newly planted trees. Travel supplies lie at its base.
events.F1-33.action: Check both directions, drive in the post, and accept supplies if you have room to carry them.
events.F1-33.result: Accept to receive one BD04. Decline to leave after setting the post.
events.F1-34.name: Duty at the Drying Rack
events.F1-34.scene: First-aid bags dry behind the forge. Extra stock costs the shop price, but clearing the rack waives the fee.
events.F1-34.action: Clear the rack or pay 36G to receive an item immediately.
events.F1-34.result: Clearing costs 1 HP (minimum 1 remaining); immediate collection costs 36G. Either grants one HE05. If short of gold, you can clear the rack.
events.F1-35.name: The Bellows Keeper’s Morning Porridge
events.F1-35.scene: The forge keeper finishes the night watch and takes down a porridge pot. A little bread and mint water remain, one portion each.
events.F1-35.action: Dip the bread and eat, or slowly drink the mint water.
events.F1-35.result: Bread porridge restores 6 HP; mint water restores 3 MP.
events.F1-36.name: Water Duty and Handwashing
events.F1-36.scene: The water keeper pours a thin stream of meadow spring water over fingers stiff from sparks.
events.F1-36.action: Cool your hands and wrap your fingers in cloth.
events.F1-37.name: Waiting for Wind in the Shade
events.F1-37.scene: Wind is too strong to light the grassland forge. The craftsperson lowers their pack.
events.F1-37.action: Set down your load and nap, or steady your breathing to the wind.
events.F1-37.result: Napping restores 4 HP and 1 MP. Breathing restores 4 MP.
events.F1-38.name: A Still-Warm Furnace Wall
events.F1-38.scene: Last night’s heat lingers in the morning furnace wall, relaxing cold shoulders when you lean against it.
events.F1-38.action: Warm yourself for free or add the keeper’s hot meal for 60G.
events.F1-38.result: The wall alone restores 3 HP. The meal costs 60G and restores 8 HP. You can warm up free if short of gold.
events.F1-39.name: Horseshoe Thatch Inn
events.F1-39.scene: A saddler and caravan dining table share an inn with a great horseshoe hanging from its roof.
events.F1-39.action: Pass the hitching posts to the desk and choose a facility. You may also borrow the saddler’s rack.
events.F1-39.result: Rest at the table, shop at the saddler’s, change jobs at the desk, and recruit at the caravan seats. At the rack, choose up to 2 owned swords to compare their extra normal-attack effects using your current attack.
events.F1-40.name: The Red Bellows Communal Forge
events.F1-40.scene: In a former smithy with red bellows, forge keepers and travelers share one long table.
events.F1-40.action: Visit the hearth, sales shelf, job notices, or shared seats. You can also open the master’s delivery ledger.
events.F1-40.result: Rest at the hearth, shop at the shelf, change jobs at the notices, and recruit at shared seats. The ledger shows the first equipment space ahead in this region, or “No deliveries scheduled” if none remain.
events.F1-41.name: Board-Bell Grassland Inn
events.F1-41.scene: Four tags on the entrance bell read Beds, Goods, Work, and Company.
events.F1-41.action: Ring the tag you want and follow the attendant. You can also help ring the evening bell.
events.F1-41.result: Rest with Beds, shop with Goods, change jobs with Work, and recruit with Company. Helping ring the evening bell restores 2 MP once.
events.F1-42.name: Spare Pasture Wire
events.F1-42.scene: The rancher is deciding whether to sell spare wire or repair a damaged fence, leaving the repair work to you.
events.F1-42.action: Take the wire to market and share the proceeds, or attach it to the fence for a travel item.
events.F1-42.result: The market grants 140G; the fence grants one BD05. Choose only one.
events.F1-43.name: The Scabbard Maker Closes Early
events.F1-43.scene: The scabbard maker is locking the shelves. For helping, you may take a remaining sample or a simple supper.
events.F1-43.action: Fit the door boards and choose sample armor or supper.
events.F1-43.result: The sample grants AR02. Supper restores 7 HP with no item received.
events.F1-44.name: The Charcoal Burner’s White Tags
events.F1-44.scene: White and black tags mark charcoal bales. The burner explains: white is paid hauling, black is furnace cleaning.
events.F1-44.action: Carry a heavy white-tag bale or sort tools at the black-tag furnace.
events.F1-44.result: White costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants 260G. Black grants one AT04.
events.F1-45.name: Sharpening Water in the Channel
events.F1-45.scene: Clear spring water enters the sharpener’s artificial channel. Only one of two sluices may open today.
events.F1-45.action: Send water to the washing area and rest, or to the polishing area to collect a prototype.
events.F1-45.result: Washing restores 4 HP and 2 MP. Polishing grants SW02.
events.F1-46.name: The Grassland Pushcart Market
events.F1-46.scene: A pushcart seller offers one first-aid item. If you do not want to carry it, you may rest there instead.
events.F1-46.action: Buy HE06 for 35G or rest in the cart’s shade.
events.F1-46.result: Buying costs 35G and grants one HE06. Resting restores 3 HP free, even if you lack the gold.
events.F1-47.name: An Apprentice’s Farewell Fire
events.F1-47.scene: A novice closes the forge for the first time. A shortcut would get you to paid work, but staying earns a share of the novice’s meal.
events.F1-47.action: Head to the delivery office or stay until the fire is out and eat.
events.F1-47.result: The office pays 190G. Staying restores 5 HP and 2 MP.
events.F1-48.name: A Snapping Pasture-Gate Spring
events.F1-48.scene: One end of a gate spring is loose and may snap at chest height if pushed. There is a gap underneath.
events.F1-48.action: Remove your pack and crawl under, or push the gate standing up.
events.F1-48.result: Crawling is harmless. Pushing costs 4 HP from the spring (minimum 1 remaining).
events.F1-49.name: Hot Nails in the Wheel Ruts
events.F1-49.scene: Hot nails lie hidden in muddy cart ruts. Someone nearby rents walking boards.
events.F1-49.action: Pay 70G for a board or shoulder your load and step over the ruts.
events.F1-49.result: The board costs 70G and avoids injury. Carrying the load costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining). You can cross without gold.
events.F1-50.name: Backdraft at the Bellows
events.F1-50.scene: The wind shifts, blowing ash from the furnace mouth. A leather cover and fading lamp lie nearby.
events.F1-50.action: Protect your face with the cover or peer into the furnace to relight the lamp.
events.F1-50.result: Covering is harmless. Peering in breaks your concentration with smoke and costs 2 MP (minimum 0).
