events.F2-01.name: A Creaking Ferry Ring
events.F2-01.scene: The ferry’s hauling ring wears the rope at the same point each time. A cloth catches on one spot inside the ring.
events.F2-01.action: File down the protrusion found with the cloth, then run the ferry there and back.
events.F2-01.result: The rope no longer chafes. The boatman pays 360G, including the test run.
events.F2-02.name: The Sluicekeeper’s Scales
events.F2-02.scene: Since the iron weight was changed, identical loads read differently. Even with an empty pan, the needle points right.
events.F2-02.action: Center the needle with the pan empty, then reweigh the entrusted cargo.
events.F2-02.result: The ferry fee can be set correctly. The keeper gives you 220G.
events.F2-03.name: Four Claws on the Net Boat
events.F2-03.scene: The fishing boat’s net-hauling fitting tilts to one side. One of its four claws bends sharply inward.
events.F2-03.action: Bend it back to match the other three and pull up an empty net.
events.F2-03.result: The net rises without twisting. The fisher pays you 410G.
events.F2-04.name: Nails at the Washing Place
events.F2-04.scene: A nail at a washboard’s edge has torn clothing. The washers await a repair that will not snag cloth.
events.F2-04.action: Sink the nail head below the board’s surface and slide a test cloth back and forth.
events.F2-04.result: The cloth passes safely. Receive 260G from the washing-place fund.
events.F2-05.name: Overlapping Drying-Rack Tags
events.F2-05.scene: Wet rental tags have stuck together, making it seem two shops rented the same fish-drying space.
events.F2-05.action: Soak the tags apart and return them by their engraved rack numbers.
events.F2-05.result: The renters are identified. Receive 190G for mediating and sorting.
events.F2-06.name: A Sharpening Bench Powered by the Current
events.F2-06.scene: The waterwheel’s teeth are apart from the grinding axle. A narrow channel reaches the bench if the right gate opens.
events.F2-06.action: Open the right gate to turn the wheel or finish by hand.
events.F2-06.result: The waterwheel grants SW11. Hand-cranking costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants finely finished SW12.
events.F2-07.name: A Split Scabbard in the Hull
events.F2-07.scene: A sword dropped into the hull has only its scabbard broken. Shipwright’s offcuts can lift it without touching the blade.
events.F2-07.action: Place a board along the split and wrap it in cloth, or leave it to the boatman.
events.F2-07.result: Wrapping it yourself earns the rescued SW13 from the boatman. Leaving it changes nothing.
events.F2-08.name: The Windward Forge
events.F2-08.scene: River wind cools one side of the furnace. A movable windbreak and a labor-price sign stand before the grate.
events.F2-08.action: Turn the windbreak and forge it yourself, or pay a craftsperson 170G to finish it.
events.F2-08.result: Working yourself costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants SW14. Hiring costs 170G and grants SW14. If short of gold, you can work yourself.
events.F2-09.name: Engraving Wave Lines
events.F2-09.scene: An engraving bench marks boat ownership. Boats marked with one line and two lines each offer a test blade.
events.F2-09.action: Choose a boat to help and engrave its blade with lines matching its sample.
events.F2-09.result: One line grants SW15; two lines grant SW16. Return the other blade to its boat.
events.F2-10.name: The Racing Boat’s Spare Oar
events.F2-10.scene: A guard sword is tied to a racing boat’s spare oar. It goes to whoever unties it before the race.
events.F2-10.action: Pull the tight knot near the blade or the release loop at the grip’s end.
events.F2-10.result: The release loop grants SW17. The tight knot remains tied when the race begins, leaving the item behind.
events.F2-11.name: A Wharf Claim Ticket
events.F2-11.scene: The wharf workshop sells an unclaimed sword. A travel item can also be exchanged as delivery supplies.
events.F2-11.action: Buy SW18 for 790G, hand over one BD11, or decline.
events.F2-11.result: Paying 790G or consuming one BD11 grants SW18. Declining changes nothing.
events.F2-12.name: Two-Colored Floats and Gear Boxes
events.F2-12.scene: Ropes from boxes on the riverbed vanish among fish baskets. A blue float marks weapons; white marks armor.
events.F2-12.action: Choose one float and haul its box from shore.
events.F2-12.result: Blue grants SW19; white grants AR11. After you pull one up, the boatman retrieves the other.
events.F2-13.name: Marks on the Measuring Rod
events.F2-13.scene: The smith’s old measuring rod has a chipped end, so its engraved 0 no longer aligns with the edge. An order needs remeasuring.
events.F2-13.action: Measure from the wooden edge or the engraved 0.
events.F2-13.result: Starting at 0 gives the correct length and grants SW20 for inspection. The edge gives the wrong size and no reward.
events.F2-14.name: A Replacement Ring for Wet Cord
events.F2-14.scene: An armor cord soaked during the river crossing grips its fastening ring tightly. The workshop has dry cord of equal length.
events.F2-14.action: Loosen the knot without cutting it and thread the replacement through the original holes.
events.F2-14.result: The ring works again. Receive the repaired sample AR12.
events.F2-15.name: Passing Bridge Boards Across
events.F2-15.scene: The bridge keeper has two bundles for the far bank. The short bundle is light; the long one earns better gear.
events.F2-15.action: Pass over the short bundle or carry the long bundle there and back.
events.F2-15.result: The short bundle grants AR13. The long one costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants AR14.
events.F2-16.name: The Desalting Tub
events.F2-16.scene: A sea-worn shipment reaches the riverside workshop. Its note says to wash off salt before drying.
events.F2-16.action: Rinse it in fresh water before hanging, or leave it salty in the sun.
events.F2-16.result: Fresh water passes inspection and grants AR15. Drying it salty requires washing again; leave the item and continue.
events.F2-17.name: The Ferryman’s Wrist Guard
events.F2-17.scene: A child carrying boat cargo has scraped wrists. The ferryman offers armor to whoever replenishes the workshop’s first-aid box.
events.F2-17.action: Donate one held HE11 or fetch water from the riverbank instead.
events.F2-17.result: Donating consumes one HE11. Fetching water costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining). Either grants AR16.
events.F2-18.name: A Trial Crossing on the Pier
events.F2-18.scene: When someone wearing sample armor bends their knees on the pier, one fitting strikes the boards.
events.F2-18.action: Fasten it one hole higher and try again, or return it to the craftsperson.
events.F2-18.result: Adjusting allows a crouch and grants AR17 for testing. Returning it leaves your belongings unchanged.
events.F2-19.name: Shoulder Heights in the Water
events.F2-19.scene: Without a shop mirror, the craftsperson reflects both shoulders in still water. One side drops forward.
events.F2-19.action: Shorten the strap on the forward side or choose another piece with a different width.
events.F2-19.result: Shortening grants AR18 for inspection. Trying the other piece grants AR19.
events.F2-20.name: A Ship Bell Inspection Tag
events.F2-20.scene: At one bell, the boat unloads only inspected cargo. Urgent armor bears an inspection fee tag.
events.F2-20.action: Pay 180G for inspection and collection, or choose ordinary pre-inspected gear.
events.F2-20.result: Paying 180G grants AR20. The ordinary choice grants AR12 free, even if you lack the gold.
events.F2-21.name: The Diver’s Two Baskets
events.F2-21.scene: A diver pulls two baskets ashore. Water remains in the weapon basket, while the armor basket has dried in the wind.
events.F2-21.action: Drain and choose a weapon, or take the dry armor first.
events.F2-21.result: Weapons grant SW12; armor grants AR14. The other basket goes to the shop.
events.F2-22.name: Collecting Rivets in the Shallows
events.F2-22.scene: Shallows Crab grips a rivet-collecting tub. One side is shallow; the deep side makes its claw harder to remove.
events.F2-22.action: Face the deep side toward it and defend, or thrust your sword through the shallow side.
events.F2-22.result: Fight EN03. Deep side reduces the enemy’s first direct hit to 0 only if you guard on your first turn. Shallow side adds 3 damage only if your first-turn normal attack hits. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F2-23.name: A Shadow beneath the Oil Dish
events.F2-23.scene: Glowtail Bat hangs beneath the boathouse’s oil dish. Turning the dish casts its shadow on the opposite sail.
events.F2-23.action: Read the shadow with the bright sail behind you, or await an opening in the dark doorway.
events.F2-23.result: Fight EN04. The sail reduces first-turn enemy direct damage by 2. The doorway adds 4 damage only if the hero’s normal attack hits in round 2. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F2-24.name: A Two-Level Landing
events.F2-24.scene: High water washes the lower level; a low-roofed passage runs above. Claws show below, a little light above.
events.F2-24.action: Challenge Shallows Crab below or Glowtail Bat above.
events.F2-24.result: Fight once against EN03 below or EN04 above. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F2-25.name: The Flume’s Light Keeper
events.F2-25.scene: Glowtail Bat nests in the flume’s oil dish. A craftsperson supports it from below for one turn to keep the flame alight.
events.F2-25.action: Borrow the flame to ready a spell or extinguish it and lower the dish safely.
events.F2-25.result: Fight EN04. Borrowing the flame adds 4 damage only if a first-turn offensive spell hits. Extinguishing it reduces the enemy’s first direct hit on the first turn by 2. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F2-26.name: Scrap-Iron Beach at Low Tide
events.F2-26.scene: Shallows Crabs gather on the exposed beach. A busy fisher leaves it to you whether to clear one away.
events.F2-26.action: Go down to fight one or walk along the embankment.
events.F2-26.result: The beach gives a normal battle against EN03. The embankment passes without battle or reward. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F2-27.name: Tracking a Fallen Mold
events.F2-27.scene: Light on a casting mold washed from the boat stirs a Glowtail Bat beneath the bridge. The boatman offers a first-aid parcel.
events.F2-27.action: Buy HE12 for 45G before going under the bridge, or go with your current supplies.
events.F2-27.result: Buying costs 45G and grants one HE12. Whether you buy, decline, or cannot afford it, fight EN04 beneath the bridge. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F2-28.name: Testing the Claws
events.F2-28.scene: Beside a Shallows Crab cracking empty shells, a fisher studies its claw stance.
events.F2-28.action: Place a test shell in one claw or enter the shallows with both claws empty.
events.F2-28.result: Fight EN03. With a shell placed, landing a first-turn normal attack closes the claw and reduces enemy attack damage that turn by 3. With no shell or another action, battle is normal. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F2-29.name: A Dry Corner of Oilpaper
events.F2-29.scene: A boat-delivered supply bag is splashed. A dry-sealed parcel contains combat supplies; first aid lies under the wet outer bag.
events.F2-29.action: Take the dry parcel or open only the outer bag to rescue the first aid.
events.F2-29.result: The dry parcel grants one AT12; first aid grants one HE13.
events.F2-30.name: A Raft-Tying Lesson
events.F2-30.scene: A raft maker teaches knots on two thick logs. The sample ends with one release loop.
events.F2-30.action: Leave the same loop as the sample or tighten both ends fully.
events.F2-30.result: Leaving the loop grants the lesson supply BD12. Tightening both makes the raft maker correct your hands, with no item received.
events.F2-31.name: Spare Cargo Tags at the Weir
events.F2-31.scene: A cargo boat at the sluice needs damaged tags replaced. The workshop opens one combat-supply box per tag.
events.F2-31.action: Retie the punched tag to the cargo with copper wire, then accept or decline supplies.
events.F2-31.result: Accept to receive one AT13. Declining only repairs the tag.
events.F2-32.name: The Exchange at the Handwashing Place
events.F2-32.scene: The attendant seeks travel items and can offer a healing parcel in exchange.
events.F2-32.action: Give one BD13 or continue with your current item.
events.F2-32.result: Giving consumes one BD13 and grants one HE14. Lacking it or declining changes nothing.
events.F2-33.name: Balancing a Boat’s Load
events.F2-33.scene: One toolbox must be unloaded to balance a rental boat. The left box holds travel gear; the right holds combat gear.
events.F2-33.action: Choose a box to carry ashore and take one item as your hauling fee.
events.F2-33.result: Left grants one BD14; right grants one AT14.
events.F2-34.name: Thanks for Repairing the Water Pulley
events.F2-34.scene: A pebble jams an old pulley wheel. The wellside medicine seller offers a parcel for repairs, or accepts cash if you are in a hurry.
events.F2-34.action: Remove the pebble or buy the parcel for 67G.
events.F2-34.result: Repair costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining); buying costs 67G. Either grants one HE15. You can repair it if short of gold.
events.F2-35.name: The Potter’s Clam Soup
events.F2-35.scene: A potter serves clam soup to river travelers. A refill price is posted, but the first bowl is free.
events.F2-35.action: Drink one bowl or pay 90G for a refill.
events.F2-35.result: One bowl restores 6 HP. A refill costs 90G and restores 10 HP. Even with little gold, you may have one bowl.
events.F2-36.name: A Nap in a Reed Boat
events.F2-36.scene: During a break, a shipwright moors a reed boat. You may lie in its bottom or sit on the gunwale to steady your breathing.
events.F2-36.action: Close your eyes in the boat or sit on its edge and count waves.
events.F2-36.result: Napping restores 6 HP and 1 MP. Counting waves restores 4 MP.
events.F2-37.name: A Riverstone Footbath
events.F2-37.scene: A potter lines a shallow tub with riverstones doused in hot water. Their warmth reaches the tired spots on bare soles.
events.F2-37.action: Wash your feet first in the lukewarm tub, then rest them in the stone tub.
events.F2-38.name: A Night of Floating Lights
events.F2-38.scene: Harbor lamps sway in the wind, reflecting each flame’s color. The night watch leaves a teacup and little stool free.
events.F2-38.action: Drink hot water or sit and focus on the lamps’ movement.
events.F2-38.result: Hot water restores 4 HP and 2 MP. Watching the lamps restores 5 MP.
events.F2-39.name: Ferry Ring Inn
events.F2-39.scene: An old iron ferry-rope ring signs an inn where boatmen gather around a long bench.
events.F2-39.action: Choose your rest at the sluice-side desk and visit the counters you need. You can ask the boatman about the embankment.
events.F2-39.result: Rest in a bed, shop at the boat-gear shelf, change jobs at the desk, and recruit at the boatmen’s seats. Ask for the name of the first trap ahead in this region, or “None ahead from here” if none remain.
events.F2-40.name: Four Rooms along the Bridge Pier
events.F2-40.scene: A lodging house, goods shop, job specialist, and ferry companions line the bridge pier.
events.F2-40.action: Open your chosen door from the plank walkway. At the table, share a long loaf with your companions.
events.F2-40.result: Rest in the lodging, shop for goods, change jobs with the specialist, and recruit at the ferry seats. Sharing bread restores 2 HP per party member including the hero, up to 6, once.
events.F2-41.name: Floating Forge Raft Inn
events.F2-41.scene: One raft tied by thick ropes holds a forge, the next an inn. A plank joins them.
events.F2-41.action: Choose facilities at the inn’s door, then return across the plank. You can arrange two water tubs with the raft maker.
events.F2-41.result: Rest in the hearth room, shop at the forge, change jobs at the master’s notices, and recruit by the gangplank. After arranging the tubs, choose one thank-you recovery once: warm water for 4 HP or cold water for 2 MP.
events.F2-42.name: Counting Boat Nails
events.F2-42.scene: The shipwright has fewer nails than needed. You can fetch another box or make small goods with the remaining nails.
events.F2-42.action: Fetch the box across the river or make small goods for a travel item.
events.F2-42.result: Fetching costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants 350G. Making goods grants one BD15.
events.F2-43.name: A Boatload of Polishing Sand
events.F2-43.scene: The sand boat is departing. Delivering one small bag to the sharpener earns a blade, or to the apothecary earns first aid.
events.F2-43.action: Deliver the bag to either the sharpener or apothecary.
events.F2-43.result: The sharpener grants SW11. The apothecary grants one HE16.
events.F2-44.name: Two People Holding the Weir Board
events.F2-44.scene: A craftsperson raising a weir board needs help. Take a turn supporting it for gold, or sit with the resting worker for advice.
events.F2-44.action: Support the board or steady your breathing with the worker off duty.
events.F2-44.result: Supporting earns 280G. Steady breathing restores 4 MP.
events.F2-45.name: The Lunch Boat’s Last Seat
events.F2-45.scene: One seat remains on the lunch boat before departure. Meals are served aboard; parcels are handed out ashore.
events.F2-45.action: Sit aboard and eat or receive a parcel ashore.
events.F2-45.result: The boat restores 8 HP. The shore grants one HE17 with no immediate recovery.
events.F2-46.name: Armor Markets on Both Sides
events.F2-46.scene: Starboard sells for cash; port exchanges armor for combat items. Each side has different armor.
events.F2-46.action: Buy starboard armor for 540G, exchange one AT15 for port armor, or decline.
events.F2-46.result: Buying costs 540G and grants AR11. Trading consumes one AT15 and grants AR18. Declining or lacking both options changes nothing.
events.F2-47.name: Letters beneath the Bridge
events.F2-47.scene: A child lowers a letter from the bridge for a grandparent’s workshop. Either the riverside or roadside workshop can receive it.
events.F2-47.action: Hand it to the grandfather by the river or carry it to the grandmother’s roadside shop.
events.F2-47.result: Riverside pays 230G. Roadside offers lunch restoring 5 HP and 2 MP.
events.F2-48.name: A Weed-Covered Pull Chain
events.F2-48.scene: Weed coats a boat chain, making it slippery to pull from the step. A thick shore post can guide the chain.
events.F2-48.action: Loop the chain once around the post or pull hard from the step.
events.F2-48.result: The post gives a safe grip without injury. Brute force makes you fall, costing 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining).
events.F2-49.name: A Downward-Opening Hatch
events.F2-49.scene: The pier’s repair hatch opens downward. Holding cargo, you risk losing the door from underfoot.
events.F2-49.action: Pay 80G to put your cargo on the far boat or shoulder it and step over the rim.
events.F2-49.result: The boat costs 80G and avoids injury. Stepping across costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining). You can pass without gold.
events.F2-50.name: White Smoke from the Oil Dish
events.F2-50.scene: Water collects in the cabin’s oil dish, producing white smoke when fire approaches. An open window and extinguishing lid are nearby.
events.F2-50.action: Cover it from the window side or lean into the smoke.
events.F2-50.result: Using the lid is harmless. Leaning in makes you cough and costs 3 MP (minimum 0).

events.F3-01.name: Listen to the Empty Cart
events.F3-01.scene: An empty minecart knocks twice at one track joint. The track keeper has missed a raised fastening nail.
events.F3-01.action: Hold down the noisy joint, hammer the nail back in, and push the empty cart again.
events.F3-01.result: The sound returns to one knock. The keeper pays 480G for repairs.
events.F3-02.name: A Corner of the Sieve
events.F3-02.scene: Good ore falls through the quarrier’s sieve. One mesh opening has frayed at a corner.
events.F3-02.action: Weave thin wire into the corner and sift the fallen ore again.
events.F3-02.result: The ore is sorted without damage. The quarrier gives you 330G.
events.F3-03.name: A Pay Pouch in the Floor Gap
events.F3-03.scene: A miner’s pay pouch falls between the office floor and wall. Removing boards would require moving the clerk’s ledgers.
events.F3-03.action: Bend the wire tip into a loop and hook only the pouch’s knot.
events.F3-03.result: Return it unbroken and receive the ledger’s recorded retrieval fee of 270G.
events.F3-04.name: A Crooked Crushing Hammer
events.F3-04.scene: The great rock-crushing hammer hits the floor only on its left. A wood scrap is wedged under one axle support.
events.F3-04.action: Stop the hammer, remove the scrap, and test empty strikes until both marks align.
events.F3-04.result: The hammer works safely. The mine chief pays you 560G.
events.F3-05.name: Rope on the Hoist Basket
events.F3-05.scene: The lift basket’s rope sags midway. Rewinding it without a load makes the rope double over at the same drum spot.
events.F3-05.action: Remove the overlapping turn and rewind it into each groove in order.
events.F3-05.result: The basket rises at a steady speed. The hoist keeper pays you 420G.
events.F3-06.name: Split along the Grooves
events.F3-06.scene: The mine-entrance workshop needs sword material divided. Three shallow grooves form a straight line on a large stone.
events.F3-06.action: Strike the wedges in each groove alternately, or keep pounding only one.
events.F3-06.result: Alternating splits the intended shape and grants SW21. One wedge chips the edge and earns no reward.
events.F3-07.name: Two Minecart Furnaces
events.F3-07.scene: The upper minecart furnace goes up a steep slope; the lower follows level track. Rewards differ with the work’s difficulty.
events.F3-07.action: Push the furnace uphill or along the lower, level track.
events.F3-07.result: Upper costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants SW22. Lower grants SW23 without exhaustion.
events.F3-08.name: An Ink Cutting Line
events.F3-08.scene: The craftsperson marks steel with ink, placing the mark’s edge on the side to be removed. A paper tag marks the part to keep.
events.F3-08.action: Cut outside the tag or across it.
events.F3-08.result: Outside preserves the needed length and grants SW24. Cutting across makes it too short; return it and finish.
events.F3-09.name: The Entrance Keeper’s Loan Hammer
events.F3-09.scene: Two people are needed to work your share with the long hammer. The keeper offers help in exchange for lunch-break pay.
events.F3-09.action: Give the keeper 230G or switch to a shorter hammer yourself.
events.F3-09.result: Paying 230G grants SW25. The short hammer costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants SW26. You may use it if short of gold.
events.F3-10.name: A Shadow on the Rock Wall
events.F3-10.scene: A collapsed storeroom wall retains the outline of a once-hanging blade. Only the gravel directly below it is fresh.
events.F3-10.action: Dig in the fresh gravel or hurry onward.
events.F3-10.result: Digging grants the buried SW27. Hurrying changes nothing.
events.F3-11.name: Two Sides of the Pattern
events.F3-11.scene: Two patterns made by a carver distinguish Blade on the front and Defense on the back. You may copy only one.
events.F3-11.action: Deliver the blade pattern to the forge or the protective pattern to the sewing bench.
events.F3-11.result: The forge grants SW28; the sewing bench grants AR21.
events.F3-12.name: A Magnet in the Stardust Tub
events.F3-12.scene: Fine iron scraps spill into the finishing tub. Wrapping a magnet in paper first makes them easy to return.
events.F3-12.action: Wrap the magnet, collect the scraps, then remove the paper above the tub.
events.F3-12.result: For returning the scraps in one go, receive the workshop sword SW29.
events.F3-13.name: An Old Sword for Road Supplies
events.F3-13.scene: The mine trading post wants travel items. Its reward shelf offers a sword, with free staff food available too.
events.F3-13.action: Give one BD21 for the sword or simply accept a meal.
events.F3-13.result: Trading consumes one BD21 and grants SW30. The meal restores 4 HP and is available even without the item.
events.F3-14.name: Scrapes on the Ceiling
events.F3-14.scene: Armor scrapes the tunnel’s low ceiling. Passing under the fitting bench’s crossbar leaves a white mark on one protruding clasp.
events.F3-14.action: Lower only the marked fitting and try passing underneath again.
events.F3-14.result: You pass without touching the ceiling and receive prototype AR22.
events.F3-15.name: Oil to Loosen a Chain
events.F3-15.scene: One link in the chain closing an old armor box will not move. The oil bottle says one drop at the stiff link’s joint.
events.F3-15.action: Oil the joint or pull the whole chain taut.
events.F3-15.result: Oil frees the link and grants AR23. Pulling alone leaves it stuck, so you cannot take the armor.
events.F3-16.name: Measuring Thread in the Tunnel
events.F3-16.scene: A tailor teaches a novice who cannot read measurements to copy shoulder width with string. You can use your own width or the bench’s standard.
events.F3-16.action: Knot the string to your width or the standard marks.
events.F3-16.result: Your own fit grants AR24; standard width grants AR25. Only one garment is made.
events.F3-17.name: A Brush for Stone Dust
events.F3-17.scene: White stone dust hides the miner’s armor fastening holes. A brush is free to borrow; professional finishing costs 220G.
events.F3-17.action: Borrow the brush and polish, or hire the finisher.
events.F3-17.result: Doing it yourself costs 1 HP (minimum 1 remaining); hiring costs 220G. Either grants AR26. You can borrow the brush if short of gold.
events.F3-18.name: The Minecart Keeper’s Knee
events.F3-18.scene: The minecart keeper always kneels on the right knee. The armor seller has one thick patch and asks which work it should suit.
events.F3-18.action: Sew it for kneeling work or carrying loads.
events.F3-18.result: Knee padding earns AR27 from the minecart keeper. Load-carrying padding earns AR28 from the porter.
events.F3-19.name: A Copper Speaking Tube
events.F3-19.scene: A dented speaking tube will not carry the item number to the inspector. Tapping a short tube can still send signals.
events.F3-19.action: Tap twice like the sample to request armor, or three times to stop work.
events.F3-19.result: Two taps bring AR29 from the far end. Three cancel the handover and change nothing.
events.F3-20.name: The Secondhand Shop’s Service Tag
events.F3-20.scene: Armor donated to the pass is free but needs servicing before collection. The seller accepts a tool instead of the fee.
events.F3-20.action: Pay 260G, give one tool AT21, or decline for now.
events.F3-20.result: Paying 260G or consuming one AT21 grants AR30. Declining or lacking both changes nothing.
events.F3-21.name: A Fulcrum in the Cave-In Model
events.F3-21.scene: A miner training model offers two ways to support a load. Different workshops handle driving wedges and bearing weight.
events.F3-21.action: Drive wedges or hold the support post.
events.F3-21.result: Wedge work grants SW23; support work grants AR21 as training thanks.
events.F3-22.name: Moving Iron-Sand Letters
events.F3-22.scene: A warning written in iron sand clings to Magnet Golem’s arms. Darker letters reveal thicker deposits.
events.F3-22.action: Guard toward the thicker-coated arm or attack from the thinner side.
events.F3-22.result: Fight EN05. Thick side adds 5 reduction to that turn’s first direct hit only if you guard on the first turn. Thin side adds 3 damage only if your first-turn normal attack hits. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F3-23.name: A Nose beneath the Minecart
events.F3-23.scene: Armored Mole lifts the track keeper’s cart with its nose. A wheel stop could protect the party but immobilize the cart.
events.F3-23.action: Insert the wheel stop or roll the cart aside to approach.
events.F3-23.result: Fight EN02. Stopping it reduces each enemy direct hit in round 1 by 2. Rolling it aside adds 3 damage only if your normal attack hits in round 2. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F3-24.name: Inspection Hammers on Both Sides
events.F3-24.scene: Scraping soil sounds from the left tunnel; clinging iron sounds from the right. Only one needs patrolling.
events.F3-24.action: Inspect the narrow left tunnel or the wide right tunnel.
events.F3-24.result: Fight one normal battle: EN02 on the left or EN05 on the right. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F3-25.name: Keys Pointing at the Door
events.F3-25.scene: Office keys hover horizontally toward the door. Magnet Golem is inside, but you can go around outside.
events.F3-25.action: Push open the door and clear the room or take the path behind the hut.
events.F3-25.result: Inside, fight EN05. The back path proceeds without battle or reward. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F3-26.name: The Bunk Inspection Bell
events.F3-26.scene: The night watch’s inspection bell vibrates, bringing Armored Mole out of the ground. A nearby mine shop sells combat supplies.
events.F3-26.action: Buy AT22 for 98G or face it with your current supplies.
events.F3-26.result: Buying costs 98G and grants one AT22. Declining or lacking gold buys nothing. In every case, fight EN02. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F3-27.name: A Mine Lamp Walks
events.F3-27.scene: A swaying work lamp crosses the tracks at the mine entrance. It is a large hermit crab living in an ore shell.
events.F3-27.action: Move workers aside and fight while watching the telegraph for its opening shell.
events.F3-27.result: Fight Mine-Lantern Hermit Crab in a normal battle. Victory grants 360G and 26 XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no victory rewards.
events.F3-28.name: The Quarry Strikes Back
events.F3-28.scene: When you tap the stone wall with an inspection rod, a thick stone arm returns the blow. Stone Gatekeeper waits with its arm raised overhead.
events.F3-28.action: Challenge the powerful foe or mark the wall to pass it by.
events.F3-28.result: Challenging starts a battle against MB01. The first time you guard against its heavy swing, the inspection rod’s vibration prepares you and reduces that hit by an additional 4. Passing gives no battle or reward. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. You cannot flee after challenging. Defeat grants no battle rewards.
events.F3-29.name: The Miners’ Shift Bags
events.F3-29.scene: A shift change leaves one combat supply bag and one first-aid bag at the entrance.
events.F3-29.action: Consider the road ahead and mark one to receive.
events.F3-29.result: Receive one AT23 for combat or one HE21 for first aid. Leave the other for the next shift.
events.F3-30.name: A Square Key for the Lid
events.F3-30.scene: The first-aid shelf has a square keyhole. Triangular and square tools hang on the wall.
events.F3-30.action: Turn the square tool or press with the triangular tip.
events.F3-30.result: Square opens the shelf and grants one HE22. Triangle will not turn; finish without receiving anything.
events.F3-31.name: Weights for a Wet Map
events.F3-31.scene: The guide’s map curls up. A flat stone lies at each corner.
events.F3-31.action: Place the stones on the corners and trace the destination marks as the map dries.
events.F3-31.result: Receive one travel item BD22 for protecting the map.
events.F3-32.name: Sharing a Load on the Cliff Road
events.F3-32.scene: A porter has one shoulder free. You may hire a cart for a joint delivery or carry the load to the pass by hand.
events.F3-32.action: Carry it uphill together or pay 160G to load a cart.
events.F3-32.result: Carrying costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining); the cart costs 160G. Either grants one BD23 for delivery. You can carry it without gold.
events.F3-33.name: Supplies with Inspection Tags
events.F3-33.scene: The mine aid station needs healing stock. Two inspection tags identify separate exchange boxes.
events.F3-33.action: Give one HE23 and choose the combat or travel box. Pass if you have none.
events.F3-33.result: Trading consumes one HE23 and grants one AT24 from the combat box or BD24 from the travel box. Declining changes nothing.
events.F3-34.name: Copper-Dust Fingerprints
events.F3-34.scene: Only the middle of three toolbox drawers has fresh copper-dusted fingerprints. The craftsperson points there for supplies.
events.F3-34.action: Open the middle drawer or leave it shut and continue.
events.F3-34.result: Opening grants one first-aid item HE24. Passing changes nothing.
events.F3-35.name: Salted Rice Balls at the Mine
events.F3-35.scene: The day shift prepares cold water and salted rice balls. Resting travelers may have one too.
events.F3-35.action: Eat a rice ball or drink water and breathe deeply.
events.F3-35.result: The rice ball restores 9 HP. Water and breathing restore 3 HP and 3 MP.
events.F3-36.name: A Tile Warm from Embers
events.F3-36.scene: After the charcoal is cleared, one hot ceramic tile remains. Its warmth suits a back chilled by the pass wind.
events.F3-36.action: Lay down outer cloth and warm your back, or warm only your hands and concentrate.
events.F3-36.result: Your back restores 7 HP and 1 MP. Your hands restore 5 MP.
events.F3-37.name: A Seat between Drops
events.F3-37.scene: Water drips at steady intervals in the tunnel rest area. The mine chief has long recommended resting for six drops.
events.F3-37.action: Sit and close your eyes until six drops fall.
events.F3-37.result: A quiet breather restores 4 HP and 4 MP.
events.F3-38.name: The Haulers’ Late-Night Pot
events.F3-38.scene: After unloading, the crew’s pot holds hearty solids at the bottom and free broth.
events.F3-38.action: Take broth or pay 120G for a hearty bowl.
events.F3-38.result: Broth restores 5 HP. A hearty bowl costs 120G and restores 11 HP. You can take broth if short of gold.
events.F3-39.name: Minecart-Stop Guard Hut
events.F3-39.scene: Retired minecarts serve as beds and counters. At the back, an old miner introduces work.
events.F3-39.action: Choose from the signs on the carts. You may also see the track keeper’s cargo list.
events.F3-39.result: Rest in a bed, shop at a counter, change jobs at the agency, and recruit at the hut table. The cargo list shows the number and name of the first item space ahead in this region, or “No cargo” if none remain.
events.F3-40.name: The Stone-Dust Inn
events.F3-40.scene: A large dusting brush hangs at the entrance. Beyond are a warm dining room and a room for craft business.
events.F3-40.action: Brush off your cloak and visit the dining room or back counter. After dusting, you may visit the aid seat.
events.F3-40.result: Rest in the dining room, shop at the shelves, change jobs in the meeting room, and recruit at shared tables. At the aid seat, restore an extra 6 HP once if at half maximum HP or less. Above half, no treatment is needed.
events.F3-41.name: The Hoist Tower Landing
events.F3-41.scene: Boards widen an old tower landing into an inn for travelers going up and down the pass.
events.F3-41.action: Leave your load by the lift and choose a marked room. You can climb the high tower with the lookout.
events.F3-41.result: Rest in a bed, shop at the exchange counter, change jobs in the master’s room, and recruit at the railing table. The tower reveals the number of the nearest remaining normal-battle space in this region, or “None in sight.”
events.F3-42.name: Where to Strike the Mark
events.F3-42.scene: The pass night watch brings two iron rods. One needs a trade mark, the other a personal practice mark.
events.F3-42.action: Stamp the trade rod or finish the practice rod for yourself.
events.F3-42.result: Trade work pays 390G. Your own piece grants SW21.
events.F3-43.name: The Sieve Keeper Leaves Early
events.F3-43.scene: The sieve keeper wants to go home early, offering wages for a replacement or a shared lunch for company on the way.
events.F3-43.action: Take over sifting or eat lunch on the homeward road.
events.F3-43.result: Taking over costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants 460G. Lunch restores 8 HP.
events.F3-44.name: Accounting for Tunnel Tools
events.F3-44.scene: A returned toolbox has a loose bottom and cannot go to the next crew. Exchange tools also lie on the workbench.
events.F3-44.action: Refasten and inspect the returned box, exchange AT25 for BD25 without working, or decline.
events.F3-44.result: Completing inspection pays a one-time 310G. Trading consumes one AT25 and grants one BD25. Declining or lacking the exchange item changes nothing.
events.F3-45.name: Chalk Posture Lines
events.F3-45.scene: Chalk posture lines mark the equipment fitting area. Both the measuring role and the seated record-reading role are open.
events.F3-45.action: Measure posture to receive armor or sit and read the records.
events.F3-45.result: Measuring grants AR24. Reading restores 4 MP without receiving armor.
events.F3-46.name: A First-Aid Box on the Ridge
events.F3-46.scene: Miners want a first-aid box on the ridge. Carrying it earns a parcel; helping here earns treatment.
events.F3-46.action: Deliver the box to the ridge or help wrap cloth here.
events.F3-46.result: Delivery grants one HE25. Staying restores 6 HP and 2 MP.
events.F3-47.name: Offcuts at the Assay Office
events.F3-47.scene: You may send approved offcuts to the workshop or training ground. Each destination offers different supplies.
events.F3-47.action: Hand them to workshop reception or training-ground reception.
events.F3-47.result: The workshop grants AR28. The training ground grants one AT26.
events.F3-48.name: One Loose Wheel Stop
events.F3-48.scene: A wheel stop has come off on sloping track. The downhill wheel starts moving.
events.F3-48.action: Step beside the track and insert a stop bar or push back from directly in front.
events.F3-48.result: From the side, no injury. From the front, you are pushed back and lose 5 HP (minimum 1 remaining).
events.F3-49.name: A Fare across the Cliff
events.F3-49.scene: A quarry platform has collapsed. A lift platform offers a route above, while a taut rope permits crossing by hand.
events.F3-49.action: Pay 130G for the lift or grip the rope and move sideways.
events.F3-49.result: The lift costs 130G and avoids injury. The rope costs 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining), and is available without enough gold.
events.F3-50.name: A Steel Ruler Clinging to the Wall
events.F3-50.scene: A marked steel ruler sticks to the wall and blocks the way. Pulling hard might send you stumbling.
events.F3-50.action: Slide it parallel to the wall or pull straight backward.
events.F3-50.result: Sliding is harmless. Pulling backward makes you fall, costing 3 HP and 1 MP (minimum HP 1, MP 0).

events.F4-01.name: A Crack in the Foghorn
events.F4-01.scene: The forest guide’s horn cracks in tone whenever blown. Submerging its tube reveals tiny bubbles at a joint.
events.F4-01.action: Rewrap the bubbling joint and give one short blast from the bank.
events.F4-01.result: The far guide answers. Receive 470G for the repair.
events.F4-02.name: The Sawyers’ Blade
events.F4-02.scene: A two-person saw drifts sideways. One side of the log’s cut has deeper rough grooves.
events.F4-02.action: Check its tilt on scrap wood and set the teeth on both sides to equal width.
events.F4-02.result: It cuts straight. The sawyers pay you 620G.
events.F4-03.name: A Perch for the Sap Bucket
events.F4-03.scene: A small sap bucket slips from its branch and spills. The cord has not stretched, but the handle has opened at its base.
events.F4-03.action: Close the handle again, fill the bucket with water, and check its balance.
events.F4-03.result: No replacement bucket is needed. The collector gives you 380G.
events.F4-04.name: Smoke Returning to the Guard Hut
events.F4-04.scene: Only on misty nights, smoke blows back into the hut. Leaves narrow the roof pipe’s outlet.
events.F4-04.action: Put out the fire, remove the pipe, and clean the leaf screen.
events.F4-04.result: Smoke escapes through the roof. The keeper pays 350G for cleaning.
events.F4-05.name: The Silent Turn on the Bell Road
events.F4-05.scene: Every bend on the misty road has a bell. One is pressed against a tree and will not ring when pulled.
events.F4-05.action: Hang it slightly clear of the branch and test from the next bend.
events.F4-05.result: The sound reaches the unseen slope. The road keeper gives you 540G.
events.F4-06.name: Growth Rings at the End Grain
events.F4-06.scene: A small crack runs through wood intended for a sword grip. The master marks the sound side with ink.
events.F4-06.action: Carve while keeping the marked side or the cracked side.
events.F4-06.result: The marked side makes a sound grip and grants SW31. The cracked side cancels the test strikes and grants nothing.
events.F4-07.name: How Well the Charcoal Burned
events.F4-07.scene: The charcoal kiln’s back is well-fired, but its front is damp. The master needs someone to carry the back charcoal or dry the front again.
events.F4-07.action: Carry the back charcoal or redry the front.
events.F4-07.result: Carrying costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants SW32. Drying grants SW33 without exhaustion.
events.F4-08.name: Reading a Brand through the Mist
events.F4-08.scene: Two weapon boxes sit in the forest storehouse. Wiping their wet surfaces with thin cloth reveals marks hidden by mist.
events.F4-08.action: Use the cloth to find the genuine round mark or return the boxes unchecked.
events.F4-08.result: The round-marked box grants SW34. Returning unchecked grants nothing.
events.F4-09.name: A Green Line Reflected in a Blade
events.F4-09.scene: Without a mirror, a craftsperson uses a grass stem’s reflection to find a bent blade. The reflected line breaks at one spot.
events.F4-09.action: Point out the spot or help reforge it on the anvil.
events.F4-09.result: Pointing it out grants SW35 for inspection. Helping costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants SW36.
events.F4-10.name: Payment after Branch Clearing
events.F4-10.scene: A guard’s share of swords lies at a cleared worksite. It is free as wages, but costs gold without work.
events.F4-10.action: Bundle the piled branches or buy a sword for 1890G.
events.F4-10.result: Bundling costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining); buying costs 1890G. Either grants SW37. You can bundle if short of gold.
events.F4-11.name: Green-Cord and Gray-Cord Orders
events.F4-11.scene: Mist wets paper tags, so the workshop marks goods with cords: green for swords, gray for armor.
events.F4-11.action: Choose the cord you need and tie it to the delivery load.
events.F4-11.result: Green grants SW38; gray grants AR31. Take only one order.
events.F4-12.name: A Drain Hole in an Old Scabbard
events.F4-12.scene: Water gathers in a scabbard left in the forest. The maker’s sample has its drain hole blocked by a fine wood chip.
events.F4-12.action: Remove the blade, invert the scabbard, and clear the bottom hole with a thin rod.
events.F4-12.result: After checking drainage, the maker gives you sample sword SW39.
events.F4-13.name: Supplies for the Mist Watch
events.F4-13.scene: The forester replenishes a shared first-aid shelf, offering a sword to anyone delivering one healing item.
events.F4-13.action: Donate one HE31, pay 280G toward stock instead, or decline.
events.F4-13.result: Consuming one HE31 or paying 280G grants SW40. Declining or lacking both changes nothing.
events.F4-14.name: A Seam That Resists Thorns
events.F4-14.scene: Thorns catch workshop test cloth differently when seams face outward or are hidden inside.
events.F4-14.action: Test near the thorns with the seam inward or outward.
events.F4-14.result: Inward keeps the thread intact and grants AR32. Outward unravels the test cloth, with no reward.
events.F4-15.name: A Frame for Carrying Branches
events.F4-15.scene: A forest porter has two sample branch-carrying frames: one shoulder-supported, one waist-supported.
events.F4-15.action: Adjust the shoulder frame or rethread the waist frame’s belt.
events.F4-15.result: Repairing the shoulder frame earns AR33; the waist frame earns AR34. Return the repaired samples to the porter.
events.F4-16.name: Drops on Smoked Leather
events.F4-16.scene: One spot on new armor absorbs a water drop quickly. Its finish is thinner there.
events.F4-16.action: Wipe the wet spot, add finish, and begin wrapping from the dry sections.
events.F4-16.result: The finish is even. Receive AR35 from the communal workshop.
events.F4-17.name: A Twisted Shoulder Strap’s Mark
events.F4-17.scene: One strap leaves a deeper mark on the lookout’s shoulder. It has twisted once across the back.
events.F4-17.action: Untwist and fasten it yourself, or give one travel item BD31 to have the shop do it.
events.F4-17.result: Repairing it yourself grants AR36. Hiring consumes one BD31 and grants differently finished AR37. You can repair it without the item.
events.F4-18.name: A Load Test for the Log Bridge
events.F4-18.scene: The bridge repairer wants a prototype load carried across. Two ink lines show where to balance weight left and right.
events.F4-18.action: Split the load and carry it, or watch the repacking from the near end.
events.F4-18.result: Carrying costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants AR38 from the tailoring box. Watching changes nothing.
events.F4-19.name: The Drying Box’s Upper Shelf
events.F4-19.scene: Ground moisture reaches the lower shelf of the forest workshop. Upper-shelf armor is already dry and ready.
events.F4-19.action: Take the upper item now or move the lower item to the hearth for finishing.
events.F4-19.result: Upper grants AR39. Moving the lower item earns AR40 in thanks. Receive only one.
events.F4-20.name: A Cloak Snag Test
events.F4-20.scene: A travel cloak catches on a cart nail. The woodworking fitting stand lets you cover the nail head with a thin board.
events.F4-20.action: Apply the board and help inspect, or buy inspected stock for 1770G.
events.F4-20.result: Helping inspection grants AR32. Paying 1770G grants AR35. You may inspect if short of gold.
events.F4-21.name: Caches in the Boundary Stone
events.F4-21.scene: Two storage holes mark the charcoal hut’s boundary stone. A swordsman and defender left spares for those following.
events.F4-21.action: Take the long narrow parcel or the wide parcel.
events.F4-21.result: Narrow grants SW33; wide grants AR31. Leave the other for the next travelers.
events.F4-22.name: Tracks of a Missing Signpost
events.F4-22.scene: A signpost has been dragged into brush, leaving Mist Fox tracks. Following them leads to a fight, but the road keeper knows a way through.
events.F4-22.action: Follow the tracks to reclaim it or ask for the passage.
events.F4-22.result: Following starts a normal battle against EN06. The passage gives no battle or reward. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F4-23.name: Threads across the Windbreak
events.F4-23.scene: Thorn Spider’s threads span a windbreak. Opening its door one way slackens them; the other pulls them taut.
events.F4-23.action: Push inward to slacken the threads or pull outward to tighten them.
events.F4-23.result: Fight EN07. Inward reduces first-turn enemy direct damage by 4. Outward lets a successful first-turn normal attack cut the taut thread and adds 4 damage to that attack. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F4-24.name: A White Tail and Black Threads
events.F4-24.scene: A white tail crosses the charcoal road; black threads span the sap collectors’ path. Two groups ask you to escort only one.
events.F4-24.action: Lead the charcoal porters or clear the sap collectors’ path.
events.F4-24.result: Fight once: EN06 on the charcoal road or EN07 on the sap road. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F4-25.name: A Guardian in the Mirror Finish
events.F4-25.scene: Mist Fox’s outline appears in a polished blade. The master can hold it tilted for only one turn.
events.F4-25.action: Aim a normal attack at the reflected outline or wait in guard in the blade’s shadow.
events.F4-25.result: Fight EN06. A successful first-turn normal attack gains 4 damage. Guarding on the first turn stops the foe with reflected light and also restores 2 MP. Other actions are unchanged. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F4-26.name: Cutting Threads at the Hanging Shelf
events.F4-26.scene: Thorn Spider descends the threads holding an herb shelf to the ceiling. The medicine seller can sell supplies but cannot fight.
events.F4-26.action: Buy HE32 for 125G and step forward, or step forward without buying.
events.F4-26.result: Buying costs 125G and grants one HE32. Whether you buy, decline, or lack gold, fight EN07 before the shelf. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F4-27.name: A Counterfeit Watch Bell
events.F4-27.scene: Mist Fox imitates bells deep in the woods. Only the voice beneath the left tree continues after the wind stops.
events.F4-27.action: Aim your first normal attack beneath the left tree or at the wind-tossed right bell.
events.F4-27.result: Fight EN06. A successful first-turn normal attack aimed left gains 3 damage. Aiming right strikes the bell for 0 damage. Other actions and rounds 2 onward are normal. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.F4-28.name: A Beetle on the Sap Jar
events.F4-28.scene: Ironclad Beetle sits on the hut’s repair box, drinking sap dripping from a jar. The jar’s shadow brightens whenever the shell opens.
events.F4-28.action: Challenge the powerful foe or tell the sawyer to collect the box later.
events.F4-28.result: Challenge MB02. The first successful normal attack on a turn when its shell opens gains 4 damage as reflected light guides your aim. Passing gives no battle or reward. Victory grants enemy-specific XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. You cannot flee after challenging. Defeat grants no battle rewards.
events.F4-29.name: Sealing-Wax Color Samples
events.F4-29.scene: Red and white sealing wax has cooled at the item shop. Red marks combat supplies; white marks recovery.
events.F4-29.action: Choose a wax color and take one parcel of that color.
events.F4-29.result: Red grants one AT31; white grants one HE33.
events.F4-30.name: A Fading Road Arrow
events.F4-30.scene: Moss buries the wooden sign’s arrow, but its carved groove still clearly shows the turn.
events.F4-30.action: Clear moss only along the arrow’s groove and have the guide check it.
events.F4-30.result: Receive one BD32 for restoring the directions.
events.F4-31.name: Balancing Medicine Bags
events.F4-31.scene: The forest medic wants shoulder bags on both sides. You can exchange a held combat item for a medical one.
events.F4-31.action: Give one AT32 or help shift the load without giving an item.
events.F4-31.result: Trading consumes one AT32 and grants one HE34. Helping costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants one HE35. You can help without the item.
events.F4-32.name: A Tied Log Tube
events.F4-32.scene: The forester’s supply tube opens at its bottom knot. The upper knot secures its carrying handle.
events.F4-32.action: Untie the bottom for supplies or undo only the top handle.
events.F4-32.result: Bottom grants one BD33. Top cannot release the contents; restore the handle and continue.
events.F4-33.name: A Pine-Resin Delivery Slip
events.F4-33.scene: A label sticks to a tree, leaving a porter’s hands full. Once freed, you can choose its destination.
events.F4-33.action: Lift the label with cloth and deliver it to the guard hut or combat practice ground.
events.F4-33.result: The hut grants one BD34; the practice ground grants one AT33.
events.F4-34.name: Closing Boxes after the Mist
events.F4-34.scene: After an all-night shift, the item seller closes the supply box. Collection costs gold, but you may carry a small box instead if short.
events.F4-34.action: Buy a combat parcel for 136G or carry a box for first aid.
events.F4-34.result: Buying costs 136G and grants one AT34. Carrying grants one HE36 and is possible without gold.
events.F4-35.name: Slits in Charcoal-Roasted Chestnuts
events.F4-35.scene: A craftsperson roasts chestnuts by the kiln, slitting their skins and sharing small plates even with new travelers.
events.F4-35.action: Eat chestnuts or drink hot water by the fire and steady your breathing.
events.F4-35.result: Chestnuts restore 10 HP. Hot water restores 4 HP and 3 MP.
events.F4-36.name: The Woodworker’s Rocking Chair
events.F4-36.scene: A freshly carved chair rocks gently. You are asked to test it, and its back can recline.
events.F4-36.action: Recline and lie down or close your eyes while sitting upright.
events.F4-36.result: Lying down restores 8 HP and 1 MP. Closing your eyes to focus restores 6 MP.
events.F4-37.name: Shelter beneath a Bark Roof
events.F4-37.scene: Fine drizzle continues. Beneath a craftsperson’s layered bark roof are a dry mat and a removable wet-coat rack.
events.F4-37.action: Hang your coat and rest on the dry mat.
events.F4-37.result: By the time the rain stops, restore 7 HP and 2 MP.
events.F4-38.name: A Bed with Hot-Water Bottles
events.F4-38.scene: The forest coppersmith lends one small hot-water bottle free to resting travelers. A second costs hot-water money.
events.F4-38.action: Rest holding one or pay 140G for another at your feet.
events.F4-38.result: One restores 5 HP and 1 MP. Two cost 140G and restore 12 HP and 1 MP. You can borrow one if short of gold.
events.F4-39.name: The Round Kiln-Door Inn
events.F4-39.scene: A spent charcoal kiln’s round door signs an inn where charcoal families and guards wait for the mist to clear.
events.F4-39.action: Pass through the round door to the hearth, sales shelf, workroom, or table. You may also help clear old kiln ash.
events.F4-39.result: Rest at the hearth, shop at the shelf, change jobs in the workroom, and recruit at the table. Carrying ash costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining), then restores 5 MP by the fire once. Facilities remain usable if you decline.
events.F4-40.name: Mistbell Relay Hut
events.F4-40.scene: Four counters have distinct bells and written tags so they can be found even when the sign is hidden.
events.F4-40.action: Read the tags and ring Beds, Goods, Work, or Company. Borrow the guide bell to signal the next road keeper.
events.F4-40.result: Rest with Beds, shop with Goods, change jobs with Work, and recruit with Company. The road keeper answers whether any powerful-foe candidate lies in the next 6 spaces: yes or no. Space 100 is excluded.
events.F4-41.name: The Woodworker’s Long Bench Inn
events.F4-41.scene: A partly carved bench surrounds the inn. Goods and job notices sit beside resting travelers.
events.F4-41.action: Move along the bench’s signs to finish your errands. You can check your bag’s weight at the packing stand.
events.F4-41.result: Rest by the hearth, shop at the item seats, change jobs at the master’s seat, and recruit at shared seats. If your bag is full (6 items), sit and repack to restore 5 HP once. With space remaining, you only inspect its contents.
events.F4-42.name: An Old Forest-Protection Sign
events.F4-42.scene: The forest sign’s letters have faded. Recarving earns wages; carrying it back for a new board earns travel supplies.
events.F4-42.action: Recarve the letters here or take the board to the workshop.
events.F4-42.result: Recarving grants 430G. Carrying grants one BD35.
events.F4-43.name: Practice Stands with Wood Shavings
events.F4-43.scene: A sword-striking stand sits beside a flute exercise that blows away shavings with a long exhale. Each has one vacancy.
events.F4-43.action: Try striking or practice the flute.
events.F4-43.result: Striking costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants SW34. Flute practice restores 5 MP.
events.F4-44.name: Branch Weaving across the Water
events.F4-44.scene: A craftsperson across the wetland awaits weaving materials. A near-side shop will buy the same load for cash.
events.F4-44.action: Sell to the near shop or deliver across the water for the finished piece.
events.F4-44.result: Near side grants 320G. Far side grants AR33.
events.F4-45.name: A Sleepy Night Watch’s Shift Token
events.F4-45.scene: The watch rubs their eyes and offers a shift token. A short replacement earns supplies; staying until dawn earns wages.
events.F4-45.action: Take a short watch or stay until dawn.
events.F4-45.result: Short grants one AT35. Until dawn costs 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants 580G.
events.F4-46.name: A Medic Spreading White Cloth
events.F4-46.scene: A medic needs two people to spread a large cloth visible through mist. Thanks can be treatment now or an item to carry.
events.F4-46.action: Tie the cloth to a tree and choose treatment here or a bag.
events.F4-46.result: Treatment restores 9 HP and 1 MP. The bag grants one HE37.
events.F4-47.name: A Test Lamp on the Path
events.F4-47.scene: An item shop tests whether a lamp burns to the end along the path. A travel item can also serve as payment toward armor.
events.F4-47.action: Give one BD36 for armor or simply watch the test lamp to restore your focus.
events.F4-47.result: Trading consumes one BD36 and grants AR39. Watching restores 3 MP, even without the item.
events.F4-48.name: A Taut Rope beneath the Branches
events.F4-48.scene: Mist hides the sawyer’s log-support rope. Leaves on one side rise in a line.
events.F4-48.action: Step over the leaf line and pass outside the log, or kick the leaves as you go.
events.F4-48.result: Outside is harmless. Kicking trips you on the rope, costing 5 HP (minimum 1 remaining).
events.F4-49.name: The Sap Bridge Handrail
events.F4-49.scene: One bridge rail is freshly coated in sap. A paid boat from the far bank can carry you and your load.
events.F4-49.action: Pay 150G for the boat or crouch and cross without touching the rail.
events.F4-49.result: The boat costs 150G and avoids injury. Crossing yourself costs 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining), even if you lack gold.
events.F4-50.name: Two Voices from the Air Hole
events.F4-50.scene: A rock air hole returns the bell twice. A distant guide left a note saying the second is an echo.
events.F4-50.action: Stop at the first sound or follow the second as though it were another bell.
events.F4-50.result: Stopping is harmless. Following loses your focus in the mist and costs 4 MP (minimum 0).
