events.B3-01.name: Payment for an Echo Check
events.B3-01.scene: A tunnel guard hands you a mallet. “A support that returns no sound is hollow.” The resonance is also shown by line length.
events.B3-01.action: Strike the three supports in turn and identify the one that produces no line at all.
events.B3-01.result: The hollow support earns 460G. If you choose a resonant one, the guard checks again and pays nothing.
events.B3-02.name: Counting Spilled Nails
events.B3-02.scene: Nails from a cart cling to pieces of ore. A carpenter wants only the nails recovered.
events.B3-02.action: Scrape them off with a wooden board, or quickly brush them away with a glove.
events.B3-02.result: Either way earns 380G. The board changes nothing else. The glove costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining), but lukewarm tea offered in thanks restores 3 MP.
events.B3-03.name: The Empty Cart on the Wrong Track
events.B3-03.scene: An empty cart bound for the foothills sits still with an uphill tag attached.
events.B3-03.action: Match the white powder on its wheels to the foothill track’s tag for white-powder loads.
events.B3-03.result: Correcting it to the foothills earns 520G. Choosing the summit makes the station worker fix it without paying.
events.B3-04.name: The Miner’s Lunchbox
events.B3-04.scene: A lunchbox sits between twisted rails. Its owner calls, “Look for the salted egg!”
events.B3-04.action: Retrieve it and show the egg picture on its lid, or just tell the miner where it is.
events.B3-04.result: Returning the box earns 410G. Giving directions instead restores 4 HP rather than gold, and the miner retrieves it.
events.B3-05.name: Recounting the Pit Props
events.B3-05.scene: There are too few pit props for work after the patrol. Three timbers on the valley side share the mine owner’s mark.
events.B3-05.action: Gather and haul the three marked timbers, or decline.
events.B3-05.result: Hauling costs 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and earns a combined payment of 610G. Declining changes nothing.
events.B3-06.name: Blades That Read the Rock
events.B3-06.scene: At the quarry, two blades are set against the same rock. A craftsperson points out vertical and horizontal seams.
events.B3-06.action: Split the vertical seam for SW21, or the horizontal seam for SW22.
events.B3-06.result: Receive one chosen sword. Vertical also restores 2 HP; horizontal restores 1 MP.
events.B3-07.name: The Hoist Shed’s Fitting Bench
events.B3-07.scene: A rope keeper sets two head-and-face protection samples on a bench. One is already finished.
events.B3-07.action: Choose the completed AR21, or commission AR22 for 1020G.
events.B3-07.result: The first grants AR21 for free. The second costs 1020G and grants AR22. You can choose AR21 without enough gold.
events.B3-08.name: Steel Seen by Tunnel Light
events.B3-08.scene: Only two swords are visible at the dark mine entrance. A hand mirror shines light onto a third farther back.
events.B3-08.action: Choose SW23 or SW24, or spend 1 MP to inspect SW25.
events.B3-08.result: The front grants one chosen sword. Choosing the back costs 1 MP and grants SW25. Without enough MP, choose from the front.
events.B3-09.name: The Load-Test Floor
events.B3-09.scene: Inspection tags on the workshop floor rearrange themselves to match your landing die result.
events.B3-09.action: On an odd roll, choose AR23 or AR24. On an even roll, choose AR24 or AR25.
events.B3-09.result: Receive the one displayed armor piece whose selection you confirm.
events.B3-10.name: The Furnace Awaiting Quenching
events.B3-10.scene: Before shutting down the furnace, a craftsperson offers two choices. Tempering a blade and making an armor clasp cannot be done together.
events.B3-10.action: Finish SW26 immediately, or rest while waiting for AR26.
events.B3-10.result: The sword grants SW26 and restores 2 MP. The armor grants AR26 and restores 3 HP.
events.B3-11.name: The Collided Coal Cart
events.B3-11.scene: Steadying a coal cart reveals weapons and armor beneath its load. The carrier asks which one you will take home.
events.B3-11.action: Choose SW27 or AR27 at either end, or reach for AR28 on the central stand.
events.B3-11.result: Either end grants the chosen equipment without further cost. The center costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining), grants AR28, and lets you wash your feet to restore 2 MP.
events.B3-12.name: A Constellation of Scrap Iron
events.B3-12.scene: Three scraps of iron float at a Magnet Golem’s shoulder. They return to its body one by one as it strengthens its magnetism.
events.B3-12.action: Sweep its shoulder with your first-turn normal attack, or step in to attack the body.
events.B3-12.result: Sweeping knocks off all the scraps but deals 0 damage on the first hit. The body takes normal damage. Remaining scraps disappear one at a time immediately before up to the next three enemy actions, adding 1 to the damage of each such action. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-13.name: A Rockfall Sign Reflected in Armor
events.B3-13.scene: An Armored Mole crosses beneath a yellow sign marking where overhead rocks will fall.
events.B3-13.action: Guard on your first turn to lure it beneath the sign, or attack away from it.
events.B3-13.result: Guarding blocks its first hit as normal, then falling rocks deal a fixed 4 damage to the enemy. Other actions move away from the sign, so the rocks miss. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-14.name: The East-West Compass
events.B3-14.scene: When a Magnet Golem stretches out its arm, a miner’s compass turns away from north toward the arm pointing east.
events.B3-14.action: Read the needle before battle and take your position north or opposite the needle.
events.B3-14.result: The opposite side puts the first magnetic pull out of reach, for 0 enemy damage on turn 1. North lets your first normal attack ignore defense, but the pull deals a fixed 3 damage. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-15.name: The Slick Coal Seam
events.B3-15.scene: An Armored Mole slides across the coal on its belly fittings. On its second run, it will reach the wall.
events.B3-15.action: Weather the first two turns, or defeat it before it crashes.
events.B3-15.result: On turns 1 and 2, the enemy telegraphs a slide dealing a fixed 3 damage. After the second slide, a surviving enemy hits the wall and loses 5 HP. Normal battle follows. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-16.name: A Red Swirl of Iron Sand
events.B3-16.scene: A ring of iron sand spreads around a Magnet Golem’s feet. One wooden platform lies outside it.
events.B3-16.action: Climb onto the wood before battle, or ready your sword inside the ring.
events.B3-16.result: On the wood, magnetic-pull damage is reduced by 3 for the first two turns, but your normal attacks are also weaker by 2. Inside the ring, both sides retain normal power. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-17.name: A Wedge beside the Rounded Back
events.B3-17.scene: An Armored Mole wedges itself into a rock fissure, exposing only its shell. A gap beside its back is just wide enough for your hand.
events.B3-17.action: Within the first two turns, guard while inserting a pebble into the gap, or strike from the front.
events.B3-17.result: Only on the turn after inserting the pebble, the enemy cannot retreat into its shell and your normal attack ignores defense. A frontal hit is reduced by 3 by the shell. From turn 3, both the gap and the shell’s extra reduction disappear. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-18.name: The Iron-Dust Pinwheel
events.B3-18.scene: A pinwheel spins right or left with the direction of a Magnet Golem’s arms. A wooden sign says, “Same direction: light. Opposite: heavy.”
events.B3-18.action: Before battle, secure the fitting in the same direction or the opposite one.
events.B3-18.result: Same direction restores 3 MP after your first normal attack. Opposite direction adds 4 to the next hit you deal after your first guard. Each benefit occurs once per battle. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-19.name: The Fading Mine Lamp
events.B3-19.scene: An Armored Mole pushes a stone beneath the lamp. A sign warns that the light will go out at the end of turn 2.
events.B3-19.action: Before then, cut the fuse cord with a normal attack, or keep aiming at the body.
events.B3-19.result: Cutting deals 0 body damage that turn and leaves a normal battle afterward. If turn 2 ends without cutting, your normal attack is halved on turn 3 only, rounded down. A backup lamp lights on turn 4. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-20.name: The Scrap Dealer’s Borrowed Wheel
events.B3-20.scene: A shop wheel starts rolling uphill, drawn by a Magnet Golem. You can see a wheel chock and a branching track.
events.B3-20.action: Set the chock before battle, or direct the branch toward the enemy.
events.B3-20.result: The chock reduces damage to 0 when you guard against the first powerful attack. The branch causes a collision at the end of turn 1 for a fixed 5 enemy damage and fixed 2 damage to you. Defeating the enemy on turn 1 prevents the collision. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-21.name: Ears That Feed on Stone Sounds
events.B3-21.scene: An Armored Mole waits with its shell shut, swinging its claws only at the sound of a sword striking the shell.
events.B3-21.action: Avoid a normal attack on turn 1, or strike the shell knowing it will counter.
events.B3-21.result: A first-turn normal attack deals its damage, then a surviving enemy counters for a fixed 4. With other actions, the enemy’s first turn misses, and its shell opens from the next telegraph onward. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-22.name: Two Lightning-Rod Nails
events.B3-22.scene: Old and new nails at a Magnet Golem’s feet connect to separate copper wires.
events.B3-22.action: Trace one wire before battle and drive either the enemy’s wire or the wire at your own feet into the ground.
events.B3-22.result: The enemy’s wire makes the golem lose 2 HP from recoil after its first normal attack. Your wire reduces the first positive damage you take by 3. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-23.name: Claws Clinging to the Ceiling
events.B3-23.scene: An Armored Mole shifts its claws along the ceiling. Sand falling from one foot signals its descent.
events.B3-23.action: Make a normal attack overhead on your first turn, or guard beneath the falling sand.
events.B3-23.result: Striking overhead hastens its fall, adding 3 to your hit but also 2 to its diving attack. Guarding gives normal reduction and also lowers enemy defense by 3 on the next turn. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-24.name: The Clinging Toolbox
events.B3-24.scene: A workshop box is stuck to a Magnet Golem. Its clasp loosens when you use one of its supplies.
events.B3-24.action: Use one owned combat consumable on your first turn, or attack the enemy through the box.
events.B3-24.result: A consumable has its normal effect, then the box falls on the enemy’s foot for a fixed 3 damage. Otherwise, on turn 1 only, the box reduces a direct hit to the enemy by 2 before falling off. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-25.name: The Red Signal in the Incline
events.B3-25.scene: An Armored Mole pushes a small freight cart. A red stop board hangs on the second support.
events.B3-25.action: Move the signal one support closer before battle, or leave it.
events.B3-25.result: Moving it makes the enemy stop instead of attacking on turn 1, but adds 3 to its body slam on turn 2. Leaving it gives a normal attack on turn 1, followed by a nonattacking stop on turn 2. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-26.name: Seven Marks on the Rock
events.B3-26.scene: Seven scale marks line a Magnet Golem’s chest. Pointing to the opposite face of your landing die shifts the ring on its chest.
events.B3-26.action: Before battle, choose the number that adds up to 7 with the displayed roll.
events.B3-26.result: A correct choice starts the enemy at 5 below maximum HP (minimum 1). A wrong choice costs you 2 MP (minimum 0 remaining) and starts the enemy at normal HP. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-27.name: The Waterskin Balance
events.B3-27.scene: A waterskin slowly empties on one end of a balance, opposite an Armored Mole’s forepaws.
events.B3-27.action: Use your first-turn normal attack to puncture the waterskin, or leave the small leak.
events.B3-27.result: Puncturing deals a fixed 4 enemy damage on turn 1, with that enemy action proceeding normally. Leaving it makes the balance spring up and cancel only the enemy action on turn 2. There is only one waterskin. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-28.name: The Red-Hot Band in the Rock
events.B3-28.scene: A Magnet Golem’s chest band glows red. You see a spell-spark symbol and a wet defensive plate.
events.B3-28.action: Use an attack spell to heat the band on turn 1, or guard to cool it with the plate.
events.B3-28.result: An attack spell adds 4 to its normal damage. Guarding hardens the band at the end of turn 1, making the enemy take 4 extra damage from a direct attack on the next turn. Other actions let the band cool. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-29.name: Sandbags on the Steep Slope
events.B3-29.scene: An Armored Mole stacks sandbags at the top of a slope. It will finish after its second turn.
events.B3-29.action: Redirect one normal attack toward the sandbags during the first two turns, or keep attacking the body.
events.B3-29.result: Hitting the sandbags collapses the stack and deals a fixed 2 enemy damage that turn. If left intact through two enemy turns, the stack adds 5 to the next powerful attack once, then collapses. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-30.name: The Statue Guarding the Mine Bell
events.B3-30.scene: At a side entrance, Stone Gatekeeper lifts a hanging bell. Its picture sign says, “Under the bell during the wide swing.”
events.B3-30.action: Return to the main path without fighting, or take the challenge and guard against its first wide swing.
events.B3-30.result: Declining gives no battle or reward. If you challenge and guard against the first wide swing, the bell falls to reduce damage to 0 and add 5 to your next normal attack. Other actions face a normal wide swing. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. You cannot flee after challenging. Losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B3-31.name: Removing the Ore Tags
events.B3-31.scene: The ledger lists the same number twice. A nail bag marked AT21 and a treatment bag marked HE21 are tied together.
events.B3-31.action: Put one back on the cart and receive the other.
events.B3-31.result: Returning AT21 grants one HE21. Returning HE21 grants one AT21.
events.B3-32.name: The Pulley Tool Keeper
events.B3-32.scene: An inspector offers a route-planning item. One shelf is free; the other requires a handling fee.
events.B3-32.action: Take BD21 for free, or arrange BD22 for 83G.
events.B3-32.result: Free grants one BD21. Paid costs 83G and grants one BD22. You can choose the free item without enough gold.
events.B3-33.name: The Tunnel Mouse’s Empty Nest
events.B3-33.scene: A patrol finds a small parcel in an old nest. The keeper wants to split the two items inside.
events.B3-33.action: Decide whether to give the keeper AT23 or HE23.
events.B3-33.result: Receive one of the item you did not give away. The keeper uses the other.
events.B3-34.name: Envelopes in the Ventilation Tower
events.B3-34.scene: Your landing die determines which door opens in a three-tier ventilation rack.
events.B3-34.action: Open the upper door for 1–2, middle for 3–4, or lower for 5–6.
events.B3-34.result: Upper grants one BD24, middle one HE24, and lower one AT24. The destination appears before you open the door.
events.B3-35.name: The Watchman Wiping His Brow
events.B3-35.scene: The night watchman takes two supplies from the table and asks you to leave one for the next person.
events.B3-35.action: Take HE25, take AT25, or leave both at the watch house.
events.B3-35.result: Receive one chosen item. Leaving both grants no items but restores 3 HP and 3 MP here.
events.B3-36.name: Two Warm Spring Streams
events.B3-36.scene: Two streams of hot water flow across bare rock. Mixing them in a bucket preserves a little of each benefit.
events.B3-36.action: Drink from the left stream, wash in the right, or mix them.
events.B3-36.result: Left restores 5 MP; right restores 8 HP; mixing restores 4 HP and 3 MP, up to their maximums.
events.B3-37.name: Dried Apricots atop the Slope
events.B3-37.scene: A young porter shares a split apricot, offering extra juice to anyone short of water.
events.B3-37.action: Check your remaining HP and MP, then take fruit or juice.
events.B3-37.result: Fruit restores 7 HP. Juice restores half your missing MP, rounded up.
events.B3-38.name: Deep Breaths at the Vent
events.B3-38.scene: A picture beside a rock-wall vent says, “Less baggage leaves more room to stretch your arms.”
events.B3-38.action: Check your inventory count, sit down, and breathe deeply.
events.B3-38.result: With 3 or fewer consumables, restore 7 HP and 3 MP. With 4 or more, restore 4 HP and 2 MP. No items are consumed.
events.B3-39.name: The Chain-Ladder Mining Inn
events.B3-39.scene: The inn’s window attendant sketches a tunnel map, coloring the monsters spotted this morning.
events.B3-39.action: Rest, shop, change jobs, or recruit, and inspect the map once before leaving.
events.B3-39.result: Reveal the nearest normal battle you have not passed, including the enemy’s name and unique behavior. If none exists, show “None.” Rest here for free once to restore half your maximum HP and half your maximum MP. Shopping, job changes, and companion recruitment are also available. Choose departure to finish.
events.B3-40.name: The Dining-Car Inn
events.B3-40.scene: A dining car taken off the tracks has become an inn. Herbs or salt can be added only while its soup is hot.
events.B3-40.action: Use the four facilities and request herbs or salt when resting.
events.B3-40.result: Once during rest, herbs reserve 2 MP restoration at the start of the next battle; salt reserves 3 HP restoration at that same time. The reservation expires in that battle. Rest here for free once to restore half your maximum HP and half your maximum MP. Shopping, job changes, and companion recruitment are also available. Choose departure to finish.
events.B3-41.name: The Miners’ Union Rest Stop
events.B3-41.scene: Job notices and price tags cover a desk. A diagram of the road ahead is pinned behind the bulletin board.
events.B3-41.action: Use the inn facilities, then turn over the diagram if you want to check for traps.
events.B3-41.result: Once, reveal the nearest trap space ahead and its available avoidance costs. If no trap lies ahead, show “None.” Rest here for free once to restore half your maximum HP and half your maximum MP. Shopping, job changes, and companion recruitment are also available. Choose departure to finish.
events.B3-42.name: The Road’s Weighing Stone
events.B3-42.scene: A miner calls, “Wages if you carry the ore, supplies if you break it up.”
events.B3-42.action: Carry it up the slope or break it into smaller chunks.
events.B3-42.result: Carrying costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and earns 540G. Breaking grants one AT26 instead of gold.
events.B3-43.name: The Old Message Tube
events.B3-43.scene: Digging sounds come from a wooden message tube. A rope beside it opens an escape hatch.
events.B3-43.action: Peer inside and challenge the Armored Mole, or open the escape hatch and pass through.
events.B3-43.result: Looking inside starts a normal battle against EN02. Only victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP plus equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards. The hatch avoids battle and restores 3 HP.
events.B3-44.name: A Mark Missing from the Wall Map
events.B3-44.scene: A surveyor has found a new fork and asks you to inspect either the stones underfoot or the nails overhead.
events.B3-44.action: Inspect the ground or the ceiling.
events.B3-44.result: Ground reveals the next 2 trap space numbers; ceiling reveals the next 2 battle space numbers. If fewer remain, show only those that exist.
events.B3-45.name: A Hot Stone and a Cold Stone
events.B3-45.scene: One stone warms your hands; the other cools your sword. A craftsperson has just one spare cloth bag.
events.B3-45.action: Choose the warm stone or the cold stone.
events.B3-45.result: Warm immediately restores 4 MP. Cold changes nothing now but restores 6 MP the first time a normal attack hits in the next battle.
events.B3-46.name: Today’s Scrap-Market Exchange
events.B3-46.scene: A small exchange stand trades combat supplies for travel supplies.
events.B3-46.action: Give one AT27 for two BD27, or decline.
events.B3-46.result: The trade succeeds only if you own AT27 and both new items fit in your bag after the exchange. Consume one AT27 and receive two BD27. Declining changes nothing.
events.B3-47.name: The Mining Courier’s Two Lamps
events.B3-47.scene: A courier asks for a battle lamp above the flag and a treatment lamp below it. You may use the leftover oil.
events.B3-47.action: Brighten the upper lamp or the lower one.
events.B3-47.result: Upper: in the next battle, deal 3 enemy damage immediately after first guarding against a powerful attack, if you survive. Lower: restore 5 HP and 1 MP now.
events.B3-48.name: The Gate That Will Not Drop
events.B3-48.scene: A grating has stopped halfway. Passing beneath requires a lifting tool or your strength.
events.B3-48.action: Rent a screw rod for 200G or lift it yourself.
events.B3-48.result: The rod costs 200G. Lifting costs 5 HP (minimum 1 remaining). One substitute ticket holds the grating in place with no other cost.
events.B3-49.name: The Thin Iron-Sand Bridge
events.B3-49.scene: Iron sand gathers only near metal fittings. Short crossing planks can cover half the bridge.
events.B3-49.action: Give one BD28 from your bag or slip across the thin section.
events.B3-49.result: BD28 consumes only that one item. Crossing costs 3 MP (minimum 0 remaining). One substitute ticket spares both BD28 and MP.
events.B3-50.name: Powder Snow on the Rock Ledge
events.B3-50.scene: Dry white powder crumbles from the tunnel. A cloth to cover your mouth and a board to shield your head lie nearby.
events.B3-50.action: Cover your mouth with the cloth or shield your head with the board.
events.B3-50.result: Cloth costs only 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining). The board spares HP but costs 3 MP (minimum 0 remaining). One substitute ticket spares both.

events.B4-01.name: Dew Washing the Lanterns
events.B4-01.scene: A lantern keeper washes mud from the waymarkers. Only the lantern bearing fox tracks has its emblem reversed.
events.B4-01.action: Compare the emblems and turn it to point correctly around the bend.
events.B4-01.result: The correct direction earns 520G for guiding travelers. If reversed, the keeper fixes it and pays nothing.
events.B4-02.name: The Appraiser’s Payment Slip
events.B4-02.scene: A Mist Fox has tricked a money changer. Of two payment slips, only the real one will not smudge when wet.
events.B4-02.action: Drop a little dew from a dish onto them and return the real slip to the money changer.
events.B4-02.result: The unsmudged slip earns 640G. The smudged one earns nothing.
events.B4-03.name: The Woodcutter’s Missing Glove
events.B4-03.scene: A glove deep in the thorns bears a star-shaped patch sewn by its owner. A woodcutter waits nearby.
events.B4-03.action: Crawl through the thorns to retrieve it, or point out branches that offer footing.
events.B4-03.result: Retrieving it costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and earns 710G. Giving directions earns no gold, but the woodcutter’s tea restores 3 MP.
events.B4-04.name: The Counting Song Is Wrong
events.B4-04.scene: One Mist Fox paw print has slipped onto a birdwatcher’s counting board among the migrating birds.
events.B4-04.action: Erase only the round paw print from the row of three-toed bird tracks.
events.B4-04.result: Erasing only the paw print earns 560G. Erasing a bird mark too forces a recount and earns nothing.
events.B4-05.name: A Passage Ledger Sewn Shut
events.B4-05.scene: A forest keeper’s ledger is caught in old Thorn Spider silk. Only one pair of scissors remains.
events.B4-05.action: Cut the straight thread, or pull the unknotted end to unravel it.
events.B4-05.result: Either earns 600G. Cutting changes nothing else. Unraveling costs 2 MP, but knot practice reduces the first positive damage you take in the next battle by 2. Without enough MP, you can cut.
events.B4-06.name: The Birch’s Labeled Shelf
events.B4-06.scene: Two sword tags hang from a birch. They come low enough to reach only on misty days.
events.B4-06.action: On a landing roll of 1–3, choose SW31 or SW32; on 4–6, choose SW32 or SW33.
events.B4-06.result: Receive one chosen sword from the two visible beneath the mist.
events.B4-07.name: The Eyes-Closed Tailor
events.B4-07.scene: A tailor offers armor: “Close your eyes and follow either thread. Both lead to your shelf.”
events.B4-07.action: Follow the wool for AR31, or the silk for AR32.
events.B4-07.result: Wool grants AR31 and restores 3 HP. Silk grants AR32 and restores 2 MP.
events.B4-08.name: The Sharpener Waiting for Mist
events.B4-08.scene: A sharpener can finish one sword immediately. Farther back is a stand where you may choose a preferred blade.
events.B4-08.action: Take the finished SW34, or order SW35 for 1760G or SW36 for 1830G.
events.B4-08.result: Free grants SW34. Ordering costs 1760G for SW35 or 1830G for SW36 and grants that sword. Without enough gold, take the free item.
events.B4-09.name: A Flagpole in the Old Nest
events.B4-09.scene: The missing town flag is tangled in an abandoned Thorn Spider nest. Its bearer holds a bundle of armor.
events.B4-09.action: Lower the flag and take AR33 or AR34, or ask for treatment here.
events.B4-09.result: Receive one chosen armor piece. Treatment grants no equipment but restores 8 HP and 2 MP.
events.B4-10.name: The Wolf-Shaped Wooden Token
events.B4-10.scene: A child’s wooden token forms a blade with its ears up and armor with its ears down.
events.B4-10.action: Make the SW37 pattern facing up, AR35 facing down, or AR36 sideways.
events.B4-10.result: Receive the one equipment piece matching your completed pattern from the craftsperson.
events.B4-11.name: The Web Bridge’s Cargo Platform
events.B4-11.scene: The bridge keeper’s cargo has two tiers. Reaching the upper one requires free hands to climb the threads.
events.B4-11.action: Take AR37 below, or compare SW38 and AR38 above if your bag holds 3 or fewer consumables.
events.B4-11.result: Reachable choices appear before you select one to receive. No items are discarded automatically to make room for this opportunity.
events.B4-12.name: The Tail That Will Not Float
events.B4-12.scene: A Mist Fox casts two tails onto the pond. Only one makes rings on the water.
events.B4-12.action: With your first-turn normal attack, aim at the tail touching the water or sweep aside the reflection without ripples.
events.B4-12.result: The ripples add 3 to normal damage. Sweeping the reflection deals 0 but dispels it, also making the enemy’s illusion fail that turn. No reflection remains from turn 2. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-13.name: The Thickest Cross-Thread
events.B4-13.scene: Two thin threads and one sagging under its own weight stretch toward you from a Thorn Spider’s web.
events.B4-13.action: With your first-turn normal attack, cut the thick support thread or a thin walking thread.
events.B4-13.result: The thick thread drops the web for a fixed 5 enemy damage. The thin thread deals 0 but weakens the first two enemy attacks by 2 each. You may also attack directly without cutting. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-14.name: The Clouded Hand Mirror
events.B4-14.scene: Only in a hand mirror does a Mist Fox show the two mouth shapes it will use next.
events.B4-14.action: Polish the mirror before battle, or turn it face down and tie its handle to your shield.
events.B4-14.result: Polishing reveals both of the first two turns’ telegraphs at the start of battle. Turning it down leaves normal one-turn telegraphs but reduces the first positive damage you take by 3. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-15.name: A Web Full of Morning Dew
events.B4-15.scene: When a Thorn Spider pulls its threads, raindrop-like dew falls on the front or back row. The front threads tighten first.
events.B4-15.action: While guarding on turn 1, hold a bowl in the front row or hide in the back.
events.B4-15.result: The bowl applies normal guard reduction, then restores 4 HP if you survive. The back row reduces the first turn’s dew damage to 0. Without guarding, the dew follows its telegraph. It runs out on turn 1. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-16.name: The Password in a Borrowed Voice
events.B4-16.scene: A Mist Fox disguised as a woodcutter asks in the woodcutter’s voice, “What do you check before felling a tree?” A tag at your feet reads “Bird nests.”
events.B4-16.action: Answer “Bird nests” before battle, or ready yourself without answering.
events.B4-16.result: The password startles the enemy into not attacking on turn 1; turn 2 proceeds normally. Silence begins combat immediately, but your first-turn attack spell costs 1 less MP (minimum 0). Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-17.name: Threads to Untie and Retie
events.B4-17.scene: A Thorn Spider has one loop around its legs and another around a branch. You cannot cut both at once.
events.B4-17.action: Untie the leg thread before battle, or retie the branch thread.
events.B4-17.result: Untying changes the enemy’s first powerful attack into a normal attack. Retying leaves that powerful attack intact, but afterward the enemy hits the branch for a fixed 6 damage. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-18.name: The Signpost Reflecting a Lie
events.B4-18.scene: An arrow before a Mist Fox reads, “Do not draw your sword.” Tiny paw prints accompany the writing on its back.
events.B4-18.action: Use your first-turn normal attack on the arrow, or slash directly at the enemy.
events.B4-18.result: Striking the arrow deals 0 enemy damage. Paw prints glow on its back and reduce the next illusion damage you take to 0. Slashing the enemy deals normal damage but adds 2 to its first-turn illusion. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-19.name: The Stump Strung like a Harp
events.B4-19.scene: A Thorn Spider stretches three threads like harp strings. Each turn, the vibrating one is marked with a circle, triangle, or square.
events.B4-19.action: For the first two turns only, you can aim your normal attack at the thread with the vibrating mark.
events.B4-19.result: Hitting the vibrating thread deals a fixed 3 enemy damage that turn and changes its telegraphed move into a normal attack. A wrong mark misses. You may attack the body directly. The threads come loose after two turns. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-20.name: Leaf Tags Tied to a Tail
events.B4-20.scene: A Mist Fox slides two leaf tags to your feet. Their fronts show fire; their backs show them turning into leaves again.
events.B4-20.action: Burn the leaves with an attack spell on turn 1, or use a normal attack without spending MP.
events.B4-20.result: A spell deals its normal damage and leaf smoke weakens the next enemy attack by 2. With a normal attack, the leaves raise enemy defense by 1 for that first hit, then disappear. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-21.name: The Red Berry Pendulum
events.B4-21.scene: A berry on a Thorn Spider’s thread swings between you and the enemy: first on its side, then on yours.
events.B4-21.action: Aim a normal attack at the berry on either of the first two turns, or ignore it and attack the body.
events.B4-21.result: Striking the berry replaces normal body damage with a fixed 5 damage to whichever side holds the berry that turn. If untouched, it falls harmlessly at the end of turn 2. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-22.name: Tracks of Healing Wounds
events.B4-22.scene: A Mist Fox sniffs the tracks of an injured foe. Its first-turn telegraph shows a nose and the words “Half or below.”
events.B4-22.action: If your HP is half or below, heal above half, guard, or defeat it first.
events.B4-22.result: If your HP is half or below immediately before the first enemy action, add 4 to that hit. Above half, it has normal power. This sniffing check occurs once per battle. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-23.name: Wind the Spool Backward
events.B4-23.scene: A Thorn Spider turns a wooden spool. Left alone, the thread pulling right will bind your shield.
events.B4-23.action: When guarding on turn 1, wind opposite the pictured arrow, or take a normal stance.
events.B4-23.result: Winding backward reduces first-turn damage to 0 and leaves guarding available next turn. A normal stance or another action resolves the first turn normally, then reduces your guard reduction by 2 on turn 2 only. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-24.name: One Star-Shaped Track
events.B4-24.scene: On the turn after a Mist Fox first falls to half HP or below, it spreads mist. Four shapes remain on the ground, but only one leaf is wet.
events.B4-24.action: During the first mist telegraph, point out the wet track or guard without following the tracks.
events.B4-24.result: A normal attack targeting the wet track ignores enemy defense. A wrong choice makes that hit deal 0. Guarding gives normal reduction and restores 2 MP. The mist lasts only this turn. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-25.name: The Long Thread Fishing for Your Bag
events.B4-25.scene: A Thorn Spider tugs your bag cord. The thread leads not to the enemy but to a wire on a crossbar.
events.B4-25.action: On turn 1, use an item to unhook the cord, strike the crossbar with a normal attack, or attack the body.
events.B4-25.result: An item disarms the trap with only its normal effect and consumption. The crossbar deals a fixed 3 enemy damage. If you choose neither, immediately after using an item on turn 2, a surviving enemy tightens the thread for a fixed 2 damage to you. The thread breaks at that turn’s end. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-26.name: Light beneath the Mushroom Cap
events.B4-26.scene: Mushroom reflections make a Mist Fox appear in two colors. Blue undersides absorb magic; white ones absorb damage.
events.B4-26.action: Break one blue or white cap before battle, leaving the other color’s reflection.
events.B4-26.result: Breaking blue leaves white to reduce the first direct damage to the enemy by 3. Breaking white leaves blue to increase your first attack spell’s MP cost by 1. Either reflection vanishes after its first use. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-27.name: A Round Shadow Falling through Mist
events.B4-27.scene: Mist settles among the trees, and a round shadow appears at your feet. A Mistbell Owl adopts a hunting stance on a branch.
events.B4-27.action: Watch the ground shadow and wing shape as you prepare for a dive.
events.B4-27.result: Fight a normal battle against Mistbell Owl. Victory grants 480G and 37 XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no victory rewards.
events.B4-28.name: Letters in Leaf Boats
events.B4-28.scene: “The reply arrives one turn late,” says a Mist Fox, floating two leaf boats marked with a sword and shield.
events.B4-28.action: Open the sword letter or shield letter before battle.
events.B4-28.result: Sword records the total direct damage you deal to the enemy on turn 1. Shield records the HP you actually lose on turn 1. At the start of turn 2, sword returns that amount as enemy damage and shield as healing to you, capped at 5. Only applies if battle reaches turn 2. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-29.name: Closing the Old Nest
events.B4-29.scene: A narrow door stands at the Thorn Spider’s burrow. When its HP first falls to half or below, it telegraphs a retreat through the door next turn.
events.B4-29.action: On that telegraphed turn, close the door with a normal attack, or chase the enemy through the open doorway and strike.
events.B4-29.result: Closing deals no follow-up damage but foils its retreat and makes it skip its next action too. Chasing deals normal damage; a surviving enemy then uses shell-like threads to reduce the next hit by 4. The door is used only once. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-30.name: The Ironclad Beetle at the Fallen Tree
events.B4-30.scene: An Ironclad Beetle on a side path scrapes its shell against a fallen tree. The forest keeper’s picture shows that light through the cracks signals an opening shell.
events.B4-30.action: Pass by, or take the challenge and make a normal attack on the first turn the shell opens.
events.B4-30.result: Passing gives no battle or reward. When challenging, a normal attack on the first turn the shell opens deals 5 extra damage. Attacks while closed face normal shell reduction. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. You cannot flee after challenging. Losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B4-31.name: The Twig Drying Rack
events.B4-31.scene: Beneath an old nest, supplies hang drying on three twigs marked with a shield, staff, and shoe.
events.B4-31.action: Take one package: combat item AT31, healing item HE31, or board item BD31.
events.B4-31.result: Receive one of the item you took down. Leave the others on the rack.
events.B4-32.name: The Woodpecker’s Hollow
events.B4-32.scene: A tree trunk has a small round hole and a large one. Only the large hole has a lid too heavy to release while reaching inside.
events.B4-32.action: Take HE32 from the small hole, or spend HP to retrieve AT32 from the large one.
events.B4-32.result: Small grants one HE32. Large costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and grants one AT32.
events.B4-33.name: A Promise in Leaf Wrapping
events.B4-33.scene: A courier who slipped shows you two packages. “One goes back to the village,” they say, asking which to keep.
events.B4-33.action: Choose BD33 or HE33 for your journey, or send the courier on without taking anything.
events.B4-33.result: Receive one chosen item. Taking nothing lets the courier warm your hands and restore 4 MP.
events.B4-34.name: Dew-Written Stationery
events.B4-34.scene: Two packages reveal their writing when dampened with dew. At first, only the AT34 tag on the left is visible.
events.B4-34.action: Take the left package, or spend 1 MP to receive BD34 on the right.
events.B4-34.result: Left grants one AT34. Right costs 1 MP and grants one BD34. With no MP, choose left.
events.B4-35.name: Spider Silk for Sandal Repairs
events.B4-35.scene: A forest keeper repairs one sandal strap. The supplies you carry in return depend on room in your bag.
events.B4-35.action: Check the space in your bag and accept a small delivery.
events.B4-35.result: With room for at least 2 items, receive one HE35 and one BD35. With room for 1 or fewer, choose only one of the two. If full, swap or decline.
events.B4-36.name: A Damp Wooden Lullaby
events.B4-36.scene: Tapping rain-soaked branches makes the leaves tremble, conveying the rhythm even with sound off. An elder offers two songs.
events.B4-36.action: Rest to the short song, or close your eyes to the long one.
events.B4-36.result: Short restores 6 HP and 2 MP. Long restores one quarter of maximum HP, rounded up, without changing MP.
events.B4-37.name: The Third Cup in the Mist
events.B4-37.scene: Three droplets sit on a bamboo-grass leaf, to be divided between HP and MP.
events.B4-37.action: Choose 0–3 droplets for HP, leaving the rest for MP.
events.B4-37.result: Each HP droplet restores 3 HP; each MP droplet restores 2 MP. Use no more than 3 droplets total.
events.B4-38.name: The Bird-Feather Mat
events.B4-38.scene: A forest keeper lends you half a feather mat. Water remains in a pillow of leaves.
events.B4-38.action: Rest on just the feathers, or share the pillow’s water too.
events.B4-38.result: Feathers alone restore 8 HP. Using the pillow restores 4 HP and 4 MP, up to their maximums.
events.B4-39.name: The Many-Windowed Mushroom Inn
events.B4-39.scene: Four round windows glow with the kitchen, shop, job-advice office, and companions’ lounge.
events.B4-39.action: Use the four facilities, then pour just one cup from the windowsill kettle before departing.
events.B4-39.result: One cup of leaf tea restores 2 of your chosen HP or MP. It remains available even after normal rest. Rest here for free once to restore half your maximum HP and half your maximum MP. Shopping, job changes, and companion recruitment are also available. Choose departure to finish.
events.B4-40.name: The Forest Keeper’s Raised-Floor Inn
events.B4-40.scene: Above the damp ground, a raised floor holds a rest area and three service desks. A patrol ledger hangs on the door.
events.B4-40.action: Read the ledger between resting, shopping, changing jobs, and recruiting companions.
events.B4-40.result: The ledger reveals the nearest normal-battle enemy ahead and the first battlefield clue you will see. If none exists, it shows “None.” Rest here for free once to restore half your maximum HP and half your maximum MP. Shopping, job changes, and companion recruitment are also available. Choose departure to finish.
events.B4-41.name: The Twisted Cedar Supply Inn
events.B4-41.scene: The shop at the roots and the tavern share one roof. Before you leave, the host offers to retie your sandals.
events.B4-41.action: Use the four facilities and choose a tight knot or a bow.
events.B4-41.result: Once here, a tight knot reduces the next board trap’s HP loss by 2; a bow reduces its MP loss by 2. The effect expires on the first loss of the chosen type. Rest here for free once to restore half your maximum HP and half your maximum MP. Shopping, job changes, and companion recruitment are also available. Choose departure to finish.
events.B4-42.name: One of the Forest Keeper’s Gloves
events.B4-42.scene: Nuts are scattered over a log the keeper must cross. Two rewards are offered for lending a hand.
events.B4-42.action: Gather the nuts for spending money, or steady the log and receive treatment.
events.B4-42.result: Gathering costs 2 MP and earns 650G. Steadying costs nothing and restores 8 HP. You can steady it without enough MP.
events.B4-43.name: The Half-Open Birdcage
events.B4-43.scene: A Mist Fox hides in a wooden birdcage. A side path leads toward distant running water.
events.B4-43.action: Open the cage and fight, or catch your breath on the side path.
events.B4-43.result: Opening starts a normal battle against EN06. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP plus equipment and item drop rolls; fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards. The side path avoids battle and restores 4 MP.
events.B4-44.name: The Owner of an Old Earring
events.B4-44.scene: A hunter searching for an earring remembers the dawn road to the left and the evening road to the right. You can illuminate two markers.
events.B4-44.action: Use the left marker to inspect two places ahead, or the right to inspect one in detail.
events.B4-44.result: Left reveals up to the next 2 unpassed equipment space numbers. Right reveals the nearest equipment space number and its initially displayed reward candidates. Also shows if none exists.
events.B4-45.name: The Fluff Fire Keeper
events.B4-45.scene: A hunter asks you to share some fire, but also knows another way to gather fuel.
events.B4-45.action: Spend 3 MP or gather dry firewood.
events.B4-45.result: Spending 3 MP offers one AT36 and one HE36 for collection. Firewood offers one BD36. Each offered item can be swapped or declined according to bag space.
events.B4-46.name: A Cloth for a Tailwind
events.B4-46.scene: A forest dyer stretches one cloth into the mist. A weak breeze suits a sudden strike; a strong one suits lasting defense.
events.B4-46.action: Twist the cloth narrow or spread it wide.
events.B4-46.result: Narrow adds 4 to your first-turn normal attack in the next battle. Wide restores 4 HP, if you survive, at the end of the first turn you choose guard in the next battle.
events.B4-47.name: Oil Money for the Patrol Lamp
events.B4-47.scene: A tower keeper shows the remaining oil, wondering whether to order more from town or use the small flame for treatment now.
events.B4-47.action: Pay 112G to order one BD37, or borrow the lamp to warm yourself.
events.B4-47.result: Ordering costs 112G and grants one BD37. Warming is free and restores 4 HP and 3 MP. You can warm yourself without enough gold.
events.B4-48.name: The Return Path Sewn Shut
events.B4-48.scene: Fine thorn threads gather at shoe height. Stepping through would send thorns flying.
events.B4-48.action: Pay the forest keeper 220G to part them, or gather the threads by hand.
events.B4-48.result: The keeper costs 220G; your hands cost 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining). One substitute ticket prevents the thorns from springing and causes no other loss.
events.B4-49.name: The Hollow of White Breath
events.B4-49.scene: White mist rises at your feet. Borrowed bellows could clear it, or you could dash through a thin patch in one breath.
events.B4-49.action: Pay 160G for the bellows, or choose to spend HP or MP crossing through.
events.B4-49.result: Renting costs 160G. Crossing costs either 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) or 3 MP (minimum 0 remaining). One substitute ticket can also prevent all losses.
events.B4-50.name: The Dye Marsh beneath the Leaves
events.B4-50.scene: One step into a marsh of dye plants changes your shoes’ color. The forest keeper’s washing bench is almost within reach.
events.B4-50.action: Wash them yourself using willpower, or use one HE38 to remove the mud.
events.B4-50.result: Washing costs 4 MP (minimum 0 remaining). HE38 consumes one item without MP loss. One substitute ticket spares both the item and MP.

events.B5-01.name: Paying Twice for a Statue
events.B5-01.scene: A mason’s invoice lists “left wing” and “shadow of the right wing” as separate items.
events.B5-01.action: Compare it with the sunlit wall and cancel the shadow entry.
events.B5-01.result: Canceling the shadow prevents an overpayment and earns 760G from the mason. Canceling the actual wing is corrected and earns no tip.
events.B5-02.name: A Day’s Pay Pulling Moat Nets
events.B5-02.scene: An old wheel is caught in a net before the castle gate, blocking the small opening that lets fish escape.
events.B5-02.action: Lift the wheel or undo the net’s knots.
events.B5-02.result: Either repairs the net and earns 820G. Lifting costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining). Unknotting costs 2 MP. Without enough MP, you can lift.
events.B5-03.name: The Toy Horse in the Watch Window
events.B5-03.scene: A child’s wooden horse has fallen into a narrow watch window, leaving its ears visible. A carpenter offers a forked pole and a round-ended pole.
events.B5-03.action: Choose the forked pole, hook it between the ears, and pull the horse back.
events.B5-03.result: The forked pole earns 690G. The round end knocks the horse inside, where the guard retrieves it without paying you.
events.B5-04.name: Checking the Bell Tower’s Leak
events.B5-04.scene: The bell keeper puzzles over three buckets. Despite the rain, only the drum-shaped bucket is losing water.
events.B5-04.action: Seal the crack in the bucket whose level is dropping, or clean the wet stairs.
events.B5-04.result: Fixing the bucket earns 900G. The stairs grant one HE41 instead of gold.
events.B5-05.name: The Drawbridge’s Final Ticket Check
events.B5-05.scene: Two curled horns carved on a genuine gate pass face inward. The final delivery cart waits.
events.B5-05.action: Give only the inward-facing pass to the guard and return the outward-facing one to the inspection box.
events.B5-05.result: Sorting both correctly earns 1000G. If either is wrong, the guard checks again and pays nothing.
events.B5-06.name: Weapon Repairs around the Wall
events.B5-06.scene: A weapon repair master has different swords for helpers who stop a large gear by hand or with a lever.
events.B5-06.action: Stop it by hand for SW41, or with the lever for SW42.
events.B5-06.result: Hands cost 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining), grant SW41, and restore 3 MP. The lever grants SW42 without consuming anything.
events.B5-07.name: The Shield Shop’s Gutter
events.B5-07.scene: Rain blows into the town shield shop. The owner asks you to put front armor back up or bring a rear piece down.
events.B5-07.action: Help at the front for AR41, or spend 2 MP lighting the dark shelf to choose AR42.
events.B5-07.result: The front grants AR41. The rear costs 2 MP and grants AR42. Without enough MP, help at the front.
events.B5-08.name: Choosing a Hilt at the Castle Workshop
events.B5-08.scene: At the gate workshop, you may have one cargo box unsealed. Every box has its purpose marked outside.
events.B5-08.action: Compare free SW43 or SW44 with special-order SW45 for 2390G.
events.B5-08.result: A free choice grants that sword. Ordering costs 2390G and grants SW45. You can take a free sword without buying.
events.B5-09.name: The Forgotten Ceremonial Wardrobe
events.B5-09.scene: Armor left by a disbanded band bears die marks matching its number of fasteners.
events.B5-09.action: For a landing roll of 1 or 6, try AR43; for 2 or 5, AR44; for 3 or 4, AR45. Or decline.
events.B5-09.result: Receive the armor you try. Declining gives no equipment, but backstage water restores 5 MP.
events.B5-10.name: The Toy-Bridge Equipment Shop
events.B5-10.scene: A child arranges blocks to imitate a stone bridge. A real equipment seller has prepared a reward.
events.B5-10.action: Add a roof to the bridge for AR46, or open a road through it for SW46.
events.B5-10.result: The roof grants AR46 and restores 3 HP. The road grants SW46 and restores 2 MP.
events.B5-11.name: A Share before the Storehouse Closes
events.B5-11.scene: The castle storehouse is closing. The guard offers to open the rear shelves for a hero who has pressed on despite injuries.
events.B5-11.action: Compare AR47 and SW47. If your HP is half or below, also inspect AR48 and SW48 at the back.
events.B5-11.result: Items available at your current HP appear before confirmation. Receive one chosen equipment piece, with no healing or payment.
events.B5-12.name: The Rain-Spouting Jaw
events.B5-12.scene: Rainwater fills a Rampart Gargoyle’s mouth. On turn 1, it will spit it all along the wall. A passage toward the moat stands open.
events.B5-12.action: Choose the wall side to target its jaw before battle, or the moat side to leave its line of fire.
events.B5-12.result: Wall adds 4 to your first-turn normal attack, but a surviving enemy’s water jet deals a fixed 4. Moat avoids the jet for 0 damage, but your first-turn normal attack also cannot reach and deals 0. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-13.name: The Archers’ Empty Tower
events.B5-13.scene: A Thorn Spider’s thread draws a bow in an empty tower. Its arrow points at the center of the web.
events.B5-13.action: Strike the thread with your first-turn normal attack, or leave the bow alone.
events.B5-13.result: The thread deals a fixed 5 enemy damage on turn 1. Left untouched, guarding on turn 2 makes the arrow deal a fixed 7 enemy damage before the next enemy action. The bow cannot be used after turn 2. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-14.name: The Stone Hand Holding Time
events.B5-14.scene: A Rampart Gargoyle holds a clock face. The short hand points to one, the long hand to three.
events.B5-14.action: Before battle, remove the retaining ring marked one or three.
events.B5-14.result: One makes the enemy pick up the face instead of attacking on turn 1. Three drops it at the start of turn 3, reducing the enemy’s remaining HP by 7. Defeating it earlier gives no extra falling damage. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-15.name: Thorns Sewn into a Banner
events.B5-15.scene: A Thorn Spider sews thorns into a banner that will topple toward you in the wind. A white arrow shows the wind direction on turn 1 only.
events.B5-15.action: While guarding on turn 1, move behind the banner or shelter beneath a stall’s eaves.
events.B5-15.result: Behind the banner, thorns deal a fixed 4 enemy damage while normal guard reduces the direct attack against you that turn. The eaves reduce first-turn damage to 0 but do not hurt the enemy. The wind blows just once. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-16.name: One Wing in Sunlight
events.B5-16.scene: A Rampart Gargoyle’s right wing shines in sunlight; its left is dark with rain. The sun will hide behind clouds after turn 1.
events.B5-16.action: Aim your first-turn normal attack at the sunlit wing or rain-soaked wing.
events.B5-16.result: Sunlight adds 3 damage to this hit. The rainy wing reduces damage by 2 but unbalances the enemy, reducing its damage dealt on turn 2 by 4. Other first-turn actions proceed normally. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-17.name: The Mimicking Printing Press
events.B5-17.scene: Behind the town press, a Thorn Spider watches only your first stance through a woodblock.
events.B5-17.action: Guard on turn 1 to print a defensive pose, or use a normal attack to print a sword.
events.B5-17.result: Guard makes the enemy defend without attacking on turn 1, then reduces damage it takes on turn 2 by 2. A normal attack is followed by a surviving enemy’s normal attack. Spells or items make no picture, so the enemy skips its first turn. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-18.name: Repair Tags at the Statue’s Feet
events.B5-18.scene: Two repair tags at a Rampart Gargoyle’s pedestal show a wing and a base. You can redirect the rainwater.
events.B5-18.action: Before battle, channel rain into the wing’s chipped edge or the pedestal’s crack.
events.B5-18.result: Wing reduces the first powerful attack’s damage by 4. Pedestal deals a fixed 4 damage from the splitting crack immediately after the enemy first falls to half HP or below, if it survives. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-19.name: The Spider Weighing Packages
events.B5-19.scene: A scale at a Thorn Spider’s feet reads, “More baggage pulls the thread tighter.” You can see your current item count.
events.B5-19.action: Place your bag on the scale before battle, or keep it on your shoulder.
events.B5-19.result: The scale reduces the first-turn enemy attack by your consumable count, up to 6, but prevents item use on turn 1. Shoulder allows items from turn 1 without extra reduction. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-20.name: The Cuckoo Clock’s Little Window
events.B5-20.scene: A Rampart Gargoyle eyes the bell. The bird’s little window opens once at the start and once on turn 3.
events.B5-20.action: Unfasten the little window at the start, or keep it shut and protect it.
events.B5-20.result: Unfastening makes the first enemy action merely chase the bird. Keeping it shut starts a normal battle, then the bird restores 5 MP at the start of turn 3. If battle does not reach turn 3, no healing occurs. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-21.name: A Thread through Three Arches
events.B5-21.scene: A Thorn Spider has threaded three bridge arches. A diagram shows that pulling both ends doubles the pull in the middle.
events.B5-21.action: Pull one end or both ends together before battle.
events.B5-21.result: On the first turn you guard, one end causes a fixed 3-damage recoil to the enemy. Both cause a fixed 6 to the enemy and a fixed 2 to you that same turn. Resolve recoil once, only if you survive and the enemy remains. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-22.name: The Gate-Tax Money Box
events.B5-22.scene: A Rampart Gargoyle shakes a box in one hand. The gatekeeper says donated coins will weigh its arm down.
events.B5-22.action: Put 100G in the box before battle, or challenge it head-on for free.
events.B5-22.result: Donating costs 100G and weakens each of the first two enemy normal attacks by 3. Declining or lacking gold gives a free normal battle. Both choices share the same battle rewards. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-23.name: Foam at the Castle Washstand
events.B5-23.scene: A Thorn Spider shoots thread on turn 1. Wet webbing washes away, but soapy webbing sticks to your feet. One pump gives water; two give foam.
events.B5-23.result: Water makes the first enemy action a normal attack. Foam makes the first thread attack deal base 3 damage; taking at least 1 also costs you 1 MP. In return, the first healing item you use this battle also restores 3 MP. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-24.name: The Gate’s Latticed Window
events.B5-24.scene: A Rampart Gargoyle’s spear passes through window bars every other turn. The crossbar starts one level higher.
events.B5-24.action: Before battle, secure the window in the low hole to protect turn 1, or the high hole to protect turn 2.
events.B5-24.result: Only on the chosen turn, the bars reduce direct enemy damage by 4. Other turns retain normal power. The window closes at the end of turn 2. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-25.name: The Airmail Thread
events.B5-25.scene: A Thorn Spider has turned a suspended mail box upside down. Pictures underneath show envelopes that will fall on the next delivery.
events.B5-25.action: On turn 1, knock down the blue or red envelope with a normal attack.
events.B5-25.result: Blue deals 0 body damage and restores 5 MP to you. Red deals a fixed 4 enemy damage but strengthens the enemy’s turn-2 hit by 2. You may ignore the envelopes and attack the body. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-26.name: A Test Strike on Double Doors
events.B5-26.scene: A Rampart Gargoyle shields itself with one door and prepares to throw the second. Their hinges are linked above and below.
events.B5-26.action: Break the front door with a first-turn normal attack, or raise your shield and wait for the second.
events.B5-26.result: Breaking deals 0 first-hit damage but drops the throwing door too, making the first enemy action miss. Guarding reduces the thrown door’s base 5 damage normally, then both broken doors deal a fixed 5 enemy damage. With other actions, the front door reduces the first hit to the enemy by 2, and the enemy throws the second. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-27.name: The Old Stage Lift
events.B5-27.scene: A Thorn Spider works threads beneath a theater floor. Red and blue boards rise when it reaches half HP.
events.B5-27.action: Unfasten the red or blue board before battle.
events.B5-27.result: The first time enemy HP falls to half or below and it survives, red launches it upward for a fixed 5 damage. Blue lifts you clear, reducing the next direct enemy attack to 0. Each occurs once per battle. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-28.name: Stone Feet Following the Streetlamp
events.B5-28.scene: Only a Rampart Gargoyle’s shadow walks along the wall. The lamp base reads, “Move it one step, and the body follows one step.”
events.B5-28.action: Guard on turn 1 to move the lamp, or leave it and slash at the body.
events.B5-28.result: Moving the lamp brings the enemy down one level. Thereafter, both your and the enemy’s normal attacks deal 2 extra damage for this battle. Leaving it keeps both unchanged. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-29.name: Slack in the Hoisting Rope
events.B5-29.scene: A Thorn Spider’s thread has caught the wall’s hoisting rope. When the empty basket lands, its telegraph reads “The rope slackens.”
events.B5-29.action: On turn 2’s “The rope slackens,” make a normal attack, or guard and wait to be hoisted.
events.B5-29.result: A normal attack that turn ignores enemy defense. Guarding rides the basket to take 0 damage and adds 3 to HP restored by a healing item you use on turn 3. The mechanism works only once. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-30.name: The Last Footsteps by the Moat
events.B5-30.scene: A Mist Wolf creates decoys in a side fort. Only one trail of footprints continues unbroken from wet stones to dry ones.
events.B5-30.action: Pass, or take the challenge and aim a normal attack at the opponent with continuous tracks during the first decoy phase.
events.B5-30.result: Passing gives no battle or reward. When challenging, only the first decoy phase adds 6 to a normal attack on the correct real body. A wrong choice deals 0. Later decoys use normal footprint identification. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. You cannot flee after challenging. Losing grants no battle rewards.
events.B5-31.name: The Tailors’ Street Bandage Box
events.B5-31.scene: A town aid box sits beneath the wall scaffolding. A watchman hands one package to each passerby.
events.B5-31.action: Take HE42 or HE43, or leave the supplies and receive treatment here.
events.B5-31.result: Receive one chosen healing item. Treatment grants no item but restores 9 HP.
events.B5-32.name: The Town Shop Tying Cargo Tags
events.B5-32.scene: Packages returned by a hunting squad bear combat and board-supply tags.
events.B5-32.action: Take one AT42, or add 330G to take two BD42.
events.B5-32.result: Free grants one AT42. Paid costs 330G and grants two BD42. You cannot confirm payment unless you can make room for both items.
events.B5-33.name: Spare Supplies beneath the Bucket
events.B5-33.scene: A final check before the gate closes reveals red and blue packages behind a water bucket.
events.B5-33.action: Check whether your landing roll is odd or even to collect the spare package.
events.B5-33.result: Odd grants one AT43; even grants one BD43. Item details appear before collection.
events.B5-34.name: Scaffolding on the Outer Wall
events.B5-34.scene: The scaffolding master lets you choose which load to lower. A heavy package takes two people.
events.B5-34.action: Alone, choose HE44 or BD44. With a companion, AT44 is also available.
events.B5-34.result: Available items appear on screen. Receive one specified item. Without a companion, two choices still remain.
events.B5-35.name: A Share from the Bell Tower
events.B5-35.scene: Two packages remain after bell repairs. The keeper offers one for free, or asks for help if you want both.
events.B5-35.action: Take AT45 or HE45, or polish the bell to receive both.
events.B5-35.result: One choice grants one specified item for free. Both cost 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and offer one AT45 and one HE45 for collection. If full, swap or decline.
events.B5-36.name: The Stone Foot-Washing Baths
events.B5-36.scene: A warm winter bath and a small cold-water bath stand beside the road to the gate.
events.B5-36.action: Stay longer in the warm bath, or alternate between warm and cold.
events.B5-36.result: A long soak restores 10 HP. Alternating restores 5 HP and, only if MP is half or below, an additional 4 MP.
events.B5-37.name: The Quiet Outer Moat Chapel
events.B5-37.scene: As you steady your breathing before the lamp, a white line on a pitcher reflects your remaining MP.
events.B5-37.action: Check your MP, then drink the water or cup the pitcher in both hands.
events.B5-37.result: Drinking restores 8 HP. Holding the pitcher raises MP to half maximum, rounded up, if it is currently below half; if already at least half, restore just 2 MP.
events.B5-38.name: The Gatekeeper’s Late-Night Porridge
events.B5-38.scene: Two bowls of porridge remain. The gatekeeper gives a dry ember to anyone choosing the small bowl.
events.B5-38.action: Choose the large bowl or small bowl.
events.B5-38.result: Large restores 12 HP. Small restores 5 HP and reserves 3 MP restoration at the start of the next battle. The ember then goes out.
events.B5-39.name: The Outer Moat Winding-Bridge Inn
events.B5-39.scene: An inn sits beneath a hand-cranked bridge. Its back door overlooks a watchtower on the route to the castle.
events.B5-39.action: Rest, shop, change jobs, or recruit, then investigate one thing at the watchtower.
events.B5-39.result: Once, check either the nearest normal-battle enemy ahead or the next equipment space’s reward candidates. If no target exists, “None” appears before confirmation. Rest here for free once to restore half your maximum HP and half your maximum MP. Shopping, job changes, and companion recruitment are also available. Choose departure to finish.
events.B5-40.name: The Stone Carver’s Inn
events.B5-40.scene: The host puts a small statue beside your bed and smiles: you may make one wish.
events.B5-40.action: Use the four facilities. When resting, turn either the “Attack” or “Defense” statue toward you.
events.B5-40.result: Once when resting here, Attack adds 2 damage to your first normal attack that hits in the next battle. Defense reduces the first positive damage you take by 2. Rest here for free once to restore half your maximum HP and half your maximum MP. Shopping, job changes, and companion recruitment are also available. Choose departure to finish.
events.B5-41.name: The Last Inn Lit by the Gate
events.B5-41.scene: In the final margin of the travel ledger, the gatekeeper circles, “Check your bag space first.”
events.B5-41.action: Rest, shop, change jobs, or recruit. Also choose one travel supply before departure.
events.B5-41.result: Receive one HE46 or BD46. If your bag is full, swap or decline. Reopening the facilities does not grant more supplies. Rest here for free once to restore half your maximum HP and half your maximum MP. Shopping, job changes, and companion recruitment are also available. Choose departure to finish.
events.B5-42.name: Night Patrol at the Market
events.B5-42.scene: After the closing bell, a shopkeeper offers two tasks: “Patrol the lanes, or watch the storefront.”
events.B5-42.action: Walk a circuit of the lanes, or watch the fire at the storefront.
events.B5-42.result: The circuit costs 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and earns 950G. Watching the fire earns no gold but restores 5 HP and 4 MP.
events.B5-43.name: An Order for a Moving Gargoyle
events.B5-43.scene: A rain-spout statue takes a step. The mason leaves it to you to defeat it or close the waterway and put it to sleep.
events.B5-43.action: Challenge the Rampart Gargoyle or close the door.
events.B5-43.result: Challenging starts a normal battle against EN08. Victory grants enemy-specific gold and XP plus equipment and item drop rolls; fleeing or losing grants no battle rewards. Closing avoids battle and grants one BD47 in thanks.
events.B5-44.name: The Last Pair of Marching Boots
events.B5-44.scene: The gate’s cobbler ties boots differently for those scouting the road and those guarding against powerful attacks.
events.B5-44.action: Loosen the laces to scout ahead, or tie them tight and ready yourself.
events.B5-44.result: Loose reveals all remaining normal-battle space numbers through 100. Tight gives 4 extra reduction after normal reduction only when guarding against the first powerful attack in the next battle.
events.B5-45.name: The Exchange Window at the Gate
events.B5-45.scene: A castle courier opens a window to trade unneeded board supplies for something useful now.
events.B5-45.action: Give one owned BD48 for AT48 or HE48, or close the window.
events.B5-45.result: Trading consumes one BD48 and grants one specified item. Without BD48, or if you close the window, your inventory is unchanged.
events.B5-46.name: The Stargazing Platform over the Moat
events.B5-46.scene: At the foot of the platform stairs, a child shows you sword and shield constellations.
events.B5-46.action: Draw the sword or shield as you face the castle.
events.B5-46.result: Sword adds 5 damage to the first attack spell in the next battle. Shield restores 5 MP after the first positive damage you take in that battle, if you survive. Both expire when battle ends.
events.B5-47.name: The Two Remaining Passes
events.B5-47.scene: The gatekeeper’s passes read “Treatment now” and “Supplies later.” One must be returned before entering the castle.
events.B5-47.action: Receive treatment now, or choose a package to take along.
events.B5-47.result: Treatment restores one third of maximum HP, rounded up. A package grants one HE49 or AT49.
events.B5-48.name: The Stone Wicket Gate
events.B5-48.scene: The small gate rises only partway. Buying a replacement gear would let you remove the rusty wedge.
events.B5-48.action: Replace the gear for 300G, or force through with your shoulder.
events.B5-48.result: Replacement costs 300G. Forcing through costs 6 HP (minimum 1 remaining). One substitute ticket lets you pass unharmed without replacing the gear.
events.B5-49.name: The Opening Plank over the Moat
events.B5-49.scene: A broken tread opens a gap at the drawbridge edge. Besides a rope seller’s wares, an item in your bag could serve as a wedge.
events.B5-49.action: Buy rope for 220G, use one BD50, or climb using your strength.
events.B5-49.result: Rope costs 220G; the item consumes one BD50; climbing costs 5 HP (minimum 1 remaining). One substitute ticket lets you pass without any of these costs.
events.B5-50.name: Mist Blocking the Castle Wall
events.B5-50.scene: Damp mist surges into a narrow doorway. Turning a handle stirs wind, or you can shield your face and walk straight through.
events.B5-50.action: Turn the handle or pass through the mist without turning it.
events.B5-50.result: Turning costs 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining). Mist costs 5 MP (minimum 0 remaining). One substitute ticket carries you through without losing HP or MP.
