events.H1-01.name: The Shepherd’s Embroidery
events.H1-01.scene: Windblown sheep tags are tangled in rapeseed flowers outside the fence.
events.H1-01.action: Compare the ear patterns with the tags’ embroidery and hang them on the owner’s fence.
events.H1-01.result: The shepherd can separate the flock again and pays you 150G.
events.H1-02.name: A Beehive on a Blanket
events.H1-02.scene: After the rain, a hive tilts in the field. The beekeeper must hold it with both hands and cannot move.
events.H1-02.action: Use an empty blanket as a stretcher to carry the hive onto dry stone.
events.H1-02.result: The honey stays safely inside, and you receive 220G in thanks.
events.H1-03.name: White Feathers in the Postal Field
events.H1-03.scene: A delivery bird sets its bag in a vegetable field and shows you a receipt wrapped around one leg.
events.H1-03.action: Sort bundles of letters into village boxes and stamp the receipt at the last one.
events.H1-03.result: Receive 180G for taking over the delivery.
events.H1-04.name: Morning Shift at the Treadwheel
events.H1-04.scene: The mill keeper’s daughter cannot stop sneezing, and the seedlings await water.
events.H1-04.action: Walk inside the wheel to pump water, stepping out once it reaches the final furrow.
events.H1-05.name: One Uncut Strip
events.H1-05.scene: A single strip of tall grass remains, with chicks chirping at its roots.
events.H1-05.action: Leave the nesting row intact, cut only the outer grass, and wipe your blade clean.
events.H1-05.result: The master mower gives you a spare SW01. Receive one sword.
events.H1-06.name: The Windbreak Fitting Stand
events.H1-06.scene: A young seamstress tests the hems of two outfits on scarecrows in the wind.
events.H1-06.action: Stand once upwind and once downwind, then point to the easier outfit to walk in.
events.H1-06.result: Compare AR01 and AR02 and take home one armor piece.
events.H1-07.name: Small Hands at the Rusty Gate
events.H1-07.scene: Before a sleeping watchdog, a kid goat has its head stuck between the bars.
events.H1-07.action: Widen the gap with a stone wedge, then remove it once the horns are through.
events.H1-07.result: Receive SW03 from the gatekeeper’s spare supplies. The goat is not startled, and no battle occurs.
events.H1-08.name: A Back to Carry the Flag
events.H1-08.scene: A young standard-bearer has hurt an arm but refuses to lay the departure flag in the dirt.
events.H1-08.action: Tie the flagpole to your back and walk together to the farewell seats.
events.H1-08.result: The procession’s outfitter gives you AR04. You may keep it without equipping it immediately.
events.H1-09.name: White Tracks at the Miller’s
events.H1-09.scene: Tracks from a split flour sack lead to a Field Mouse Swordsman cutting a sack cart’s rope.
events.H1-09.action: Shake an empty sack to raise flour dust and draw the enemy away from the cart.
events.H1-09.result: Fight EN01. The white flour reveals its footing, reducing the first damage you take from the enemy by 2. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H1-10.name: A Helmet beneath the Seedbed
events.H1-10.scene: A row of seedlings rises from one end. An Armored Mole is directly beneath the seedbed.
events.H1-10.action: Tap bare ground with a hoe handle to lure it into soil without seedlings.
events.H1-10.result: Fight EN02. As it emerges from the soft earth, your first normal attack is stronger by 2. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H1-11.name: Protecting the Calf’s Bell
events.H1-11.scene: A Field Mouse Swordsman slips a calf’s bell onto its sword guard and runs away.
events.H1-11.action: Follow the sound and confront it in a pen away from the cattle.
events.H1-11.result: Fight EN01. Guarding in the first round also restores 1 MP as you match its footsteps. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H1-12.name: The Moving Prayer Mat
events.H1-12.scene: A cloth slides from beneath the worshippers’ feet. An Armored Mole’s back peeks out underneath.
events.H1-12.action: Wait until everyone steps off, then lift all four corners.
events.H1-12.result: Fight EN02. The cloth catches the opening thrust, halving damage in round 1, rounded up. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H1-13.name: A Little Sword on the Cartwheel
events.H1-13.scene: A Field Mouse Swordsman hangs from the wheel of a medicine cart.
events.H1-13.action: Lay the cart in the grass and use your free hand to intercept the attack by the axle.
events.H1-13.result: Fight EN01. Choosing a normal attack on turn 1 catches its sword on the wheel and blocks the enemy’s direct hit in the same round. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H1-14.name: The Little Bag of Spilled Seeds
events.H1-14.scene: A channel in the herb garden has broken, and spilled seeds are beginning to sprout between stones.
events.H1-14.action: Return them to the seedbed without harming the sprouts and accept a parcel from the gardener.
events.H1-14.result: Receive one healing item, HE01. Put it in your bag without opening it now.
events.H1-15.name: Hedgehog Delivery
events.H1-15.scene: A hedgehog has rolled upside down with a delivery package still on its back.
events.H1-15.action: Use a flat board to turn it upright and guide it to the recipient’s hedge.
events.H1-15.result: The recipient shares a reward. Choose one HE02 or BD01.
events.H1-16.name: The Stubborn Scarecrow
events.H1-16.scene: As soon as the watchdog leaves, crows line both sleeves of the scarecrow.
events.H1-16.action: Hang empty nut shells from the sleeves to make a wind-rattled bird scarer.
events.H1-16.result: The field owner gives you one combat item, AT02. The startled birds fly away.
events.H1-17.name: A Brush for Pollen
events.H1-17.scene: Yellow pollen coats a sneezing flower seller’s shoulders.
events.H1-17.action: Brush it away with a feather duster from the cart and move the flowers downwind.
events.H1-17.result: Receive one healing item, HE03. If your MP is already full, you may choose BD02 instead.
events.H1-18.name: The Signpost at Your Feet
events.H1-18.scene: Tall grass hides a sign, and little travelers hold their map upside down.
events.H1-18.action: Raise the sign to a child’s eye level and pack stones around its base.
events.H1-18.result: Receive one board item, BD03, to help you find your way.
events.H1-19.name: Newspaper around a Blade
events.H1-19.scene: An uncovered work blade has slipped into a delivery boy’s load and is about to cut the paper.
events.H1-19.action: Fold newspaper with a blank reverse around the edge and tie it securely.
events.H1-19.result: The owner gives you one AT03 or HE04. Choose which to take.
events.H1-20.name: The Spool Exchange Stand
events.H1-20.scene: Two spools hang on a camp fence. Red thread is strong; blue is stretchy.
events.H1-20.action: Retie a frayed rope for the next visitor and return the spools.
events.H1-20.result: Choose one BD04 or BD05 in thanks for your knots. The other stays for the next traveler.
events.H1-21.name: The Well Bucket’s False Bottom
events.H1-21.scene: A loose board rattles at the communal well, and a package knocks whenever water is drawn.
events.H1-21.action: Remove the board and open the dry side of a package left by a former well keeper.
events.H1-21.result: Receive one HE05. If your HP is half or below, the well keeper also restores 3 HP here.
events.H1-22.name: A Butterfly at the Bell Tower Window
events.H1-22.scene: A butterfly trapped in the closed bell tower keeps bumping into colored glass.
events.H1-22.action: Climb around the bell rope and open only the clear little window.
events.H1-22.result: The bell keeper gives you one BD06. You do not ring the bell, so no battle occurs.
events.H1-23.name: The Forked Coal Tongs
events.H1-23.scene: At a field smithy, bent tongs cannot lift glowing coals from the furnace.
events.H1-23.action: Take turns with the smith pressing the handles, restoring a usable grip outside the furnace.
events.H1-23.result: Choose one combat item, AT04 or AT05, from the cooled workbench.
events.H1-24.name: The Pony’s Upside-Down Bag
events.H1-24.scene: A pony has rubbed its back and spun a travel bag all the way under its belly.
events.H1-24.action: Show it a carrot while tightening the loose girth strap.
events.H1-24.result: The bag’s owner gives you one HE06. If you arrived with no items at all, also receive one BD07.
events.H1-25.name: White Steam in the Wheatfield
events.H1-25.scene: Harvesters share morning porridge among the stubble.
events.H1-25.action: Sit down with a bowl, or wash your hands and open a small travelers’ box.
events.H1-25.result: Eating restores 5 HP. Choosing a portable supply grants one HE07 without healing.
events.H1-26.name: Morning Dew in a Hat
events.H1-26.scene: A tiny herbalist holds an oversized hat full of dew in both hands.
events.H1-26.action: Tip the brim to pour dew into cups and drink the first one.
events.H1-26.result: Restore 3 MP. If MP was full before drinking, receive one HE08 in exchange for the spare dew instead.
events.H1-27.name: A Post for Resting Shoes
events.H1-27.scene: A weary walker has taken off their shoes and hung them on a wooden post.
events.H1-27.action: Clean off the mud, let the breeze cool your bare feet, and retie your laces loosely.
events.H1-27.result: Restore 4 HP. If your HP was half or below before healing, also restore 2 MP.
events.H1-28.name: A Sunny Seat by the Windmill
events.H1-28.scene: An elderly miller moves a little chair to follow the morning sun.
events.H1-28.action: Set your chair in the sunshine, or arrange one in the shade and rest.
events.H1-28.result: Sunshine restores 6 HP; shade restores 4 MP. Use only your chosen seat.
events.H1-29.name: Sleeves Full of Fluff
events.H1-29.scene: Children covered in fluff race by rolling downhill, laughing at the bottom.
events.H1-29.action: Join them for one roll down the hill, then catch your breath on level ground.
events.H1-29.result: Restore 2 HP and 2 MP. If both were full to begin with, receive one BD08.
events.H1-30.name: The One-Handled Pitcher
events.H1-30.scene: A well keeper braces a pitcher with one broken handle against their knees.
events.H1-30.action: Support the spout while they fill it, then pass it to the injured first.
events.H1-30.result: Restore one quarter of maximum HP. With a companion, also restore 1 MP.
events.H1-31.name: Until the Bread Oven Cools
events.H1-31.scene: A baker warms stones with the oven’s remaining heat and lines them up in cloth bags.
events.H1-31.action: Place a warm bag on your shoulders, or tuck it inside your clothes before it cools.
events.H1-31.result: Using it now restores 4 HP. Saving it reduces the first damage you take in the next battle by 3.
events.H1-32.name: Humming the Way Home
events.H1-32.scene: A lost child sings only the beginning of a lullaby heard at home.
events.H1-32.action: Walk while quietly singing the rest, searching for a house whose window answers with the same song.
events.H1-32.result: Finishing the song restores 2 MP. Without a companion, you sing it all alone and restore 2 more MP.
events.H1-33.name: A Not-So-Sweet Baked Apple
events.H1-33.scene: An apple over the campfire is a little sour. The cook wonders whether to add flavor or serve it as is.
events.H1-33.action: Choose salt or aromatic leaves, then taste it.
events.H1-33.result: Salt restores 5 HP. Leaves restore 2 HP and 2 MP.
events.H1-34.name: A Gate for Stretching Arms
events.H1-34.scene: Beneath the gate, a village teacher shows heavily laden travelers how to stretch.
events.H1-34.action: Set down your load, hold the crossbar, and slowly stretch your back.
events.H1-34.result: Restore 3 HP. With at least 4 consumables, setting down the heavy load restores 3 more HP.
events.H1-35.name: Stars at Your Feet
events.H1-35.scene: At dusk, star-shaped flowers open only around a well in the meadow.
events.H1-35.action: Circle the well without treading on flowers, then quietly look into the water.
events.H1-35.result: If you have less than 2 MP, bring it back to 3. Otherwise, restore 4 HP.
events.H1-36.name: A Woolen Patch
events.H1-36.scene: A shepherd’s sewing box has spare wool, while the camping blanket has a hole.
events.H1-36.action: Patch the blanket, choose a side, and lie down.
events.H1-36.result: The white side restores 3 HP and 1 MP. The thick wool side restores only 5 HP.
events.H1-37.name: The Sowing Inn’s Screen
events.H1-37.scene: A seed-sack screen shelters the inn entrance, welcoming travelers even in muddy clothes.
events.H1-37.action: Take off your shoes, step behind the sacks, and onto the porch boards.
events.H1-37.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Use the field owner’s washstand once to restore 2 HP separately from normal rest.
events.H1-38.name: The Goat Tavern’s Windborne News
events.H1-38.scene: A note for the next traveler is tied to the bell around a goat’s neck.
events.H1-38.action: Untie the paper without ringing the bell and read it to the innkeeper.
events.H1-38.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. The inn’s news reveals the enemy’s name at the next battle space ahead. If no battle space remains, you are told so.
events.H1-39.name: Upside-Down Shoes at the Eaves
events.H1-39.scene: Shoes hanging upside down from the eaves mark the inn.
events.H1-39.action: Undo one knot in the cord and open the sliding door.
events.H1-39.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Receive one free BD09 as a cobbler’s sample, once only. If your bag is full, swap or decline.
events.H1-40.name: The Lark’s Shared Room
events.H1-40.scene: Travelers’ self-portraits line the inn wall, with just one blank space left.
events.H1-40.action: Listen to introductions in the dining room and, if you wish, draw your face on the empty board.
events.H1-40.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Drawing your face restores 2 MP. Compare prospective companions’ support conditions on the same board before deciding to recruit.
events.H1-41.name: The Birch Kettle Tavern
events.H1-41.scene: Lift the lid of an enormous kettle, and the innkeeper waves through the white steam.
events.H1-41.action: Check two boxes for different purposes beside the stove.
events.H1-41.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Once, receive one HE09 or AT06 from the host. Free rest remains separately available.
events.H1-42.name: Both Sides of a Lost-Child Tag
events.H1-42.scene: On departure day, a child grips a wooden tag marked “Home” on one side and “Road” on the other.
events.H1-42.action: Point toward home and escort the child, or draw and hand over a road map.
events.H1-42.result: Escorting home restores 4 HP. Drawing a map earns one BD10 from the child’s mother.
events.H1-43.name: The First Flint
events.H1-43.scene: The watchtower’s wood is damp. Only the waiting campers’ shadows grow longer.
events.H1-43.action: Spend 1 MP to kindle a fire, or rub it by hand to preserve an ember.
events.H1-43.result: Using MP earns 200G in thanks. Using your hands earns one dry spare AT07. You may choose the latter without enough MP.
events.H1-44.name: Who Goes through the Fence First
events.H1-44.scene: A lamb and a medicine cart face each other at a narrow fence, each yielding the way.
events.H1-44.action: Decide whether the lamb or cart goes first.
events.H1-44.result: Lamb first restores 5 HP at the farm. Cart first earns one HE10 from the medicine seller.
events.H1-45.name: A Borrowed Waist Cord
events.H1-45.scene: A stepladder’s legs spread too far. Someone hanging a nest box asks to borrow your waist cord.
events.H1-45.action: Tie the ladder with the cord, or brace its legs yourself.
events.H1-45.result: Tying earns replacement armor AR08. Bracing earns one AT08 that fell from the nest box.
events.H1-46.name: Where the Flower Crown Belongs
events.H1-46.scene: A flower crown sits between two destinations as wind rolls away one tag.
events.H1-46.action: Deliver it to the departing siblings or their grandfather seeing them off.
events.H1-46.result: The siblings strengthen your first normal attack next battle by 3. Their grandfather restores 3 MP.
events.H1-47.name: The Fallen Quill
events.H1-47.scene: A mapmaker waves from the gate steps, one hand still pinning the paper.
events.H1-47.action: Draw a spring in the map’s margin, or the tracks of an enemy to watch for.
events.H1-47.result: A spring earns shared flask water, restoring 3 HP and 2 MP. Tracks earn one combat item, AT10.
events.H1-48.name: The Rake beneath the Straw
events.H1-48.scene: Rake teeth poke from beneath a fallen straw bundle, blocking the narrow path.
events.H1-48.action: Borrow a board to cover them, or lift the bundle to clear the way.
events.H1-48.result: Pay 30G for the board, or lose 3 HP lifting, stopping at 1 HP. If you have a trap-prevention item, consume it to avoid both costs.
events.H1-49.name: The Milk Cart on the Slope
events.H1-49.scene: A milk cart’s chock has come loose, and the cart starts rolling across the slope.
events.H1-49.action: Catch it with your pack or throw yourself onto the grass.
events.H1-49.result: Catching it loses one owned consumable of your choice. Dodging loses 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining). With an empty bag, you can dodge.
events.H1-50.name: A Black Cloud over Honey
events.H1-50.scene: A honey pot has toppled at a little shrine, and swarming insects block the path.
events.H1-50.action: Take a long downwind detour, or scatter the insects with smoke and pass.
events.H1-50.result: The detour costs 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining). Smoke costs 1 MP. Without enough MP, you can detour.

events.H2-01.name: The Unsinkable Accounting Desk
events.H2-01.scene: A landing clerk holds a ledger and drifting invoices overhead.
events.H2-01.action: Tie empty barrels together to float the desk and pull it ashore.
events.H2-01.result: Hand over the dry invoices and receive 300G from the boat guild.
events.H2-02.name: Breakfast in the Square Net
events.H2-02.scene: A damaged escape opening for small fish has left even market fish avoiding the net.
events.H2-02.action: Weave a small exit into the net’s side and return it to the water with the fisherman.
events.H2-02.result: The fish remain unharmed and reach the morning market in time. Receive 240G for repairing the net.
events.H2-03.name: The Mail Bell on the Mother Ship
events.H2-03.scene: A mail boat visiting moored ships has lost its way home in thick fog.
events.H2-03.action: Ring the mother ship’s bell in short groups of three and wait for the boat’s reply.
events.H2-03.result: The mail boat returns to the pier, and its captain pays you 330G.
events.H2-04.name: The Found Water Gauge
events.H2-04.scene: What looked like scrap wood bears water-level marks. A keeper in the downstream fields is searching for it.
events.H2-04.action: Wash away the mud and re-erect the board using its original nail holes.
events.H2-04.result: The keeper can judge when to open the sluice again and pays you 280G.
events.H2-05.name: The Ferryman’s Old Scabbard
events.H2-05.scene: Whenever the boat rocks, a little whistle nearly slips from the rower’s old scabbard.
events.H2-05.action: Sew the whistle loop to the back of the scabbard so the rower can use both hands.
events.H2-05.result: The ferryman gives you a retired colleague’s SW11. The whistle stays with the boat.
events.H2-06.name: The Reed Boat’s Float
events.H2-06.scene: During a reed-boat lesson, a trainee has fastened the shoulder straps on the wrong sides.
events.H2-06.action: Refit them on land and check freedom of movement in shallow water.
events.H2-06.result: Take home AR11 or AR13 as equipment for your help.
events.H2-07.name: The Grey Heron’s Borrowed Tool
events.H2-07.scene: A grey heron across the river repairs its nest with a thin rod. A boatbuilder tilts their head at its handle.
events.H2-07.action: Place a replacement twig beneath the nest and pick up the rod the bird drops.
events.H2-07.result: Unwrapping it reveals SW14. The builder gives it to you for recovering it unbent.
events.H2-08.name: The Costume Box in the Spray
events.H2-08.scene: A theater-boat troupe cannot protect its costume box from sudden spray.
events.H2-08.action: Cover the box with your cloak, haul it ashore, and spread out only the wet cloth.
events.H2-08.result: Choose one SW16 or AR15 from the troupe’s stores.
events.H2-09.name: Claws Knocking beneath the Boat
events.H2-09.scene: A Shallows Crab has caught on a boat. Passengers crowd to one side and tilt the hull.
events.H2-09.action: Return the passengers to balanced seats and extend an oar from shore.
events.H2-09.result: Fight EN03. Guarding in round 1 makes the claw grip the oar, reducing damage that round to 0. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H2-10.name: The Covered Streetlamps
events.H2-10.scene: The pier lamps all go dark. A Glowtail Bat covering their light spreads its wings.
events.H2-10.action: Lower the nearest lamp and lure it toward the landing’s firm footing.
events.H2-10.result: Fight EN04. With the streetlamp at your back, your first attack spell deals 3 extra damage. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H2-11.name: The Backward Waterwheel
events.H2-11.scene: A waterwheel turns against the current, sending buckets toward the stone steps. An otter uses it as a springboard.
events.H2-11.action: Move everyone above the steps and prepare for a leap from the wheel.
events.H2-11.result: Fight a normal battle against Waterwheel Otter. Victory grants 250G and 17 XP, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Fleeing or losing grants no victory rewards.
events.H2-12.name: The Pharmacy’s Lighted Window
events.H2-12.scene: The pharmacy window goes dark at night, leaving people waiting for medicine on the bridge.
events.H2-12.action: Open the window from the side and release the Glowtail Bat toward an empty boat.
events.H2-12.result: Fight EN04. Before battle, the pharmacist restores 3 HP; then view the enemy’s telegraph. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H2-13.name: A Little Bridge Caught in the Net
events.H2-13.scene: Low tide reveals a rope bridge with a Shallows Crab’s large claw wedged beneath it.
events.H2-13.action: Keep would-be crossers on shore and use a short cut rope to pull the enemy away.
events.H2-13.result: Fight EN03. The rope slows its opening movement, reducing enemy damage by 3 in round 1 only. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H2-14.name: The Potter’s Air Hole
events.H2-14.scene: Pottery rattles inside a crate that has crossed the water.
events.H2-14.action: Clear mud from the lid’s vent and place dry cloth between the plates.
events.H2-14.result: The potter gives you one stored HE11. No additional payment is needed.
events.H2-15.name: Two Damselflies
events.H2-15.scene: Two damselflies perch on the end of a fine-thread spool. The thread seller hesitates with scissors set aside.
events.H2-15.action: Offer a reed leaf to move the pair and tie the thread ends separately.
events.H2-15.result: Choose one BD11 or AT11 from the seller’s travel box.
events.H2-16.name: The Apple-Cooling Pool
events.H2-16.scene: A basket of chilled apples is caught underwater, too heavy for its young seller to lift.
events.H2-16.action: Sink an empty basket beside it, support it from below, and lift together.
events.H2-16.result: The seller receives the basket and gives you one HE12 in thanks.
events.H2-17.name: The Mud-Spitting Water Spout
events.H2-17.scene: Brown water flows from the communal spout, and the keeper rearranges the buckets.
events.H2-17.action: Scoop fallen leaves from the intake with a sieve and watch until the water clears.
events.H2-17.result: Receive one HE13 from the keeper’s package. If your MP is 0 before collection, also restore 2 MP here.
events.H2-18.name: A Xylophone That Plays on the Waves
events.H2-18.scene: At a boat concert, one xylophone leg has slipped into a gap in the pier.
events.H2-18.action: Turn an empty fish box upside down under the leg and listen to the final piece.
events.H2-18.result: The musicians give you one board item, BD12. With a companion, you may ask for BD13 instead.
events.H2-19.name: The Cargo Tag Left on the Sandbar
events.H2-19.scene: On a sandbar where boats wait for the tide, a lone cargo tag hangs unusually high on a branch.
events.H2-19.action: Bend the branch at low tide and give the tag to the ship matching its crest’s color.
events.H2-19.result: Learn a packing technique and receive one BD14. If you need to reduce your load, you can swap.
events.H2-20.name: A Chorus of Dippers
events.H2-20.scene: Dippers knock together in a water shed, waking a baby who wants to sleep.
events.H2-20.action: Tie cloth between them and hang them far enough apart to stay quiet.
events.H2-20.result: The mother offers two packages. Choose one HE14 or HE15.
events.H2-21.name: The Dog Chasing Bubble Rings
events.H2-21.scene: A dog trying to retrieve a dropped key circles after bubbles from its own breath.
events.H2-21.action: Shade the light falling through the water so the dog can spot the key below.
events.H2-21.result: The key’s owner brings AT12 and AT13 from the storehouse. Choose one item as your share.
events.H2-22.name: The Floating Pier’s Folding Shelf
events.H2-22.scene: A household-goods shelf tilts, and bulky wooden boxes obstruct boat traffic.
events.H2-22.action: Remove the shelf boards in order and stand the boxes upright to clear the route.
events.H2-22.result: Receive one BD15 from a box. If you have 0 consumables, also receive one HE16 from the owner.
events.H2-23.name: The Shell Shop without a Sea
events.H2-23.scene: At a shop selling only freshwater shells, display specimens clog the rain gutter.
events.H2-23.action: Take the shells from the gutter and return each to the price tag matching its pattern.
events.H2-23.result: The owner gives you one AT14 or BD16. The other goes back on the shelf.
events.H2-24.name: The Starlit Laundry Net
events.H2-24.scene: A hole in the inn’s laundry net lets white cloth drift away like a moon.
events.H2-24.action: Retrieve the cloth from a small boat and fold the net opening twice before tying it.
events.H2-24.result: Choose one HE17 from the laundry keeper, or immediate treatment restoring 5 HP.
events.H2-25.name: The Steamer-Basket Boat
events.H2-25.scene: A small boat carrying only steamed food emerges through morning-market steam.
events.H2-25.action: Take a bamboo lid from the boatman and serve your travel portion onto a plate.
events.H2-25.result: Eating restores 7 HP. If HP was full from the start, you may take one HE18 home instead.
events.H2-26.name: The Sluice’s Clock Flowers
events.H2-26.scene: The sluice clock is broken, but riverbank flowers still announce midday.
events.H2-26.action: Breathe quietly before the fully opened flowers for as long as the water keeper does.
events.H2-26.result: Restore 4 MP. If HP is below half, the seated rest also restores 2 HP.
events.H2-27.name: The Barefoot Washstand
events.H2-27.scene: Your traveling shoes are dirty, and households have set foot-washing buckets outside.
events.H2-27.action: Soak your feet in cold water or a bucket warmed with hot water.
events.H2-27.result: Cold restores 3 MP and reduces the first damage next battle by 1. Warm restores 6 HP.
events.H2-28.name: Fish Porridge under a Lid
events.H2-28.scene: A ship’s doctor cooks fish porridge, covering the bowls of sleeping passengers.
events.H2-28.action: Take one small bowl, or accept the travel package the doctor prepared.
events.H2-28.result: The bowl restores 4 HP and 2 MP. The package contains one HE19.
events.H2-29.name: Strings above the River
events.H2-29.scene: A musician replaces a broken string beneath the bridge but cannot hear its final note over the water.
events.H2-29.action: Listen without leaning over and signal during a break in the water’s roar.
events.H2-29.result: Restore 3 MP. If MP was already full, the first attack spell you use next battle deals 3 extra damage instead.
events.H2-30.name: Warm Stones on the Riverbed
events.H2-30.scene: Lukewarm stones gather in the shallows. A washer has left one seat free for you.
events.H2-30.action: Pass your load ashore and sit on the flat stone.
events.H2-30.result: Restore half your missing HP, rounded up. If HP is full, restore 2 MP instead.
events.H2-31.name: String Figures beneath the Lantern
events.H2-31.scene: A child mending nets makes a boat shape with thread around their fingers.
events.H2-31.action: Take the boat and return it as a star without breaking the taut thread.
events.H2-31.result: Restore 2 MP and 3 HP. If only MP is full, the HP restoration becomes 5.
events.H2-32.name: Two Moons in the Water Mirror
events.H2-32.scene: Short and long platforms cross at an inlet where two moons appear.
events.H2-32.action: Drink water from the short board, or watch the quiet moon from the long board’s end.
events.H2-32.result: Short restores 5 HP. Long restores half your missing MP, rounded up.
events.H2-33.name: Salt in the Clam Soup
events.H2-33.scene: The cook holds a salt jar, judging the amount by each traveler’s face.
events.H2-33.action: Choose mild soup or a rich bowl with extra shellfish.
events.H2-33.result: Mild restores 3 HP and 3 MP. Rich restores 8 HP.
events.H2-34.name: Shade over the Floating Weed
events.H2-34.scene: Moving boat shade leaves just one resting place beside a child tired from swimming.
events.H2-34.action: Rest yourself, or offer the child the seat and drink cold water from shore.
events.H2-34.result: Shade restores 6 HP. Giving up the seat restores 2 MP and earns one BD17 from the boatman.
events.H2-35.name: Drying Rain Capes in the Drizzle
events.H2-35.scene: Only beneath the drying-net shelf is it quiet, as though the rain has stopped.
events.H2-35.action: Dry your hair under the shelf and rearrange your wet belongings.
events.H2-35.result: Restore 3 HP. If you entered with 3 or fewer consumables, there is room to spread them out, also restoring 3 MP.
events.H2-36.name: A Fish Basket for One Night
events.H2-36.scene: An old fisherman puts a lamp in a holed fish basket, casting circles of light on the bank.
events.H2-36.action: Listen to one night-watch story beside the roundest patch of light.
events.H2-36.result: Restore 5 MP. If both HP and MP were full before listening, receive one AT15 as watch supplies.
events.H2-37.name: The Tide-Marked Boat Inn
events.H2-37.scene: Lines on the inn steps record each day’s water level.
events.H2-37.action: Trace today’s mark and climb through the slightly higher entrance.
events.H2-37.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Once, exchange one owned consumable for BD18. You may depart without giving an item.
events.H2-38.name: The Ferry Stacked with Tatami
events.H2-38.scene: A boat that ferries by day and serves as an inn by night holds neatly stacked rolled mats.
events.H2-38.action: Spread one mat and turn the onboard information signs face up.
events.H2-38.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Before the boat leaves, restore an additional 3 HP or 3 MP once.
events.H2-39.name: The Great Dipper Guestbook
events.H2-39.scene: A dipper is tied to the guestbook cover. Each guest adds one scoop to a tank in the back garden.
events.H2-39.action: Write your name and add water without startling the fish.
events.H2-39.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Once, receive one HE20 or BD19 from the host’s delivery.
events.H2-40.name: The Quayside Shadow-Puppet Tavern
events.H2-40.scene: Guests’ equipment casts silhouettes on a white cloth beneath the eaves.
events.H2-40.action: Place your hands against the cloth and copy a shield or sword shadow.
events.H2-40.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Shield reduces the first damage next battle by 2; sword strengthens the first normal attack by 2. Choose either once.
events.H2-41.name: The Floating Kitchen at Dawn
events.H2-41.scene: Bed boats and shop boats gather around a large floating kitchen.
events.H2-41.action: Lay the knife flat on its board before boarding the serving boat.
events.H2-41.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. If you wish, once give one owned healing item to restore 5 HP and 5 MP.
events.H2-42.name: Hand Flags from the Far Bank
events.H2-42.scene: Flags signal two requests: “Send a boat” and “Send water.”
events.H2-42.action: Pull a boat across by rope, or carry a flask over the wooden bridge.
events.H2-42.result: Sending the boat earns a 360G share of the fare. Carrying the flask earns one travel item, BD20.
events.H2-43.name: Auntie’s Rice-Bran Pickles
events.H2-43.scene: Two barrel lids lie side by side, branded “Table” and “Journey.”
events.H2-43.action: Open the Table lid, or load the Journey lid onto the boat.
events.H2-43.result: Table restores 7 HP. Loading the boat earns one combat item, AT16.
events.H2-44.name: Until the Duck Family Crosses
events.H2-44.scene: A duck and ducklings pause before the crossing board while passengers approach from the other bank.
events.H2-44.action: Lower the board to the ground, or carry the passengers’ bags together.
events.H2-44.result: Lowering the board restores 4 MP in the shallows. Carrying the bags instead earns AR18.
events.H2-45.name: The Boat Song’s Second Verse
events.H2-45.scene: A boatman who forgot the song rests the oar. Passengers suggest “heavy cargo” or “tailwind.”
events.H2-45.action: Make a second verse using either phrase in rhythm.
events.H2-45.result: Heavy cargo reduces damage by 3 in the first round you guard next battle. Tailwind strengthens the first normal attack next battle by 3.
events.H2-46.name: Blue-Sealed Bottle Mail
events.H2-46.scene: A bottle floats on the river. The only words readable without breaking its seal are “To the harbor teacher.”
events.H2-46.action: Send it by boat or carry it to the teacher’s home yourself.
events.H2-46.result: Boat mail costs 60G; waiting restores 4 HP and 4 MP. Hand delivery is free and earns one AT18.
events.H2-47.name: The Leaking Prayer Hall
events.H2-47.scene: A riverside prayer hall has two leaks: a pot sits on the altar and a bucket on the bench.
events.H2-47.action: Replace either the altar’s roof tile or the one over the bench.
events.H2-47.result: Fixing the altar strengthens your first attack spell next battle by 4. The bench earns treatment from worshippers, restoring 6 HP.
events.H2-48.name: The Pier High on One Bank
events.H2-48.scene: Falling water has left a steep step at the end of the return pier.
events.H2-48.action: Rent a rope ladder or help each other climb.
events.H2-48.result: Paying 50G avoids any strain. Climbing yourself costs 4 HP, reduced to 2 with a companion (minimum 1 remaining).
events.H2-49.name: The Transparent Puddle
events.H2-49.scene: What looked like pier planks is a deep puddle reflecting the sky.
events.H2-49.action: Crawl along the edge, or float on an owned board item.
events.H2-49.result: The edge costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining). If you have a board item, give up one to preserve HP.
events.H2-50.name: The Waterwheel’s Backstop Rope
events.H2-50.scene: Backflow spins the wheel backward and tightens the rope supporting the crossing planks.
events.H2-50.action: Stop the axle with magic, or go beneath the planks to unhook the rope.
events.H2-50.result: Stopping costs 2 MP. Going around the back costs 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining). One trap-prevention item also lets you cross without either payment.

events.H3-01.name: Wages for Watching the Embers
events.H3-01.scene: Shift-working miners want to attend a midday celebration without putting out the furnace.
events.H3-01.action: Watch it through the day shift and open a vent if it gets too hot.
events.H3-01.result: The returning foreman pays you 410G for covering the shift.
events.H3-02.name: Three Name Tags
events.H3-02.scene: Entry tags lie buried in mud, leaving no one sure who is underground.
events.H3-02.action: Use the patterns on their boots to return three tags to their owners.
events.H3-02.result: Once roll call is complete, receive 350G from the station.
events.H3-03.name: The Goat-Closed Crossing
events.H3-03.scene: A goat crossing the tracks grips the barrier rope in its mouth, holding up a line of empty mine carts.
events.H3-03.action: Set its favorite peel away from the rope and let the final cart pass.
events.H3-03.result: The transport keeper shares 420G saved in waiting costs.
events.H3-04.name: A Seal among the Coal
events.H3-04.scene: The black seal stone used on miners’ pay packets has fallen into a coal pile.
events.H3-04.action: Rub the stones with cloth and carry only the one revealing a white crest to the office.
events.H3-04.result: The clerk distributes wages safely and pays you 390G.
events.H3-05.name: The Master’s Final Sharpening
events.H3-05.scene: Before passing the whetstone to an apprentice, a retiring sharpener wants to finish one last blade.
events.H3-05.action: Soak the stone and turn the blade over at the master’s signal.
events.H3-05.result: The master gives you SW21 bearing a personal mark.
events.H3-06.name: The Leather Apron Pocket
events.H3-06.scene: A large hole in a workshop apron lets tools slip through its hem.
events.H3-06.action: Test the seams with the weight of ore and sew a pouch inside the hole.
events.H3-06.result: Choose AR21 or AR22 in thanks. Compare their properties before choosing.
events.H3-07.name: The Side-Tunnel Lost Property Keeper
events.H3-07.scene: A muddy bundle remains on the lost-property shelf, its destination tag turned backward.
events.H3-07.action: Rewrap it and deliver either the coat or the blade.
events.H3-07.result: Delivering the coat earns AR24 from its owner; the blade earns SW24.
events.H3-08.name: A Long Handle across the Valley
events.H3-08.scene: A polisher stranded across the valley wants to send the finished blades ahead.
events.H3-08.action: Extend a survey pole, pass the wrapped blade through its loop, and draw it across.
events.H3-08.result: Receive one sword from SW26 and SW28. The other reaches the workshop.
events.H3-09.name: Nails Rising from the Bed
events.H3-09.scene: Nails rise from an aid-station bed as a Magnet Golem gathers iron outside.
events.H3-09.action: Move the patient to a wooden bed and put the empty iron frame before the enemy.
events.H3-09.result: Fight EN05. Drawn toward the frame, it is vulnerable to your first normal attack, which is stronger by 4. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H3-10.name: A Hole beneath the Lunchboxes
events.H3-10.scene: A hole opens in the lunch shelf, and an Armored Mole’s back pushes up the last box.
events.H3-10.action: Return the box to its owner, lower an empty bucket, and secure your footing.
events.H3-10.result: Fight EN02. Using an item in round 1 lets the empty bucket reduce damage that round by 3. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H3-11.name: The Sled That Calls Sparks
events.H3-11.scene: An iron sled races toward an empty mine entrance on its own. A Magnet Golem waits at the other end of its rope.
events.H3-11.action: Steer it into a wooden stop, then draw your sword once it halts.
events.H3-11.result: Fight EN05. The collision starts the enemy with 4 HP lost (minimum 1 remaining). Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H3-12.name: The Ore Cart Carrying Dreams
events.H3-12.scene: An Armored Mole piles soil and sits before a cart carrying a sleeping trainee to the rest room.
events.H3-12.action: Quietly stop the wheels and tap the wall to turn the enemy away from the tracks.
events.H3-12.result: Fight EN02. Guarding in round 1 strengthens your next normal attack by 4. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H3-13.name: Silver Sand at the Furnace
events.H3-13.scene: In still air before the furnace, silver sand races sideways to form a Magnet Golem’s feet.
events.H3-13.action: Leave the sand, climb a wooden workbench, and take a stance clear of sparks.
events.H3-13.result: Fight EN05. An attack spell used in round 1 costs 2 less MP, with a minimum of 1 if it originally had a cost. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H3-14.name: A Quiet Afternoon for the Hammer
events.H3-14.scene: The workshop baby has just fallen asleep, but finishing time is drawing near.
events.H3-14.action: Wrap the anvil’s legs in thick cloth to dampen the shaking.
events.H3-14.result: Receive one AT21 from the craftsperson’s box. If MP is half or below, you may choose HE21 instead.
events.H3-15.name: Lunch Tags at the Quarry
events.H3-15.scene: Soot obscures the lunch tags’ colors, splitting the midday queue in two.
events.H3-15.action: Read the notches in the tag corners and guide each owner to the correct window.
events.H3-15.result: Accept one HE22 in thanks, or restore 4 MP here instead.
events.H3-16.name: The Jumbled Strata Sample Box
events.H3-16.scene: A child who dropped a geology box cries over its scattered stones.
events.H3-16.action: Follow the lid’s picture and replace three slabs so their colored bands connect.
events.H3-16.result: Receive one BD21 from the teacher’s spare tools.
events.H3-17.name: The Backward Wind Indicator
events.H3-17.scene: A reversed wind indicator at the mine entrance sends even resting workers toward the work tunnel.
events.H3-17.action: Remove its tassel, flutter a leaf, and realign it with the true wind.
events.H3-17.result: The wind keeper gives you one board item, BD22 or BD23.
events.H3-18.name: A Kaleidoscope of Fragments
events.H3-18.scene: Beneath a gem-polishing bench, a trainee collects colored pebbles in a paper tube.
events.H3-18.action: Fit thin stones at both ends, finish one, and let everyone look through.
events.H3-18.result: Choose one HE23 or AT22 from the trainee’s share.
events.H3-19.name: The Steam-Release Whistle
events.H3-19.scene: A steamer’s whistle is blocked, and the pot rattles during preparation.
events.H3-19.action: Put out the fire, wait for the steam to subside, then clear the whistle opening with thin bamboo.
events.H3-19.result: Receive one AT23 from the keeper. If HP is half or below before collection, you may take HE24 instead.
events.H3-20.name: Hand-Pushed Mail over the Pass
events.H3-20.scene: A mail sled catches on a step, and thin letters nearly slide beneath a stone.
events.H3-20.action: Brace the sled from behind and slip a card beneath the letters.
events.H3-20.result: The post carrier gives you one BD24. Without a companion, one HE25 is added.
events.H3-21.name: A Borrowed Sturdy Finger
events.H3-21.scene: A craftsperson’s leather thimble has rolled away and become a puppy’s toy at the mine entrance.
events.H3-21.action: Offer a rolling wood scrap instead and inspect the recovered thimble’s hole.
events.H3-21.result: With the thimble repaired, the craftsperson offers AT24 and AT25. Compare them and choose one combat item.
events.H3-22.name: Clappers for Raising the Bucket
events.H3-22.scene: The well-rope team’s calls are out of sync, tilting the bucket halfway up.
events.H3-22.action: Pick up two wooden scraps and make different sounds for pulling and resting.
events.H3-22.result: Receive one HE26 from the well keeper. If your inventory is full, you may decline it and restore 4 HP instead.
events.H3-23.name: The Surveyor’s Single Glove
events.H3-23.scene: A surveyor wants to record the road’s width, but one glove is wrapped around a messenger dog’s neck.
events.H3-23.action: Tie a rest-stop destination tag to the dog and hand back the returned glove.
events.H3-23.result: Receive one spare surveying item, BD25, or choose one BD26 from the same box instead.
events.H3-24.name: Patterns on the Rock-Salt Tray
events.H3-24.scene: Lines on a sorting tray have faded, mixing coarse and fine salt.
events.H3-24.action: Trace the tray with a finger and divide the salt into two areas.
events.H3-24.result: Finishing the fine-grain tray earns one HE27; the coarse-grain tray earns one AT26.
events.H3-25.name: A Recess for the Carrying Basket
events.H3-25.scene: A chair at the pass has a round recess where you can lean back without removing your basket.
events.H3-25.action: Set your back into the recess and rest until the shoulder straps loosen.
events.H3-25.result: Restore 6 HP. If your item bag is full, also restore 3 MP before shouldering it again.
events.H3-26.name: The Mountain Dove’s Drinking Song
events.H3-26.scene: A dove coos in an old tunnel, and miners pass a flask to its rhythm.
events.H3-26.action: Drink during the long call and pass it along during the short one.
events.H3-26.result: Restore 4 MP. With a companion, water goes around the party and also restores 3 HP.
events.H3-27.name: Oil Jars for Cracked Fingers
events.H3-27.scene: Two oil jars stand at the workshop exit. Each worker’s hands are thanked at the end of the day.
events.H3-27.action: Oil your fingers or massage the hard patches on your feet.
events.H3-27.result: Fingers restore 5 MP. Feet restore 7 HP, plus 2 more if remaining HP is 4 or below.
events.H3-28.name: The Egg Seller at the Pass
events.H3-28.scene: A seller lifts eggs from hot rocks. A first-aid box beside them serves those crossing the pass.
events.H3-28.action: Ask the seller to peel an egg, or leave it for the next traveler and take a first-aid package.
events.H3-28.result: The egg restores 6 HP and 1 MP. The first-aid box grants one HE28.
events.H3-29.name: The Mineral Spring’s Forked Spout
events.H3-29.scene: Spring water splits into two channels, one feeding a footbath and the other a drinking spout.
events.H3-29.action: Rest your blisters in the footbath or quench your thirst at the spout.
events.H3-29.result: The footbath restores one third of maximum HP; drinking restores half of maximum MP. Round fractions up.
events.H3-30.name: Eyes Resting in Darkness
events.H3-30.scene: Where tunnel lights end, a small recess offers a place to sit with closed eyes.
events.H3-30.action: Cover your lamp and sit, counting distant footsteps and your own breaths.
events.H3-30.result: Restore 3 MP. If MP was already full before healing, instead reduce the first positive damage you take next battle by 3.
events.H3-31.name: The Breezy Stump
events.H3-31.scene: Only around a stump at the pass does the breeze flow freely past the rocks.
events.H3-31.action: Take turns sitting on it and let the wind dry your sweat.
events.H3-31.result: Restore 4 HP, plus 2 HP for each accompanying companion.
events.H3-32.name: Little Handprints on the Rock
events.H3-32.scene: Handprints of those who returned safely overlap on the aid hut’s rock wall.
events.H3-32.action: Add your handprint in ash, or polish an empty area with water.
events.H3-32.result: Adding a print restores 5 HP and 2 MP. Polishing restores 2 HP and 4 MP.
events.H3-33.name: Dumplings in the Big Pot
events.H3-33.scene: The miners share one large pot for dinner. Dumplings at the bottom have been saved for travelers.
events.H3-33.action: Ask for extra broth or scoop extra dumplings.
events.H3-33.result: Broth restores 5 MP; dumplings restore 8 HP. If both were full at the start, you may leave with one BD27 instead.
events.H3-34.name: A Vent with a View of the Stars
events.H3-34.scene: Even underground, one star is visible directly beneath a tiny opening.
events.H3-34.action: Sit on the stone steps, extinguish your lamp, and look up at the lone star.
events.H3-34.result: Compare current HP and MP as percentages of their maximums. Restore 6 to the lower one; choose if tied.
events.H3-35.name: The Shared Illustrated Diary
events.H3-35.scene: Every face in the rest hut’s diary sports a soot-drawn mustache.
events.H3-35.action: Leave one portrait or laugh at yesterday’s pictures.
events.H3-35.result: Drawing restores 3 MP and strengthens your first attack spell next battle by 2. Laughing restores 6 HP.
events.H3-36.name: Sitting on Spare Sleepers
events.H3-36.scene: Dry railway sleepers are stacked beside the track. Off-duty workers wave and make room.
events.H3-36.action: Drink water beside your companions, or sit alone at the quiet end.
events.H3-36.result: Sitting together restores 5 HP and, with a companion, 3 MP. The end restores 4 MP regardless of companions.
events.H3-37.name: The Wildcat-Marked Station
events.H3-37.scene: Behind a door painted with white cat tracks, beds for miners and travelers stand in rows.
events.H3-37.action: Take a wooden tag shaped like the door’s tracks and find an empty bed.
events.H3-37.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Once, choose Wildcat Care to restore 4 HP or reduce the first damage next battle by 3.
events.H3-38.name: The Rock-Sample Inn
events.H3-38.scene: Each room key has a rock sample tied to it. Entering the wrong bedspace is quickly noticed by its sound.
events.H3-38.action: Compare sample weights in your palm and be shown to an empty room.
events.H3-38.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Give the resident collector one combat item to receive one HE29. Trade only once.
events.H3-39.name: The Lantern Dining Car
events.H3-39.scene: An old mine cart parked at the pass is now a diner, with a lantern swaying over the tables.
events.H3-39.action: Check the wheel chock and sit at a steaming place setting.
events.H3-39.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Once, additionally choose tea restoring 3 MP or roasted grain restoring 3 HP.
events.H3-40.name: The Watch House without Whistles
events.H3-40.scene: To let night workers sleep, this inn uses colored cloth instead of a ringing bell to announce guests.
events.H3-40.action: Pull the bell cloth and signal the keeper who sees its color move.
events.H3-40.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Once, receive one AT27 or BD28 from the inn’s box. This does not reduce recruitment or shopping opportunities.
events.H3-41.name: The Valley’s Long Table
events.H3-41.scene: A low-ceilinged hillside inn has one long dining table running through three rooms.
events.H3-41.action: Sit at a free end and pass the salt jar to someone farther away.
events.H3-41.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Once, additionally restore 1 MP for the party plus 1 per accompanying companion, for a total of 1–3.
events.H3-42.name: The Candle Left in the Tunnel
events.H3-42.scene: One candle remains in a side tunnel. A morning-shift child and an all-night watchman cannot decide how to share it.
events.H3-42.action: Split it in half for both, or give it intact to the watchman.
events.H3-42.result: Sharing earns one HE30. The intact candle earns tool-handling advice, strengthening your first normal attack next battle by 4.
events.H3-43.name: A Narrow Vein and a Wide Shortcut
events.H3-43.scene: A miner and a porter point to different places on a picture map.
events.H3-43.action: Copy the ore vein’s location, or mark the porter’s shortcut with an arrow.
events.H3-43.result: The vein copy sells for 480G. Marking the shortcut earns one board item, BD29.
events.H3-44.name: The Rock Lark’s Rain Shelter
events.H3-44.scene: A bird nests in a temporary hut’s beam. Only one cloth is available to catch the drips.
events.H3-44.action: Stretch it above the nest, or cover the workers’ bedding.
events.H3-44.result: Protecting the nest brings a quiet song restoring 5 MP. Covering the beds earns AR29 from a waking miner.
events.H3-45.name: The Rescue Rope’s Knot
events.H3-45.scene: Two kinds of rope hang at opposite ends of a wooden bridge. Red supports people; white lifts cargo.
events.H3-45.action: Pull red to rescue someone, or use white to raise a medicine box.
events.H3-45.result: Rescuing earns training that reduces the first damage next battle by 4. Raising the box earns one AT28.
events.H3-46.name: Footsteps Echoing to the Bottom
events.H3-46.scene: The caller is resting. Apparently, vibrations through the ground can also signal the valley’s mine entrance.
events.H3-46.action: Signal with your heels, or buy a spare mallet and strike.
events.H3-46.result: Heels cost 2 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and restore 6 MP. The mallet costs 80G and earns SW29 from a miner. You may pass without doing either.
events.H3-47.name: The Chimney’s Wrapping Cloth
events.H3-47.scene: Day- and night-shift loads are wrapped in the same cloth, hiding their destinations.
events.H3-47.action: Mark the cloth with a sun, or tie it into a secure crescent shape.
events.H3-47.result: Sun earns shared lunch restoring 8 HP. Crescent lets you choose one AT29 or BD30 from the night shift.
events.H3-48.name: The Gouge on the Stone Steps
events.H3-48.scene: A round-handled gouge rolls down the steps into the path of your next footfall.
events.H3-48.action: Leap sideways and brace against a rock, or set down your item bag to catch it.
events.H3-48.result: Leaping costs 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining). Catching loses one chosen consumable. You can leap with no items.
events.H3-49.name: The Low Beam around the Bend
events.H3-49.scene: A beam juts low across a dark corner, with mud at head height.
events.H3-49.action: Pay to light the path, or crouch beneath it.
events.H3-49.result: Lighting costs 80G. Crouching costs 5 HP, or only 2 with armor equipped (minimum 1 remaining). A trap-prevention item also avoids the loss.
events.H3-50.name: The Gravel Hiding a Hollow
events.H3-50.scene: The ground under inspection crumbles, and gravel falls from beneath your soles.
events.H3-50.action: Leap to a hanging rope or solidify your footing with magic.
events.H3-50.result: Leaping costs 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining). Solidifying costs 2 MP. Without enough MP, leap to continue.

events.H4-01.name: The Answering Signpost
events.H4-01.scene: One of the wooden tubes that echo signals on foggy days has fallen silent where a branch has grown into it.
events.H4-01.action: Pull the branch out of the tube and wait for the lost traveler beyond the mist to signal back.
events.H4-01.result: The signpost keeper gives you 510G for the repair.
events.H4-02.name: The Stamp-Carrying Slug
events.H4-02.scene: At the forest post office, a slug is riding the edge of a stamp on a journey behind the desk.
events.H4-02.action: Move it onto a wet leaf, dry the stamp, and return it to the ledger.
events.H4-02.result: The postmaster cancels the loss report and pays you a 460G finder’s fee.
events.H4-03.name: The Driverless Wooden Cart
events.H4-03.scene: An empty wooden cart blocks the road. Somewhere ahead in the mist, its driver calls for help.
events.H4-03.action: Straighten the wheels and push the cart toward the voice.
events.H4-03.result: Take the driver, who has twisted an ankle, back to the hut. The guild pays you 590G.
events.H4-04.name: The Rainbow Washing Stone
events.H4-04.scene: Moss makes the dyer’s washing stone slippery, leaving the finished cloth stranded in the stream.
events.H4-04.action: Wrap linen around the stones underfoot, then help haul the bolt of cloth ashore.
events.H4-04.result: The dyer pays you 540G for helping with one bolt of cloth.
events.H4-05.name: The Bird That Returns a Scabbard
events.H4-05.scene: Every morning, a bird brings an empty scabbard back to the forest workshop. The blade never arrives.
events.H4-05.action: Put a cloth-wrapped branch into the scabbard and follow the bird to its true destination.
events.H4-05.result: You meet the owner who wanted an old sword delivered and receive sword SW31.
events.H4-06.name: A Little Map in the Lining
events.H4-06.scene: A tailor has embroidered the route home inside a piece of armor so its wearer will not get lost in the mist.
events.H4-06.action: Stitch in the missing stream and log bridge so the apprentice can trace the route with a finger.
events.H4-06.result: For the gift of a map, receive one piece of armor: AR31 or AR33.
events.H4-07.name: A Helmet on Antlers
events.H4-07.scene: A deer with an old helmet caught on its antlers is stuck among the saplings.
events.H4-07.action: Crouch low and use a long knife to cut only the helmet’s cord.
events.H4-07.result: Once the deer leaves, search the spot to recover armor AR34, left by a former watchman.
events.H4-08.name: The Forest Keeper’s Two Keepsakes
events.H4-08.scene: Two packages sit on the forest keeper’s desk. His younger brother wants to entrust a traveler with one of the keepsakes meant for his siblings.
events.H4-08.action: Open the packages together and say which keepsake you will take on your journey.
events.H4-08.result: Take sword SW35 for the strength to press onward, or armor AR35 for the strength to withstand.
events.H4-09.name: A Gray Tail and a White Cane
events.H4-09.scene: Beyond tracks that lead a cane-using traveler back to the same tree, a Mist Fox turns around.
events.H4-09.action: Seat the traveler on a stone, then pursue the fox using white cloth tied to a branch as a marker.
events.H4-09.result: Fight EN06. The cloth reveals the enemy’s position, adding 4 damage to normal attacks in round 1. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H4-10.name: A Nest That Weaves the Rain
events.H4-10.scene: A Thorn Spider has woven a lid-like web over a bucket that collects water dripping from the leaves.
events.H4-10.action: Bang an empty bucket some distance away to lure the enemy without spilling the stored water.
events.H4-10.result: Fight EN07. The bucket takes a blow, reducing the first damage that reaches your HP by 4. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H4-11.name: The Same Parent and Child in the Mist
events.H4-11.scene: The parent and child you already passed are ahead of you again. The shadow behind them is a Mist Fox.
events.H4-11.action: Have the real pair hold hands, then roll a stone toward the shadow’s feet.
events.H4-11.result: Fight EN06. If you guard on your first turn, the enemy trips over the stone and loses 4 HP after its first action (minimum 1 remaining). Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H4-12.name: The Tree-Climbing First-Aid Box
events.H4-12.scene: A woodcutter’s first-aid box rests on a branch, its handle wrapped in Thorn Spider silk.
events.H4-12.action: Catch the bottom of the box with a cloth, then face the spider as it descends to the ground.
events.H4-12.result: Fight EN07. Before starting, choose to restore either 3 HP or 2 MP with supplies from the box. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H4-13.name: The Stump’s False Campfire
events.H4-13.scene: Flames appear above a cold stump, drawing a traveler off the path toward a Mist Fox’s den.
events.H4-13.action: Hold a real light low to guide the traveler back, then shine it on the remaining shadow.
events.H4-13.result: Fight EN06. The real light adds 5 damage to your first attack spell that hits. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H4-14.name: A Tiny Address Beneath a Leaf
events.H4-14.scene: You cannot find the house awaiting a medicine delivery. The fronts of the leaves are blank, but house markings remain on their backs.
events.H4-14.action: Turn the leaves over without breaking the branches and point out the delivery destinations in the order of the markings.
events.H4-14.result: Receive 1 HE31 from the delivery worker. If you are in a hurry, you may restore 6 HP immediately instead of taking the item.
events.H4-15.name: The Squirrel’s Door Lock
events.H4-15.scene: The hut door will not close. A large wooden spoon, rather than an acorn, is wedged in the hinge.
events.H4-15.action: Remove the spoon and move the squirrel’s nuts into another shallow box.
events.H4-15.result: Receive 1 item from the hut’s supplies: either AT31 or BD31.
events.H4-16.name: A Bookmark That Cuts the Shadows
events.H4-16.scene: On the forest library shelves, the leaves marking where books belong have dried and crumbled.
events.H4-16.action: Fold thin bark into bookmarks and return the books to their original shelves.
events.H4-16.result: The librarian gives you 1 board item BD32. Leave the books on the shelf for the next reader.
events.H4-17.name: The Waterdrop Field Journal
events.H4-17.scene: Droplets of mist have fallen on drawings of mushrooms, making it impossible to tell spots from paint.
events.H4-17.action: Stretch a dry cloth overhead and copy a page that has not smudged.
events.H4-17.result: The collector shares 1 HE32 or HE33 from their supplies.
events.H4-18.name: The Stray Cricket Orchestra
events.H4-18.scene: The crickets’ cage has opened. The only silent cricket rests its legs on a painter’s hat.
events.H4-18.action: Place the hat over the cage and wait for the cricket to climb onto a stem by itself.
events.H4-18.result: Receive 1 AT32 from the orchestra’s travel supplies. If you have a companion, you may choose BD33 instead as thanks for the ensemble performance.
events.H4-19.name: The Moss-Covered Handcart
events.H4-19.scene: Moss covers a handcart left idle so long that its handle seems to merge with a sapling.
events.H4-19.action: Find the join beneath the moss and push the cart free without hurting the tree.
events.H4-19.result: The owner gives you 1 BD34 from the cart. If you have no items, they also add 1 HE34.
events.H4-20.name: The Sign Only Owls Can Read
events.H4-20.scene: An upside-down sign at the owl watchtower has baffled the daytime watchman.
events.H4-20.action: Copy the sign from its reflection in the water and hang a correctly oriented version on the lower post.
events.H4-20.result: Receive 1 AT33 or HE35 from the daytime watchman. You can compare how both are used before choosing.
events.H4-21.name: The White-Fruit Sorting Plates
events.H4-21.scene: Rainwater fills the fruit-sorting plates, nearly erasing the lines that mark where each batch was gathered.
events.H4-21.action: Empty the plates one at a time and fasten their labels outside the receiving trays.
events.H4-21.result: The gatherer gives you 1 BD35. If you arrived with 0 MP, also restore 2 MP immediately.
events.H4-22.name: The Homing Pigeon That Cannot Go In
events.H4-22.scene: A pigeon shuffles outside its nest box. A swollen seed bag blocks the entrance from inside.
events.H4-22.action: Open the bottom of the box and move the spilled seeds away from the passage.
events.H4-22.result: Choose 1 HE36 or BD36 from the messenger’s supplies.
events.H4-23.name: The Alarm Clock Beneath a Branch
events.H4-23.scene: A woodcutter’s alarm clock keeps ringing beneath a fallen branch, keeping the nocturnal animals awake.
events.H4-23.action: Stop the spring mechanism and lift the branch without cracking the bell.
events.H4-23.result: The woodcutter gives you 1 AT34. Instead, you may prepare to reduce the first damage in your next battle by 3.
events.H4-24.name: A Bamboo Boat Carrying Light
events.H4-24.scene: A little lantern boat cannot reach the bank, leaving a signal from the storehouse undelivered.
events.H4-24.action: Free the bent bamboo from the bridge pier and clear a channel so the boat can drift to the far bank.
events.H4-24.result: Receive 1 AT35 or BD37 as thanks from the storehouse.
events.H4-25.name: The Palm-Shaped Stump
events.H4-25.scene: A broad trunk opens like a hand, sheltering only its center from the rain.
events.H4-25.action: Set your bags in the hollow and rewrap your bandages.
events.H4-25.result: Restore 7 HP. If your HP was already full, save the treatment for later and receive 1 HE37 instead.
events.H4-26.name: Sky Through a Fox Window
events.H4-26.scene: A child makes a little window with interlaced fingers, searching for a thin patch in the mist.
events.H4-26.action: Copy the gesture, find light above the trees, and point it out to the child.
events.H4-26.result: Restore 4 MP. If your MP was already full, reduce the cost of the first spell that costs MP in your next battle by 2 (minimum 1).
events.H4-27.name: A Towel Washed in Moonlight
events.H4-27.scene: Only moonlight reaches this deep part of the woods, making the freshly washed cloth shine white.
events.H4-27.action: Lay the towel on your forehead or tuck it into a gap in your cloak.
events.H4-27.result: On your forehead, it restores 5 MP. In your cloak, it restores 5 HP and reduces the first damage in your next battle by 2.
events.H4-28.name: Forest Sugar Cubes
events.H4-28.scene: A confectioner making sweets from hardened sap sorts little cubes from thin flakes.
events.H4-28.action: Take a cube to savor, or help make the sweets before resting.
events.H4-28.result: The cube restores 8 HP. Helping restores 4 HP and 3 MP.
events.H4-29.name: The Listening Log
events.H4-29.scene: With your ear against a hollow log, you can hear a distant spring bubbling.
events.H4-29.action: Listen at the opening facing the stream or the one facing the tree roots.
events.H4-29.result: The stream side restores half your missing HP; the root side restores half your missing MP. Round fractions up.
events.H4-30.name: A Place at the Forest Doctor’s
events.H4-30.scene: A cloth lies on the forest doctor’s resting log. A twig left by the previous patient reads “Next, please.”
events.H4-30.action: Spread the cloth again and show the doctor what you want treated.
events.H4-30.result: Restore 10 HP or 6 MP. If both are already full, you can take 1 spare HE38 home instead.
events.H4-31.name: White Spores Like Snow
events.H4-31.scene: White powder softly covers a stump as the forest lantern keeper sweeps a shrine with a tiny broom.
events.H4-31.action: Take over and gently brush away the powder without putting out the flame.
events.H4-31.result: Restore 3 MP. If your original HP was at or below half your maximum, the keeper’s treatment also restores 5 HP.
events.H4-32.name: A Hole for Warming Hands
events.H4-32.scene: Seeing a child blowing on chilled fingers, a woodcutter opens a space beside the charcoal box.
events.H4-32.action: Warm your own hands first or let the child go ahead of you.
events.H4-32.result: Going first restores 7 HP. Giving up your turn restores 4 MP, and the woodcutter gives you 1 AT36.
events.H4-33.name: The Moss Wall That Knows Morning
events.H4-33.scene: In a forest where morning and evening look alike, a traveler rests while checking the dampness of the moss.
events.H4-33.action: Lie down with your back to the dry side or wipe your face on the damp side.
events.H4-33.result: The dry side restores 6 HP and 1 MP. The damp side restores 1 HP and 5 MP.
events.H4-34.name: An Old Ticket Marks the Way
events.H4-34.scene: Someone has tucked an old ticket into a pilgrim’s journal at the rest stop.
events.H4-34.action: Read the short letter on its back and return it to the same page, or write a reply in the margin.
events.H4-34.result: Reading restores 4 MP. Replying restores 5 HP, plus 3 MP if a companion is traveling with you.
events.H4-35.name: The Gloveless Doll
events.H4-35.scene: One hand of a wooden doll is wet from the rain. A little glove left by a previous pilgrim lies at its feet.
events.H4-35.action: Dry the glove and put it on the doll, then warm your own arm with the remaining cloth.
events.H4-35.result: Restore one quarter of your maximum HP, rounding up. If you arrived on a roll of 1–3, also restore 3 MP.
events.H4-36.name: The Joined Tents
events.H4-36.scene: Before sunset, travelers join their tents in a ring, sharing the sheltered and breezy spots.
events.H4-36.action: Sit around the fire in the center or enjoy the night breeze at the edge.
events.H4-36.result: The center restores 6 HP and adds 2 damage to your first normal attack in the next battle. The edge restores 5 MP.
events.H4-37.name: Shelter Beneath a Bell Mushroom
events.H4-37.scene: Forest folk run an inn beneath a huge inedible mushroom.
events.H4-37.action: Climb the stairs on its stalk and choose a room away from the dripping rain.
events.H4-37.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Once only, restore 4 HP or 4 MP, choosing one that is not full. If both are full, you may choose 1 BD38 instead.
events.H4-38.name: The Inn with a Map for a Wall
events.H4-38.scene: The inn’s great wall is covered in lines tracing the journeys of people who lost their way.
events.H4-38.action: Borrow a different-colored piece of chalk at reception and draw the route you took.
events.H4-38.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. As thanks for adding to the map, receive 1 AT37 or HE39 once only. You may use the facilities without taking either.
events.H4-39.name: The Echo-Waiting Tree Inn
events.H4-39.scene: Rooms jut out around the trunk, carrying calls from downstairs upward in turn.
events.H4-39.action: Answer the receptionist before climbing the wooden steps one at a time.
events.H4-39.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Once only, prepare to restore 3 MP if you guard on your first turn in the next battle. Normal rest is available separately.
events.H4-40.name: Black-Window Birch Lodge
events.H4-40.scene: Black cloth covers the inn’s windows so guests can sleep without being startled by the mist outside.
events.H4-40.action: Open the birch door and hang one wooden tag for each person staying.
events.H4-40.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Borrow the innkeeper’s warm stone once to restore 4 HP. If no companion is traveling with you, also restore 3 MP.
events.H4-41.name: The Wide-Brimmed Innkeeper
events.H4-41.scene: Colored ribbons tied by travelers who arrived lost dangle from the innkeeper’s hat brim.
events.H4-41.action: Tie on a ribbon matching the color of an empty bed.
events.H4-41.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. If your item bag has at least 1 free slot, receive 1 BD39 from the innkeeper once only. You may make room first and collect it afterward.
events.H4-42.name: The Forked Walking Stick
events.H4-42.scene: Two pilgrims heading in different directions want to split a forked walking stick into one each.
events.H4-42.action: Finish it as two walking sticks or keep it whole as a shoulder pole for carrying luggage.
events.H4-42.result: Making walking sticks earns you sword SW38. Making a shoulder pole earns you 1 HE40 or BD40 from their luggage.
events.H4-43.name: The Cuckoo’s Rented Home
events.H4-43.scene: The bird in an old clock has stopped. Both the clockmaker who wants to fix it and the little bird living inside are troubled.
events.H4-43.action: Leave the clock stopped and build a nest box, or borrow a spare shed and move the bird there.
events.H4-43.result: Building a box earns you 630G from the clockmaker. Borrowing the shed costs 90G and adds 6 damage to your first attack spell in the next battle.
events.H4-44.name: The Stump No One Sits On
events.H4-44.scene: One seat is empty at the forest feast. The late guest seems to be a musician who lost the path.
events.H4-44.action: Go looking for the musician or open their sheet music at the seat and start playing.
events.H4-44.result: Finding the musician earns you armor AR38. Playing restores 5 MP and earns you 1 battle item AT38.
events.H4-45.name: The Sleeve the Fireflies Follow
events.H4-45.scene: Fireflies use your cloak sleeve as a guide. A child in a nearby hut is waiting for one too.
events.H4-45.action: Open your sleeve to let the swarm return, or carry just one to the hut in an open cage.
events.H4-45.result: Returning the swarm restores 4 HP and 4 MP. Carrying one to the hut reduces the first positive damage in your next battle by 5.
events.H4-46.name: The Tree Crossing Toll
events.H4-46.scene: A tree spanning a valley offers a free footpath beside a paid cargo sled.
events.H4-46.action: Load your bags on the sled and rest, or help the person pulling it.
events.H4-46.result: Using the sled costs 100G and restores 10 HP. Pulling costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and earns you 1 AT39. Simply walking changes nothing.
events.H4-47.name: The Final Act of a Frayed Curtain
events.H4-47.scene: A torn curtain in the forest theater has split the final scene’s moon in two.
events.H4-47.action: Borrow a needle to sew the moon together or use your light to turn the second moon into a star.
events.H4-47.result: Sewing restores 5 MP and 2 HP. Lighting costs 2 MP and earns you 1 AT40. You can sew even with no MP.
events.H4-48.name: The Root Bridge That Flips
events.H4-48.scene: A root that seemed held firmly by moss flips over as soon as you step on it.
events.H4-48.action: Hang from the root with both hands or lighten your load and cross to the far bank.
events.H4-48.result: Hanging costs 5 HP (minimum 1 remaining). To lighten your load, choose and lose 1 consumable instead, without losing HP.
events.H4-49.name: The Red Marsh That Looks Like Fire
events.H4-49.scene: Reflections on the red water hide the path. Before you notice, one foot has sunk into the mud.
events.H4-49.action: Pull it out slowly or use MP to make ripples and find solid ground.
events.H4-49.result: Pulling free costs 4 HP (minimum 1 remaining). Making ripples costs 3 MP. A trap-prevention item lets you keep both.
events.H4-50.name: The Hollow That Copies Voices
events.H4-50.scene: “This way,” calls a voice from a fallen tree. When you step inside, an old board bends beneath you.
events.H4-50.action: Rent a handrail or roll nuts across the boards to find the weak spots.
events.H4-50.result: The handrail costs 120G. Searching costs 5 HP, reduced to 2 if your landing roll was even (minimum 1 remaining).
