events.H5-01.name: Morning Papers Rain on the Square
events.H5-01.scene: Wind sweeps the morning papers off the castle town’s printshop roof.
events.H5-01.action: Gather the copies that fell on the cobblestones and deliver them so every home receives the castle gate’s notice.
events.H5-01.result: After delivering the notices, receive 650G from the printshop.
events.H5-02.name: The Key Lost in the Moat
events.H5-02.scene: The moat-cleaning crew has dropped the key to a rented warehouse. There is no time to wait for the sluice gate to close.
events.H5-02.action: Tie a bread basket to a long rope and scoop up the key ring from the bank.
events.H5-02.result: The crew chief gives you 720G once the warehouse is open again.
events.H5-03.name: A Wedding Without Bells
events.H5-03.scene: The great clock bell is blocked, leaving the brides unable to announce the start of the ceremony.
events.H5-03.action: Visit each shop around the square and ask them to ring their doorbells in turn.
events.H5-03.result: A ripple of bells reaches the wedding venue. Receive 840G in thanks from both families.
events.H5-04.name: Old Records on the Stairs
events.H5-04.scene: During a library evacuation, a librarian carrying a box of heavy ledgers is stuck at the top of the stone steps.
events.H5-04.action: Lay boards across the steps and lower the boxes one at a time, using cloth to slow them.
events.H5-04.result: Move the library without dropping a single volume and receive 780G from the town for transport.
events.H5-05.name: The Sword Painted on the Wall
events.H5-05.scene: At the castle town’s training hall, a child stands back-to-back with a life-size painting of a sword.
events.H5-05.action: Mark a height the child can reach and lower the practice rack.
events.H5-05.result: The instructor gives you sword SW41 for your journey. The practice equipment stays with the child.
events.H5-06.name: Feather Ornaments Sewn Together
events.H5-06.scene: The armor shop’s decorative feathers are tangled together, keeping two displayed suits from being taken down separately.
events.H5-06.action: Cut only the threads that will not damage the feather bases and return both suits to the counter.
events.H5-06.result: For helping the shop, receive one piece of armor: AR41 or AR43.
events.H5-07.name: The Knight’s Shelf Awaiting a Horse
events.H5-07.scene: An injured old knight no longer goes on expeditions, but still polishes his horse’s equipment every day.
events.H5-07.action: Send the worn saddle to the stable and help tidy the newly cleared shelf.
events.H5-07.result: Inherit either sword SW44 or armor AR44 from the shelf.
events.H5-08.name: The Mason’s Little Platform
events.H5-08.scene: A castle-wall mason sets the last stone on a fitting platform built to match the hero’s height.
events.H5-08.action: Level the platform and swing the weapons to check their reach without hitting the wall.
events.H5-08.result: After trying them, choose one sword: SW46 or SW48.
events.H5-09.name: The Stone Mouth That Spits Rain
events.H5-09.scene: What looked like a gutter opens its eyes: a Rampart Gargoyle directly above a line of water buckets.
events.H5-09.action: Move the buckets aside, lead the people back, and turn the enemy toward dry stone steps.
events.H5-09.result: Fight EN08. Its wet wings are heavy, capping the total direct-hit damage in its first action at 6. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H5-10.name: The Cranked Gate That Will Not Close
events.H5-10.scene: A small gate in the castle wall will not shut. A Thorn Spider has built a bag-like nest deep in the winch.
events.H5-10.action: Prop up the gate with a pole and turn to face the enemy leaping from its nest.
events.H5-10.result: Fight EN07. Choosing a normal attack on your first turn unravels the nest, reducing enemy direct-hit damage that round by 4. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H5-11.name: The White Flag Left on the Roof
events.H5-11.scene: A Rampart Gargoyle’s claw catches on the white flag signaling that evacuation is complete.
events.H5-11.action: Free the flagpole from the roof and bring the enemy down into the empty courtyard.
events.H5-11.result: Fight EN08. If an attack spell used on your first turn hits, the cloth catches on its wings and halves direct-hit damage from its first action, rounding up. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H5-12.name: The Haystack Puppet Soldier
events.H5-12.scene: Stable hay moves in the shape of a soldier. A Thorn Spider is pulling its strings, frightening the horses.
events.H5-12.action: Close the stalls and throw an unused saddle to tangle the threads.
events.H5-12.result: Fight EN07. The first time you guard, the threads pull on the saddle, reducing the total direct-hit damage you take that round by an additional 5. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H5-13.name: The Castle Gate’s Applause Squad
events.H5-13.scene: A Rampart Gargoyle lands in the square. The cheering children freeze with their hands still raised to clap.
events.H5-13.action: Turn the clapping into an evacuation signal and lead everyone into cover before facing the enemy.
events.H5-13.result: Fight EN08. The cheers add 3 damage to a normal attack on your first turn. If you guard on that turn instead, restore 3 MP. Victory grants the enemy’s specified XP and gold, with separate equipment and item drop rolls. Both can succeed. Fleeing or losing grants no loot.
events.H5-14.name: The Lamp Shop That Will Not Sell Wicks
events.H5-14.scene: The castle town’s lamp shop is distributing wicks to evacuation shelters and needs more hands to cut the thread.
events.H5-14.action: Cut bundles of thread to the length of a board and sort them by destination.
events.H5-14.result: Receive 1 AT41 or BD41 from the shop’s spare supplies. The bundles of wicks reach the shelters.
events.H5-15.name: Claim Tickets in the Steam
events.H5-15.scene: Steam at the public baths has soaked the claim tickets, making the luggage owners’ names unreadable.
events.H5-15.action: Match the holes in the tickets to the shapes of the keys and return each person’s belongings.
events.H5-15.result: Receive 1 HE41 from reception. If your item bag is full, you may restore 6 HP instead of taking it.
events.H5-16.name: The Pharmacy’s High Shelves
events.H5-16.scene: The pharmacy’s steps have come loose, leaving its short shopkeeper unable to reach the top shelf.
events.H5-16.action: Support the steps with empty boxes and move the medicines down to waist height.
events.H5-16.result: The shopkeeper shows you HE42 and HE43. Choose 1 of either.
events.H5-17.name: Marker Nails on the Outer Moat
events.H5-17.scene: Nails have fallen from the cargo boats’ number plates, threatening to mix up their destinations.
events.H5-17.action: Line up the boats by color and hammer the nails back where the boards will not split.
events.H5-17.result: Receive 1 BD42 from the shipwright’s supplies. If your current MP is below half, you may choose HE44 instead.
events.H5-18.name: The Pot-Lid Parade
events.H5-18.scene: People at the soup kitchen are returning pot lids, but none seem to fit the pots.
events.H5-18.action: Compare their sounds and diameters and stack each lid on its original pot.
events.H5-18.result: Receive 1 AT42 or HE45 from the server.
events.H5-19.name: The Cloak Shop’s Last Button
events.H5-19.scene: A button fallen from a cloak before departure washes along a gutter and stops at a small drain.
events.H5-19.action: Scoop it up with a loop of thread rather than a magnet and sew it onto its owner’s sleeve.
events.H5-19.result: Receive 1 BD43 in thanks from the cloak shop. If 2 companions are traveling with you, you may choose AT43 instead.
events.H5-20.name: The Giant Key Missing a Tooth
events.H5-20.scene: On the morning the decorative wall key joins the festival parade, one wooden tooth is missing.
events.H5-20.action: Carve a fallen wood scrap to fit and pass the handle to the child at the head of the procession.
events.H5-20.result: Choose 1 BD44 or BD45 from the festival’s leftover supplies.
events.H5-21.name: A Day to Wash the Signal Flags
events.H5-21.scene: Mud has splashed the aid station’s flag, making it hard to recognize on a windless morning.
events.H5-21.action: Hold the flag taut with a helper, then raise the washed cloth on a tall pole.
events.H5-21.result: Receive 1 HE46 from the aid station. If your HP was at or below half before receiving it, also restore 4 HP.
events.H5-22.name: A Shoulder-High Farewell
events.H5-22.scene: A little child has dropped a hat beyond the railing and cannot see an older brother off.
events.H5-22.action: Retrieve the hat, put it back on the child, and lead them to higher ground away from the railing.
events.H5-22.result: Receive 1 AT44 from the family, or restore 5 MP instead.
events.H5-23.name: The Icehouse’s Name-Tag Cord
events.H5-23.scene: The cord holding a name tag on the icehouse door has frozen, leaving the person there unable to open it.
events.H5-23.action: Loosen only the knot with a warm cloth and hang a replacement cord on a nail in the wall.
events.H5-23.result: The icehouse keeper gives you 1 AT45 or BD46. You can leave without depleting the supplies inside.
events.H5-24.name: The Postal Dog with a Quill
events.H5-24.scene: A postal dog sits holding a quill in its mouth. Its short legs cannot reach the receipt field on the desk.
events.H5-24.action: Copy the receipt field onto a board on the floor and have the dog stamp it with a paw.
events.H5-24.result: The dining hall receives its delivery receipt and gives you 1 HE47. If you arrived with an empty bag, also receive 1 BD47.
events.H5-25.name: The Last Bowl for a Hundred People
events.H5-25.scene: One serving of soup remains in the castle town’s great pot. The server warms a bowl again for the hero.
events.H5-25.action: Sit down and accept the bowl or exchange it for an item from the server’s supplies.
events.H5-25.result: The meal restores 10 HP and 2 MP. Choosing supplies gives you 1 HE48.
events.H5-26.name: A Foot Check Below the Stairs
events.H5-26.scene: Before the castle’s long staircase, a shoemaker arranges steps to match travelers’ strides.
events.H5-26.action: Walk up and down once, say which side hurts, and add thin cloth to the sole.
events.H5-26.result: Restore 8 HP. If your landing roll was 4–6, restore an additional 3 HP to soothe your well-traveled feet.
events.H5-27.name: The Theater Without a Show
events.H5-27.scene: The theater serving as a shelter has a stage for playing with echoes and seats where you can stretch out.
events.H5-27.action: Sing a verse onstage or lie down among the seats.
events.H5-27.result: The stage restores 6 MP. The seats restore 9 HP and reduce the first damage in your next battle by 1.
events.H5-28.name: The Aid Lamp’s Two Wicks
events.H5-28.scene: A pale blue flame and an orange flame take turns lighting the room until morning.
events.H5-28.action: Draw your chair toward the pale blue flame or warm both hands over the orange one.
events.H5-28.result: Pale blue restores up to 6 missing MP, then restores HP equal to the amount of those 6 MP that could not be restored. Orange restores 10 HP.
events.H5-29.name: The Gate Guard’s Empty Lunchbox
events.H5-29.scene: The gate guard turns an empty lunchbox upside down to make a little table for tea.
events.H5-29.action: Drink the warm tea now or exchange it for the guard’s spare supplies.
events.H5-29.result: Drinking restores 5 MP and 4 HP. Exchanging gives you 1 BD48 without drinking.
events.H5-30.name: The Wheelchair Returns
events.H5-30.scene: Road repairs have brought a wheelchair back to the square. Its elderly owner wants the first guest to take a rest.
events.H5-30.action: Ride around the square in the wheelchair or push from behind and enjoy the town.
events.H5-30.result: Sitting restores one third of your maximum HP, rounding up. Pushing restores 4 HP and 4 MP.
events.H5-31.name: The Statue’s Cold Hand
events.H5-31.scene: Town children with fevers take turns touching a statue’s hand that stays cold even in summer.
events.H5-31.action: Cool your forehead against its hand, then call the next person when your turn is over.
events.H5-31.result: Restore 6 MP. If your MP was already full, add 4 damage to your first attack spell in the next battle.
events.H5-32.name: A Red Fire in the Distant Furnace
events.H5-32.scene: A small fire has returned to an abandoned furnace in the castle town, now used only to bake bread.
events.H5-32.action: Eat a slice of bread or carry spare firewood to the watch.
events.H5-32.result: Eating restores 11 HP. Carrying wood restores 4 HP and adds 3 damage to your first normal attack in the next battle.
events.H5-33.name: The Empty Covered Walkway
events.H5-33.scene: Halfway along a long corridor hangs a dark curtain where tired eyes can rest.
events.H5-33.action: Step behind the curtain and wait until you can no longer hear the entrance.
events.H5-33.result: Restore 4 HP and 4 MP. If both were already full, receive 1 AT46 from the watchman instead.
events.H5-34.name: The Pressed-Flower Patient Card
events.H5-34.scene: The castle town clinic uses pressed flowers as patient cards, welcoming even first-time travelers to its waiting room.
events.H5-34.action: When your turn comes, tell the doctor the one thing troubling you.
events.H5-34.result: Restore 12 HP or 7 MP. To save treatment for later, receive 1 HE49 instead.
events.H5-35.name: One Knee on the Castle Wall
events.H5-35.scene: A low stone waits at the top of the stairs, becoming free for the next person after each brief rest.
events.H5-35.action: Rest one knee on it and match your breathing to those still climbing.
events.H5-35.result: Restore 6 HP and 2 MP per companion. If traveling alone, restore an additional 3 HP instead.
events.H5-36.name: The Last House’s Porch Light
events.H5-36.scene: The last home on the road to the castle keeps a light on, waiting for someone to return.
events.H5-36.action: Tend your wounds beneath the light or reassure the person inside with a quiet wave.
events.H5-36.result: Treatment restores half your missing HP, rounding up. Waving restores 4 MP and reduces the first damage in your next battle by 3.
events.H5-37.name: The Gatefront Inn of Lucky Knots
events.H5-37.scene: At the gatefront inn, returning travelers untie the knots on the handrail in order.
events.H5-37.action: Tie a new cord to the railing before ringing the bell at the door.
events.H5-37.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Learn a lucky knot once. The first time you guard in your next battle, restore 4 MP.
events.H5-38.name: The Bath Inn’s Farewell Seat
events.H5-38.scene: Through the bath inn’s high window, travelers beyond the outer moat look tiny.
events.H5-38.action: Climb the stairs through the steam and sit in an empty farewell seat.
events.H5-38.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. After bathing, once only, restore 5 to whichever of HP or MP has the larger missing amount. If the missing amounts are equal, choose either.
events.H5-39.name: The Night Diner on the Corner
events.H5-39.scene: For sleepless watchmen, the inn’s dining room keeps its door half open all night.
events.H5-39.action: Offer just one empty bowl at the late-night serving window.
events.H5-39.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Receive 1 HE50 or AT47 from the dining room once only.
events.H5-40.name: The Inn Across the Castle Wall
events.H5-40.scene: A little inn straddles the wall, letting travelers from inside and outside share meals in one courtyard.
events.H5-40.action: Arrange letters from people on both sides on the courtyard table.
events.H5-40.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Sort the letters once to choose between reducing the first damage in your next battle by 4 or restoring 4 MP.
events.H5-41.name: The Letter Inn on Hundred-Step Hill
events.H5-41.scene: At an inn halfway up the stairs, undelivered letters are being moved one by one into fresh envelopes.
events.H5-41.action: Accept the innkeeper’s offer of a chair and fold a clean envelope.
events.H5-41.result: Rest, shop, change jobs, and recruit companions here. Once only, exchange 1 of your board items for either AT48 or HE50. You may simply rest instead.
events.H5-42.name: For Whom the Homecoming Bell Rings
events.H5-42.scene: The townspeople gather around the homecoming bell. One echo reaches the hero; another reaches those seeing them off.
events.H5-42.action: Ring it strongly once or softly twice.
events.H5-42.result: One ring adds 6 damage to your first normal attack in the next battle. Two rings restore 5 HP and 5 MP.
events.H5-43.name: Long Shadows in the Waiting Area
events.H5-43.scene: The great key to the castle gate is missing. The waiting crowd’s shadows stretch across the stone floor.
events.H5-43.action: Help the locksmith make a replacement or follow the shadows on the floor to search for the lost key.
events.H5-43.result: Making a replacement earns you 900G. Following the shadows earns you armor AR48, found alongside the key.
events.H5-44.name: The Drawbridge Counterweight
events.H5-44.scene: The stone counterweight that raises the bridge has chipped. The repair crew needs both carpenters and carriers.
events.H5-44.action: Carry stone or measure the missing section and carve a wooden mold.
events.H5-44.result: Carrying costs 3 HP (minimum 1 remaining) and earns you sword SW49. Carving the mold earns you 1 BD49 at no cost.
events.H5-45.name: A Discussion About the White Flag
events.H5-45.scene: There is one white flag to deliver to the outpost. The aid team needs the flag, while the messenger needs its sturdy pole.
events.H5-45.action: Remove the flag and give it to the aid team, or entrust the whole thing to the messenger.
events.H5-45.result: The aid team restores 10 HP and 2 MP. The messenger reduces the first positive damage in your next battle by 6.
events.H5-46.name: The Concert’s Last Seat
events.H5-46.scene: The only empty concert seat is offered to you for a quiet moment before battle.
events.H5-46.action: Sit and listen or stay standing and support the band’s luggage.
events.H5-46.result: Listening reduces the cost of the first spell that costs MP in your next battle by 3 (minimum 1). Supporting the luggage earns you 1 AT49 in thanks.
events.H5-47.name: Three Candles Facing the Gate
events.H5-47.scene: Three candles wait at a little altar by the gate for those setting out today.
events.H5-47.action: Light one for yourself, for your companions, or for those who will come after you.
events.H5-47.result: For yourself: restore 12 HP. For companions: restore 3 HP and 3 MP per traveling companion (unavailable when alone). For those to come: receive 1 BD50.
events.H5-48.name: Mirrorlike Ice by the Moat
events.H5-48.scene: Ice remains only in the bridge’s shadow. You slip on what looked like a wet board.
events.H5-48.action: Cling to the railing or wedge one of your battle items into the gap to stop yourself.
events.H5-48.result: The railing costs 6 HP (minimum 1 remaining). Wedging an item costs 1 chosen battle item. You can choose the railing even without an item.
events.H5-49.name: The Drawbridge Without a Signal
events.H5-49.scene: The passage flag has blown down, stranding your party as the bridge starts to rise.
events.H5-49.action: Call for a rescue boat’s rope or shift toward the lower side and climb down.
events.H5-49.result: The rescue boat costs 150G. Climbing down costs 6 HP, reduced to 3 if you have 2 companions (minimum 1 remaining). You may also use a trap-prevention item.
events.H5-50.name: The Thread Curtain Before the Gate
events.H5-50.scene: Fine threads that looked decorative are lifting old weights from the cobblestones.
events.H5-50.action: Use MP to lift the threads or support the weights on your shoulders while everyone passes one at a time.
events.H5-50.result: Lifting costs 4 MP. Supporting costs 5 HP (minimum 1 remaining). You can support the weights and pass even without enough MP.
